fdroid:com.jarsilio.android.magnifica.name: Magnifica
fdroid:com.jarsilio.android.magnifica.description:
Magnifica is a magnifier app I built because sometimes text is tiny, labels are impossible to read, and product designers apparently enjoy using microscopic fonts.
The name is a little bilingual joke, born of a glorious act of linguistic optimism. I'm Spanish, and "Magnifica" sounds a bit like "magnify" in English. At the same time it brings to mind magnífica in Spanish, which means "magnificent." So the goal was obvious: build a magnifier app that's, well... magnificent.
 Features 
▸ Magnifies stuff. The tiny print on a medicine box, the impossible serial number on a router, the ingredients list written by someone who clearly hates you — or that suspicious little dot on your kid's leg that you really, really need to know is a freckle and not a tick. Point, zoom, see.
▸ Freeze. Tap to hold a full-resolution still. While frozen, zoom in further and pan around to examine detail you couldn't see in the live view. Tap again to unfreeze. The volume buttons work too — either one freezes or unfreezes without touching the screen.
▸ Share. While frozen, tap to send the image to any app — the file is a plain JPEG with the active colour effect applied and no EXIF, no GPS, no timestamps, no device information.
▸ Sensible zoom. Tap plus and minus to snap through powers of two (1×, 2×, 4×, 8×…), or pinch to zoom smoothly anywhere in between. Zoom level is remembered when you switch away and come back.
▸ Tap to focus. See a blurry thing, tap it, it becomes a readable thing.
▸ A torch. On the back camera it's your real flashlight. The front camera has no flash, so it turns the whole screen blindingly white and calls that a "flash." It's a hack. It works.
▸ Front and back cameras , one button to flip between them.
▸ Color effects. Six filters applied live — negative, grayscale, high contrast, yellow on black, color-blind assist, or none. Tap to toggle; long-press to preview all six on a live thumbnail of your current view.
▸ Screen stays on. The display doesn't dim while the app is open.
No accounts. No ads. No mysterious permissions. It wants the camera, because it's a camera app, and then it would like to be left alone to do its job.
 Magnifica is open source and released under the GPLv3 license[1]. Check out the code[2] if you like.
 Get it 
You can download it for free in F-Droid[3].
Translations are always welcome! :)
The app is available for translation on Transifex[4].
 Magnifica: a magnificent way to make small things bigger.
[1] https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.en.html
[2] https://gitlab.com/juanitobananas/magnifica
[3] https://f-droid.org/packages/com.jarsilio.android.magnifica/
[4] https://explore.transifex.com/juanitobananas/magnifica

Here's a list of supported triggers and actions:
Supported triggers:

* Bluetooth connection
* Headset connected
* Notifications of other apps
* Device orientation (gyroscope)
* Profile active or not
* Screen state (on or off)
* Status of media playback
* Device is starting
* Service is starting
* Broadcasts of other apps
* Router state
* System states (Bluetooth/wifi)
* Variables that have been set
* Calendar appointments
* Phone call running
Supported actions:
* Change wifi state
* Change bluetooth state
* Toggle USB tethering
* Toggle wifi tethering
* Toggle Bluetooth tethering
* Toggle automatic screen rotation
* Make an HTTP request
* Change ringtone/sound setting
* Start another application
* Wait (in between other actions)
* Turn screen on or off
* Toggle airplane mode
* Toggle mobile data connection
* Speak text
* Open music player
* Control media playback
* Change screen brightness
* Play sound file
* Create notifications
* Close notifications
* Send broadcasts
* Run script/command
* Maintain screen active
* Set variables
* Initiate phone calls
* Terminate phone calls

* Make screenshot
* Change location setting
* Send text message
It's quite hard to keep this app working across the many different devices as well as the many changes Android undergoes over the versions. I can test it in the emulator, but that cannot show all bugs.
So if a certain feature is not working on your device - let me know. Over the years I have fixed almost all bugs that have been reasonably reported to me. But for that I'm dependent on your input.
If you have a problem and think about contacting me please

- check this list of known problems first: https://server47.de/automation/index.php#knownProblems
Donations are certainly a good, but not the only way to motivate me :-)

* Furthermore I can always use help in translating the app. English, German and some Spanish are among my own skills. Italiano e russo sono già coperti. But everything else is more than welcome.
* If you have a talent/experience in graphics design and have some ideas for nicer icons let me know.

fdroid:org.androidlabs.filewall.name: Filewall: Secure Storage Provider
fdroid:org.androidlabs.filewall.summary: A file firewall: choose which apps may read, write or list your files.
fdroid:org.androidlabs.filewall.description:
Filewall is a firewall for your files. It is a document provider built on Android's Storage Access Framework (SAF): files live in the app's own private storage, and every other app that wants to read, write or list them has to go through Filewall's rules.
How access is gated:
* The system's own SAF grant, as for any document provider.
* An optional PIN, with fingerprint or face unlock if you like. Turn it on in Settings.
* Your rules, evaluated top to bottom - the first match applies, like a firewall.
Key features:
* Rules per app, per folder or per file: allow read, write or list, block, or extend a rule to subfolders.
* Time-limited rules that expire on their own.
* When an app asks for something no rule covers, you get a request to allow or block it - one decision can answer a whole batch of requests.
* An optional access log that records what each app tried and why it was allowed or denied. It can be filtered and exported as CSV, and it can be switched off.
* No account, no analytics and no network access: Filewall does not declare the Internet permission. No root needed.
Permissions the app declares, and why:
* POST_NOTIFICATIONS - to tell you about access requests and blocked access (optional).
* USE_BIOMETRIC - fingerprint or face unlock in addition to the PIN (optional).
* RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED - ends any open authentication session when the device restarts.
* QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES - lists your installed apps when you create a rule and shows the name and icon of the app asking for access. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
IMPORTANT: Filewall controls and restricts access; it does not encrypt your files. If you need encryption, combine it with an encryption tool. Threat model: it protects against unauthorized app access and accidental exposure on an unlocked device, not against root access or forensic tools.
Free software, GNU General Public License v3.

 Features

apple-macos:6820235734.name: TerraPulse: World News Map
apple-macos:6820235734.description:
TerraPulse puts the world's news on a living 3D globe, so you can see what is happening and where, at a glance.
LIVE NEWS, ON THE MAP
Headlines from major international outlets, earthquakes from USGS and natural events from NASA appear on the globe the moment they're reported. Spin the Earth, zoom into a region, or tap any glowing marker to read the story.
WHO RUNS THE OUTLET
Every story shows who is behind the outlet that reported it: private, public media, state-run or government-aligned. Tap the label to see the owner.
ONE STORY, MANY OUTLETS
When several outlets report the same event, TerraPulse groups them into one card. Tap Compare coverage to see how each outlet frames the story: what they emphasise, who they quote and what they leave out. A bar shows the mix of private, public and state-run outlets reporting it.
MORE INFO ON EVERY COUNTRY
Tap a country, then More info: inflation, the central bank's interest rate, geopolitical risk and GDP growth, each with its chart, how it compares with neighbouring countries and what it means for policymakers and investors.
YOUR DAILY BRIEF
A short summary of the day's most important stories, ready every morning.
ASK AI ABOUT THE NEWS
Ask questions like "What's happening in Sudan?" or "Why are oil prices moving?" and get clear answers that link back to the stories they come from.
GROUPS, LIVE ROOMS AND CHANNELS
Every big story has a live room where people share what they see, with an AI summary of what trusted outlets confirm and what is still unverified. Journalists with a verified PRESS badge stand out. Newsrooms can start private groups with an AI catch-up, and verified journalists run public channels you can follow, comment on and get notified about.
MARKETS AT A GLANCE
Major stock indices, commodities and crypto, with the news that moves them.
FOLLOW WHAT MATTERS TO YOU
Follow countries and get alerted when big news breaks there. Save stories to read later and share them with friends.
BREAKING NEWS NOTIFICATIONS
Optional alerts when a major story is confirmed by several outlets, plus a morning brief at 7am your time.
DAY AND NIGHT
The globe shows real daylight and city lights as the sun moves around the Earth.
No account needed to read the news: just open the app and explore the world. Groups need a quick sign-in by email.

Clipboard AI automatically saves everything you copy - text, links, phone numbers, emails, addresses, and even images. Never lose an important piece of copied text again.
SMART CLIPBOARD HISTORY
Every time you copy something, Clipboard AI captures it instantly. Your complete copy history is searchable, organized, and always available. No more "I copied something but lost it" moments.
AI-POWERED CATEGORIZATION
Clipboard AI automatically detects what you copied and sorts it into smart categories:
- Text Snippets - notes, messages, paragraphs
- Links - URLs with automatic title preview
- Phone Numbers - tap to call instantly
- Email Addresses - tap to compose
- Physical Addresses - open directly in Maps
- Codes & OTPs - verification codes, saved securely

PASTE KEYBOARD
Access your entire clipboard history from any app with our built-in keyboard extension. No more switching between apps to paste. Just open the keyboard, find your clip, and paste it instantly.
SAVE, TAG & ORGANIZE
Bookmark important clips so they never get deleted. Organize your saved items into custom collections. Tag clips for easy filtering and retrieval later.
AI TEXT TOOLS
- TL;DR Summarize - Get instant summaries of long text
- Math Solver - Automatically solves math expressions and currency conversions
- Text Transform - Convert case, format text, rewrite content
- Language Detection - Identifies the language and offers translation
- Checklist Detection - Automatically formats lists into interactive checklists
COLLECTIONS & FOLDERS
Group related clips into collections. Create folders for work, personal, shopping lists, project research, or anything else. Your clipboard, organized your way.
BUILT FOR PRODUCTIVITY
- Copy once, paste anywhere - your history is always available
- Swipe to delete - clean up with a quick gesture
- Dark mode - easy on the eyes
- iCloud sync - access your clips across all your devices
- Privacy first - your clipboard data stays on your device
WHY CLIPBOARD AI?
Most clipboard managers just save text. Clipboard AI understands what you copy. It auto-categorizes, summarizes, solves math, detects languages, and organizes everything into a searchable archive. It is the smart clipboard your iPhone should have had from day one.
Download Clipboard AI and never lose a copied text again.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
The app is free to use with upto 10 saved clips. Clipboard AI Pro is offered as an auto-renewable subscription (monthly or yearly) with a 7-day free trial, or as a one-time Lifetime purchase. Pro allows unlimited clips, iCloud sync and a lot more unlocked features.

flathub:com.github.scrivanolabs.scrivano.summary: A note-taking application for those who prefer handwriting over typing
flathub:com.github.scrivanolabs.scrivano.description:
Scrivano is a note-taking application aimed at those who prefer handwriting over typing. It
 offers a simple and easy to use interface to write down your thoughts and ideas. The app gives
 you an infinite vertical canvas (but limited horizontal space) without sacrificing the ability
 to easily export your notes in traditional printing formats (e.g. A2, A3, A4, etc...).
 Here is a summary of the most important features:
 4 different paper backgrounds to choose from: Plain, Lined, Grid or Dotted with customisable
 spacing and backgrounds.
 Grid Snapping: in Scrivano you can toggle the grid snapping feature so that your drawings
 will automatically snap to grid lines in the background. This is very useful to easily draw tables,
 diagrams and lines.
 Automatic filling of strokes: toggle the paint bucket in the toolbar to fill your drawing
 shapes and strokes.
 Stickers: save your frequently used symbols and diagrams, so you can easily drag and drop
 whenever you need them.
 Insert images: paste or drag and drop any image on the canvas to unleash your creativity!
 Offline saving: save your notes anywhere on your main drive, so you can manage them however
 you please.
 Laser: Scrivano offers a special laser tool to quickly draw over your notes. Incredibly useful
 when sharing your screen or presenting something!
 Annotate PDF files: You can import your PDF books, lecture slides, articles and documents
 to annotate them using Scrivano's built-in inking tools.
 NOTE: The flatpak version of the app runs in a sandbox environment and it can only read/write
 files from these folders: xdg-desktop, xdg-documents, xdg-download and xdg-pictures. If you want
 to circumvent this for more freedom, you can use Flatseal to override these restrictions.

flathub:com.onekeepass.OneKeePass.name: OneKeePass
flathub:com.onekeepass.OneKeePass.description:
OneKeePass keeps your passwords and other sensitive information in a single
 encrypted KeePass-compatible database file (KDBX 4). The file stays yours: keep
 it on your computer, on a USB drive, or on cloud storage you already use.
 Everything happens on your own machine. There is no account to create, no server
 to trust and no telemetry. Databases are encrypted with AES-256 or ChaCha20 and
 unlocked with a master password, a key file, or both.
 Features:
 Entries organised by type, category, tag or the standard group tree
 Custom entry types and any number of custom fields, grouped into sections
 Built-in entry types for SSH keys, identities, passports and driver licences
 Time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) with a live countdown
 Password and diceware passphrase generator
 File attachments, and custom icons for entries and groups
 Open databases directly over SFTP or WebDAV, without a third-party sync tool
 Import CSV exports from Bitwarden, 1Password, LastPass and others
 Merge databases, clone entries, and work with several databases at once

flathub:org.godotengine.Godot.description:
The feature-packed, cross-platform game engine to create 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. Godot Engine provides a comprehensive set of common tools, so that you can focus on making games without having to reinvent the wheel. Games can be exported in one click to a number of platforms, including the major desktop platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows) as well as mobile (Android, iOS), web-based (HTML5) platforms and consoles (Switch, PS4 and Xbox One - via thirdparty publishers).
 Completely free and open source under the very permissive MIT license. No strings attached, no royalties, nothing. Your game is yours down to the last line of engine code. Godot's development is fully independent and community-driven, empowering you to help shape the engine to match your expectations. It is supported by the non-profit Godot Foundation.
 Create games with ease, using Godot's unique approach to game development:
 Nodes for all your needs. Godot comes with hundreds of built-in nodes that make game design a breeze. You can also create your own for custom behaviors, editors and much more.
 Flexible scene system. Create node compositions with support for instancing and inheritance.
 Visual editor with all the tools you need packed into a beautiful and uncluttered context-sensitive UI.
 Friendly content creation pipeline for artists, level designers, animators and everything in between.
 Persistent live editing where changes are not lost after stopping the game. It even works on mobile devices!
 Create your own custom tools with ease using the incredible tool system.
 Current limitations of this Flatpak version:
 For C#/Mono support, install org.godotengine.GodotSharp instead: https://flathub.org/apps/org.godotengine.GodotSharp
 External script editors are supported, but you need to follow the steps described here: https://github.com/flathub/org.godotengine.Godot#using-an-external-script-editor
 Godot 4's Blender importer is supported, but Blender needs to be installed on your system and you need to follow the steps described here: https://github.com/flathub/org.godotengine.Godot#using-blender
 For projects using text-to-speech, make sure speech-dispatcher is installed on your system, so that this Flatpak can access it.

 Features
 Stitch together pages in any order with specified number of rows/columns
 Rotate pages for stitching
 Add a margin around the final output
 Trim or overlap the edges of each page by a specified amount
 Add blank pages by including zeros in the page list (e.g. 1-5,0,6-10)
 Layers are automatically preserved if present in the source document
 Exclude layers (either deactivate or remove)
 Modify line properties (colour, thickness, style (solid, dashed, dotted))

It aims to implement some highly efficient backtrack search algorithms in finite permutation groups. These algorithms are intended to solve a range of problems, including (but not limited to): - Subgroup intersection - Normalizer - Centralizer - Graph isomorphism - Coset intersection - Canonical image These algorithms are based on the theory introduced by the paper “Permutation group algorithms based on directed graphs” (2021) [1], by Christopher Jefferson, Markus Pfeiffer, Rebecca Waldecker, and Wilf A. Wilson. This theory extends the well-established “partition backtrack” framework of Jeffrey Leon, and works with labeled digraphs as the fundamental objects of these algorithms. [1] https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jalgebra.2021.06.015 FEDORA NOTE: If tracing is requested, the vole binary attempts to write vole.trace in the same directory as the binary. That directory is not writable by regular users, leading to the vole program exiting with an error. The Fedora build instead writes to /tmp/vole.trace.

firefox-addons:2594934.name: Bookmarks Folders Locker/Blocker
firefox-addons:2594934.summary: Make your bookmarks private! Lock/Block your bookmarks folders (hide the bookmarks inside) with a password (each folder can have a different password), the bookmarks will be encrypted and only you will be able to unlock/unblock them.
firefox-addons:2594934.description:
** IMPORTANT **
If you uninstall the extension, you will lose all your locked bookmarks! To prevent this, you first need to unlock them.
Have you ever shared your computer and therefore your browser with someone? Let me guess, yes! If I guessed it right, this is the right extension for you. When you are browsing the web, you come across loads of websites that you want to save in your bookmarks, but sometimes you don't want other people to see them, the only way you can do this is by not saving them. What a shame! This extension allows you to lock (hide) all the bookmarks inside a folder by using a password. Once you've locked the folder, you need the password to unlock it. All the hidden bookmarks are encrypted using AES 256-bit, if you use a strong enough password they will be impossible to recover. Once you want to unlock(show) them you just need to enter your password and your bookmarks will be shown again in the folder. You can even set a timer after which the folder will be locked again automatically.

firefox-addons:780998.name: Video Speed Controller
firefox-addons:780998.summary: Speed up, slow down, advance and rewind any HTML5 video with quick shortcuts.
firefox-addons:780998.description:
Faster HTML5 Video 
HTML5 video provides native APIs to accelerate playback of any video, but most implemented players either hide or limit this functionality. This extension fixes that, plus more... 
It will help you optimize your video viewing by allowing you to make quick playback speed adjustments, as well as rewind the video to hear the last few second one more time. We don't read at a constant speed, and we talk much slower than we read - there is no reason why we have to listen at a constant speed and at a (very) slow rate.
Once the extension is installed simply navigate to any page that offers HTML5 video, and you'll see a speed indicator in top left corner of the video player. Hover over the indicator to reveal the controls to accelerate, slowdown, or rewind the video. Or, even better, use your keyboard:
 S - decrease playback speed.
 D - increase playback speed.
 R - reset playback speed.
 Z - rewind video by 10 seconds.
 X - advance video by 10 seconds.
 V - show/hide controller.
If you prefer other shortcuts, want to change the increment value, or want the player to remember your playback speed in the future, head into the settings page and customize it to your heart's content.

firefox-addons:482339.name: Tab Deque
firefox-addons:482339.summary: This add-on is for you if you miss the behaviour of your computer's window manager/taskbar in your browser. It remembers the order tabs are opened and focused so when closing or minimizing a tab the previously active one gets the focus.
firefox-addons:482339.description:
Tab Deque
=========
A webextension for better tab handling. Inspired by Opera 12 and its `Activate
the last active tab` setting, which is not the same as `most recently used tab`
or `last tab selected` other extensions provide.
Most users will recognize the behaviour from the way windows are handled on
their Desktop. When using Windows(with stacking disabled) or for example Xfce
under Linux, opening a window adds it to the taskbar, clicking another one will
focus that one, closing or minimizing will bring the previous one back to
focus. This extension will do that and more.
Building a deque of tabs:
-------------------------
 - When a tab is closed, it is removed from the deque. If it was the current
 one, the next one from the front of the deque is selected.
 - Opening a tab in the background adds it at the end of the deque, so it will
 be selected after all others have been closed.
 - Opening a tab in the foreground or selecting a tab moves it to the front of
 the deque.
 - You can also send a tab to the end of the deque, which means the next one
 from the front of the deque is selected. It's bit like minimizing a window
 on your desktop, but as there is no desktop to show when all other tabs have
 been "minimized"/closed, the tab gets re-selected. This is currently an
 option in the tab's (if supported by the browser) and page's context menu.
 Ideally a simple left click would do that too (like a previous version of
 this extension based on a different API did), but there is currently no API
 for detecting clicks on tabs. There is also a keyboard shortcut:
 `Ctrl-Down`.
 - A kind of undo of the latter is `Ctrl-Up`, it selects the tab at the end of
 the deque and moves it to the front of the deque.
Privacy Policy
--------------
This extension does not collect or send data of any kind to third parties.
Feedback
--------
You can report bugs or make feature requests on
 https://github.com/sblask/webextension-tab-deque 
Patches are welcome.

bluejetty:00015751:ios.name: Stellarium Mobile - Star Map
bluejetty:00015751:ios.summary:
Stellarium Mobile is a planetarium app that shows exactly what you see when you look up at the stars.
Identify stars, constellations, planets, comets, satellites (such as the ISS), and other deep sky objects in real time in the sky above y
bluejetty:00015751:ios.description:
Stellarium Mobile is a planetarium app that shows exactly what you see when you look up at the stars.
Identify stars, constellations, planets, comets, satellites (such as the ISS), and other deep sky objects in real time in the sky above you in just a few seconds, just by pointing the phone at the sky!
This astronomy application has an easy to use and minimalist user interface, that makes it one of the best astronomical applications for adults and children who want to explore the night sky.
Stellarium Mobile features:
• View an accurate night sky simulation of stars and planets for any date, time and location.
• Dive in a collection of many stars, nebulas, galaxies, star clusters and other deep sky objects.
• Zoom on realistic Milky Way and Deep Sky Objects images.
• Discover how people living in other regions of the planet see the stars by selecting the shapes and illustrations of the constellations for many sky cultures.
• Track artificial satellites, including the International Space Station.
• Simulate landscape and atmosphere with realistic sunrise, sunset and atmosphere refraction.
• Discover 3D rendering of the major solar system planets and their satellites.
• Observe the sky in night mode (red) to preserve your eyes adaptation to darkness.
Stellarium Mobile contains in-app purchases allowing to upgrade to Stellarium Plus. With this upgrade, the app will display objects as faint as magnitude 22 (versus magnitude 8 in the base version) and enable advanced observing features.
Stellarium Plus features (unlocked with in-app purchase):
• Reach the limit of knowledge by diving in a massive collection of stars, nebulas, galaxies, star clusters and other deep sky objects:
  - All known stars: Gaia DR2 catalog of over 1.69 billion stars
  - All known planets, natural satellites and comets, and many other minor solar system objects (10k asteroids)
  - Most known deep sky objects: a combined catalog of over 2 million nebulas and galaxies
• Zoom almost without limits on high resolution images of deep sky objects or planetary surfaces.
• Observe in the field, even without internet connection, with a "reduced" set of data: 2 million stars, 2 million Deep Sky Objects, 10k asteroids.
• Control your telescope through WIFI: drive any GOTO telescope compatible with NexStar, SynScan or LX200 protocols.
• Prepare your observing sessions using the advanced observation tools, to predict a celestial object observability and transit times.
Stellarium Mobile is made by the original creator of Stellarium, the well known open source planetarium and one of the best astronomy applications on Desktop PC.
Your can unlock the full features using either a one time payment or a subscription. See In-App Purchase section for the subscription price available in your country. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your account settings after purchases.
Terms of service: https://stellarium-labs.com/stellarium-mobile-plus/stellarium-mobile-terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://www.stellarium-labs.com/privacy-policy-for-stellarium-mobile

Amerigo is an enhanced file manager that allows you to manage and organize local and cloud-saved files. 
It's the only APP that allows to link multiple cloud (DropBox, Google Drive, OneDrive, iCloud Files) and offers iOS Files app integra
bluejetty:00070139:ios.description:
Amerigo is an enhanced file manager that allows you to manage and organize local and cloud-saved files. 
It's the only APP that allows to link multiple cloud (DropBox, Google Drive, OneDrive, iCloud Files) and offers iOS Files app integration to download and upload to any cloud from any app!
For example if you receive an email, you can directly save the email attachments to one of the cloud linked in Amerigo, simply choosing "Save in files" in the action sheet.
Virtual folders allows to group files that come from different sources (cloud/local): you can for example have a virtual folder with all the files that belongs to a project but are stored on different cloud storage providers.
The Spotlight indexing of all local contents allows to immediately find and open the file you're looking for, without opening the app!
You can also add more than one account for each clouds to increase your space! 
The integrated PDF viewer with enhanced annotation capabilities, automatically recognize common shapes and gestures, and allows to highlight paragraph by drawing a line over it.
Main features: 
- iOS 11 Files app integration for ALL clouds linked to the app in read write mode.
- Spotlight indexing of all content in the app.
- Integration with the Dropbox, GDrive, OneDrive, iCloud services for remote file storage.
- Search between all contents in the app and in the linked cloud storages thanks to the advanced search 
- Compression (zip) and decompression (zip & rar) of any files. 
- PDF editor with annotation, free-hand writing.
- Support for all Microsoft Office files. 
- Simultaneous management of multiple Cloud accounts and management of folders shared with other users. 
- Enhanced bookmarks and history management. 
- URL autocomplete and search suggestions 
- Quick search bar, and enhanced search within all cloud and local files.
- File archive with folders and subfolders capabilities. 
- PIN to hide selected folders.
- Multi-tab fast internet browsing 
- Private browsing mode
Available as in-app subscription:
- No Ad & Ad Block for browsers: allows to stop advertising in the app, in the integrated browser and in Safari (by enabling the content block extension)
• Free 7 days trial and then renew for a period of a month
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
Terms of use (EULA) available at: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00153098:ios.description:
Athon App brings the timeless beauty of Orthodox Christianity into your daily rhythm, right in your pocket.
Whether you are discovering the faith, deepening your prayer life, or renewing your spiritual journey, Athon helps you live Orthodoxy with peace, structure, and devotion.
Athon is developed with the episcopal blessing of the Romanian Orthodox Church, through His Eminence Andrei, Archbishop and Metropolitan of Cluj.
The project is developed under the spiritual guidance of Father Iustin Miron, abbot of Nicula Monastery in Transylvania, and its content is reviewed by the theological committee of the Faculty of Orthodox Theology in Cluj.
From daily Scripture readings and fasting calendars to audio Bible studies, Commentaries from the Holy Church Fathers, prayers, and lives of the saints, every element is designed to guide you closer to Christ, at home, on the road, or before rest.
For catechumens, Athon becomes a gentle teacher and daily companion, helping you learn the rhythm of Orthodox life through readings, prayers, and reflections.
For the faithful, it is a source of depth and stillness, uniting tradition with modern simplicity.
And for those returning or newly baptized, Athon offers clarity, guidance, and the tools to grow into the fullness of the faith.
Athon App includes:
• Daily Orthodox Scripture readings and feast and fasting calendars
• Audio Bible studies and faith-based explanations
• Lives of over 900 saints
• A full offline Orthodox Bible
• A complete prayer book with audio
• AI-powered Orthodox Q&A
• A clean, reverent, and modern interface
All designed to bring prayer, presence, and understanding into your hands every day.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00095295:ios.description:
Become the Ultimate Pizza Tycoon! 
Dive into the delicious world of "My Pizza Shop Simulator Game" and build your dream food empire! Start with a humble pizza shop and rise to become the food business tycoon. Manage everything from making mouthwatering pizzas in this exciting cooking game to hiring skilled staff and expanding your chain across the states! Serve hungry customers at the counter and drive-thru game windows for double the fun and profits! 
Hire & Upgrade Employees: Build a dream team! Hire employees like waiters, cashiers, and cleaners, and upgrade shop skills for peak efficiency. 
Unlimited Expansion: Open stores! Expand into coffee game, burger game, and ice cream game shops and conquer the food empire! 
Upgrade Everything: Enhance your shop's interior, upgrade pizza machines, and boost staff skills for maximum profit in this restaurant management simulation.
Serve Diverse Customers: From regular diners to VIPs and drive-thru game orders, keep everyone satisfied!

Time Management: Juggle multiple tasks and prioritize orders to keep customers happy with excellent time management game skills.
Financial Planning: Track expenses, manage revenue, and make smart investments to grow your food business and become a food tycoon.
Customer Satisfaction: Deliver excellent service and handle customer feedback to build a loyal customer base in this cooking simulator. This business Food Tycoon of coffee game, burger game, and ice cream game shop is sure to provide hours of fun.

bluejetty:00092104:ios.description:

Direct messaging and unlimited job postings
Our custom AI job post tool makes it easy to post a job immediately
24/7 AI chat support and FAQ resources
No buy-out fees if you hire your temp permanently - saving you up to $6,000 in standard fees

bluejetty:00186402:ios.description:
From the creators of My Town comes a new dollhouse adventure called My Little Princess! 
Imagine a castle where your child can interact with just about everything. Making dinner and dressing up, decorating the terrance and throwing a party in the ballroom just for fun. It's like a digital dollhouse where you child can play, create and imagine a different adventure each time he plays.
Little Princess Castle comes with 12 rooms, lots of characters and a ton of clothing, accessories and props. All rooms are highly interactive and offer a variety of hotspots and activities that are both fun and creative.
Why Do Parents Like Our Games.
Little princess dollhouse game has everything kids love. First we don't have any rules in the game, what kid likes rules? The game is pure imaginative fun, your kids will have a blast playing with this amazing digital dollhouse set. Dressup the little princess and her family with lots of different clothing and costumes,Enjoy artistic and creative play elements. Guaranteed hours and hours of pure fun.
Game Features:
- Play alone or play together with friends and family on the same Device, multitouch is supported!
- Meet the little princess family and friends. From king dad and queen mom to the guards, the cook and even the witch.
- Huge castle with lots of rooms to explore and secrets to discover. Try tapping both unicorns at the castle's entrance. 
- Visit the kitchen and check out all the amazing foods you can make.
- Whats the use in having a ballroom if you can't throw a costume party for the royal family. Dressup, makeup and get ready for some fun!
- Check out the stained windows in the ballroom and royal bathroom. 
- Try digging for precious crystals, did you know you can turn it into magic potions?!
Recommended Age Group

bluejetty:00160470:ios.name: Swing Loops - Grapple Parkour
bluejetty:00160470:ios.summary:
Now try to name at least one of the parkour games – can you? Hardly you can! But not this time – check on your own why the game «Swing loops» will be your favorite …and sure unforgettable one!
► Your mind keeps turning in an endless loop.
bluejetty:00160470:ios.description:
Now try to name at least one of the parkour games – can you? Hardly you can! But not this time – check on your own why the game «Swing loops» will be your favorite …and sure unforgettable one!
► Your mind keeps turning in an endless loop.
Literally! Just close your eyes and imagine…A huge megalopolis, thousands of skyscrapers, even traffic jams (such a real game design, do not be that surprised!) and you are running right in the center of it. WOW! How do you feel about it? 
Not bad! And if we tell you that at some point of this race you are swinging and afterwards flying as a wild bird… What a crazy parkour game! 
Than you suddenly mention some more strange people around you. What are they doing here? Are they running towards the finish line. No way!
► Top-10 distinctive features of «Swing loops».
1. Gaming hierarchy: each level consists of 11 sublevels. You cannot be foxy and skip any of them to reach the next destination. Come on, be honest gamer. 
2. Every sublevel differs from others within one level in terms of its route and features that you can use on your way. No place for boredom.
3. The game includes the elements of competition: there will be other runners along with you. That is why it is called «race».
4. Different opportunities in the field of action: jump, fly, run, go, even stop – do whatever you want to become the first!
5. New stylish outfits. Hey, in our humble opinion, they are stylish! Tastes differ. 
6. Endless chances to start again. It is crucially necessary when you fall down from the 12-storey building. 
7. Respect to the classical stuff: golden keys, diamonds, money and other «must collect» things. It is not an old school, but just a piece of good tradition, you know… 
8. Highly realistic design of all locations: you can turn left or right and still observe the city around. It makes you feel inside the process for 100%. 
9. The unique opportunity to double, triple or more your gathered treasures. It is such an easy way to become a greedy person, so watch yourself!
10. By the way about treasures, in particular colorful crystals. They can be of great help for you in purchasing such things as clothes, tools for climbing, skateboards, wings and water boats. Shopping is available according to your level.
► Someone wise and ancient said that our life is a swing rope.
We are not Greek philosophers and thus we are not going to agree or disagree with this famous statement. However, the one thing we do know for sure: the more you play «Swing loops» the less mood swings you have! So download and stay happy all the time cause the game will not leave you a single chance to be sad!

bluejetty:00087486:ios.name: Psalm-A-Day
bluejetty:00087486:ios.summary:
Psalm-A-Day delivers a new Bible verse selection from the book of Psalms each day, it allows you to select a preferred translation and provides the ability to share your experience with friends. 
Preferred translations for Psalms Bible ver
bluejetty:00087486:ios.description:
Psalm-A-Day delivers a new Bible verse selection from the book of Psalms each day, it allows you to select a preferred translation and provides the ability to share your experience with friends. 
Preferred translations for Psalms Bible verses include: 
NET (New English Translation) 
NIV (New International Version) 
NKJV (New King James Version) 
NLT (New Living Translation) 
KJV (King James Version) 
Psalm-A-Day also provides the following features: 
-Reminder feature to enhance your daily devotional experience. You can configure Psalm-A-Day to display daily reminders at a time of your choosing to help you remain consistent in your daily reading. 
-Ability to view Psalms Bible verse selections from the past at your convenience (simply swipe left to right on the main verse screen to access past verses). 
-Occasional commentary is offered to engage you about a Psalms Bible verse selection. Commentary will be available at least 1-2 times per week. 
Now you can also bookmark Psalms Bible verses (and commentaries) that you really like so that you can review them again later. Plus your bookmarked verses/commentaries will automatically sync across all your iDevices through your iCloud account. The bookmarking feature can be purchased through the In-App Store. 
We hope that Psalm-A-Day serves as an encouragement to all toward a rich relationship with God.

bluejetty:00036443:ios.description:
* Ready to train your brain?
Toy Master 3D: Matching Triple is a free triple matching game suitable for all ages!
By finding & matching 3D objects in a limited time, you can power up your brain and speed up your reaction. Hundreds of 3D cute and unique objects are waiting for you!
HOW TO PLAY
- Pick up 3 identical objects from a pile of mixed-up items and match them all.
- Pay attention to the number of items in the tray, if it is full, the game is over.
- Use boosters to help you quickly finish the level if it is necessary.
- Try to match all 3D items within a limited time to reach higher levels and earn more rewards!
*TOP FEATURES*
- Over 1000 unique 3D objects: unlock new items after reaching higher levels.
- Powerful boosters to help you easily pass the level. You can pause the time, directly eliminate some items ...and so on!
- Easy to Play: Drag & Tap!
- Hard to Master: Pay attention, the level design is very challenging
Enjoy the puzzle collections of lovely animals, yummy fruits, interesting toys, exciting emojis, and more.
About Skylink Studio:
Toy Master 3D: Matching Triple is produced by Skylink Studio. Skylink is a top game studio of Puzzle Games and Casual Games. Skylink Studio published many top games: Merge Master - Elden Warrior, Merge Tower Defense 3D, Color Fill - Water Sort Puzzle, Final Giant Rush, Jewels Mix, Tangle Bridge Puzzle 3D, Pour Water - Sort Puzzle 3D, Ball Sort Puzzle and many more.

bluejetty:00044546:ios.description:
This is a sponsored program. You must be an eligible sponsored member to register for Healthy Savings.
Living healthy is now easier and more affordable with Healthy Savings. With the Healthy Savings mobile app, you can access your benefits anywhere, anytime. You can instantly redeem your benefits on qualifying products with a simple scan of your mobile app barcode or card at checkout. It’s that easy!
The Healthy Savings program provides members with access to exclusive savings on pre-qualified healthier food brands and other health-related items at participating stores. You can save up to $50 each week and in some cases may receive fresh produce discounts. Best of all, with Healthy Savings, there is no clipping, printing or downloading of coupons – all discounts are preloaded onto member accounts each week!
To view the benefits you are eligible for and how to shop, go to your program website. You can find your program website information in the welcome materials you receive in the mail.
With Healthy Savings, you can:
• Save on healthy food staples such as lean meats, whole grain bread, eggs, yogurt, milk, produce and more!
• Easily identify which foods are healthier. Only the healthiest 1/2 of items in a typical grocery store are promoted on the program. Foods are rated by the nationally renowned Guiding Stars® nutrition guidance system.
• Favorite the items you like on the mobile app to use as a shopping list while you’re at the store.
• Find participating stores to save.
• Update your account information.
Eligible plans may receive an additional benefits and rewards. Review your welcome materials or login to your program website for a full description of benefits and shopping options.

لا داعي لحمل جدولك الورقي أو تصويره ، مع تطبيق الجدول يمكنك تنسيق جدولك مجاناً وبكل سهولة والحصول على تنبيهات تفاعلية مع بداية أو نهاية الدرس.

اضف الويدجت Widgets على شاشة جوالك الرئيسية ومن خلال لمحة سريعة سوف تعرف موعد ومكان درسك/محاضرتك القادمة.

تطبيق الجدول مجاني بالكامل، لكن تستطيع الاستفادة من خيارات إضافية من خلال الاشتراك بالخدمات المدفوعة الجدول+

bluejetty:00042604:ios.description:
"The absolute best migraine app!" – Dr. Pulde, Harvard Medical School
Proven techniques from advanced headache clinics help you easily track the right information, and finally find your real triggers. Find your real triggers in weeks instead of years and make real progress reducing episodes. 
Finding triggers with this app has helped tens of thousands of users reduce or eliminate migraines.
This full-featured headache journal:
Helps you track quickly and see a clear log of your data. No endless tracking of questions that aren't relevant to you.
Finds your strongest trigger patterns based on the time between your trigger exposures and the start of your symptoms.
Helps you have better appointments with the #1 clinical report, according to the 2025 Survey of Clinical Neurologists.
Logging is easy and includes quickly tracking time of suspected triggers. Our patent-pending analysis uses your own unique dataset to pinpoint patterns based on the timing of events.
Designed by doctors, this app has helped tens of thousands of people identify triggers and finally solve the puzzle of what’s making them sick. Odds are, your doctor told you to find triggers. We built an app that helps you do it.
Health, location and barometric pressure auto-logging makes building your log easy. Some triggers take days to appear. Some only show up in combination. Our pattern finder sorts it all out and surfaces patterns that matter most to you.
Doctors love our migraine diary reports. You’ll love finally knowing your real triggers. Get started for free today.
---
FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS
All these great features to help you work better with your care team and make real progress.
Full-Featured Journal: ** Easiest. Tracking. Ever. (Get it just for this!) **
Both doctors and patients love our journal.
Track anything you want.
Record migraines in seconds. Come back later to fill in the details.
Automated tracking:
Weather and Barometer
Workouts
Steps
Sleep
Location (Do certain locations cause you to have more migraines? Our users LOVE this feature.)
Fully custom tracking:
We don't force you to track things you don't want to track.
Pattern Finder: Finally know your real migraine triggers.
Your records are there when you need them:
Clear records for your care team or at the ER.
Make better medication decisions with a clear log of past trials.
Integrates with iPhone Health App so you can pull in data you tracked with Fitbit, Oura, Apple Watch and more. If your iPhone tracks it into health, you can bring it into your log in Migraine Insight.
CHRONIC MIGRAINE 'PAIN LEVEL TRACKING' MODE
The app works great for all headache types. And, for people living with chronic migraine, there's a pain level mode to record pain levels instead of episodes.
This is a headache diary with real insights to help you get better faster.
Download and start tracking today for free.
Terms and Conditions - https://www.migraineinsight.com/tos/
Privacy Policy - https://www.migraineinsight.com/privacy-statement/

bluejetty:00128038:ios.description:
Earthquake+ keeps you informed when seismic and volcanic activity occurs.
See what’s happening around you and worldwide with fast, reliable data from over 30 trusted sources, including USGS, EMSC, and the Smithsonian Institution. Track earthquakes, tsunamis, and volcanic activity with powerful maps, alerts, and real-time updates.
===================================
FREE VERSION:
===================================
- Receive real-time earthquake alerts for up to 20 locations.
- See the latest earthquakes and volcanic activity worldwide and near you.
- View recent events, seismic time-lapses, and weekly summaries.
- Get real-time updates on volcanic eruptions.
- View current and historical tsunami bulletins on the map.
- Customise maps, alerts, lists, and filters.
- Set custom earthquake alert magnitudes to one decimal place.
- Explore earthquake history (since 2010) with tectonic and fault data.
- Save favourite events and search locations easily.
- Share updates via SMS, email, or Facebook.
- Access daily summaries through the Home or Today widget.
- Visualise data with multiple map layers.
- Customise alert sounds so you never miss an event.
- Stay informed about air travel disruptions from volcanic activity.
===================================
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION:
===================================
- Unlock advanced features for deeper insights and control
- Remove all advertisements
- Customise alerts with advanced filters and sound options
- View earthquakes in 3D with additional map layers
- Assess impact instantly with ShakeMap
- Track volcanic ash clouds in real time
- Create animations of earthquake activity
===================================
SUBSCRIPTION INFO:
===================================

Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your App Store account settings.
Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased.

bluejetty:00026964:ios.description:
Meet your personal tour guide in an app! Shaka Guide has 90+ audio tours across the country in places like Hawaii, Yellowstone National Park, Grand Teton, Yosemite, Sedona, Gettysburg, Salem, the Boston Freedom Trail, Utah's Mighty 5 and more.
HOW A GPS AUDIO TOUR WORKS 
The app uses GPS to play audio narration automatically as you drive or walk. Shaka Guide’s audio tours provide directions to must-see stops, stories about the places you’re visiting, travel tips, and local music. It's like having a personal tour guide along for the ride!
TOUR ON YOUR TERMS 
Upgrade your road trip on a GPS audio tour! With Shaka Guide, you’ll get the insights of a tour guide with the freedom to explore on your terms. Shaka Guide has planned the itinerary, picked the must-see stops, and has hours of stories to share. But, with Shaka Guide what you see and do is up to you – pick the stops you want and skip the ones you don’t. 
AUDIO TOUR GUIDE + OFFLINE MAP
So, what exactly is a GPS audio tour? Imagine you combined a travel guide, sightseeing app, and audio guide all in one - that’s a GPS audio tour! The app uses GPS to give you directions to popular sites with stories, music and travel tips (like bathroom and food stops) as you guide along on your travels. And, with a reliable offline map, the app still works when there’s no service. 
NEW YELLOWSTONE TOUR GUIDE 
Check out the NEW Yellowstone GPS audio Tour. Spend 1-7 days in Yellowstone National Park with your very own personal guide. The Yellowstone Tour has starting points at all of the park's entrances - just pick a section of the park, turn the app on, and explore. The Yellowstone Tour also works in multiple directions! The timing is perfect with detailed history lessons as you travel through Yellowstone National Park. Don't visit Yellowstone National Park without Shaka Guide's Yellowstone National Park GPS audio Tour!
HAWAII AUDIO TOUR GUIDE
Shaka Guide has the #1-rated travel apps for Maui, Oahu, Kauai, and Big Island. Stay just ahead of your Hawaii trip planning and visit spots like the Road to Hana on Maui, Oahu's Grand Circle Island, Volcanoes National Park on the Big Island, or Waimea Canyon in Kauai with a Shaka Guide GPS audio tour by your side!
MAUI AUDIO TOUR GUIDE
Shaka Guide is the highest-rated tour app in Maui and the Road to Hana. Explore Maui with 6 GPS audio Tours including Maui's most beloved road trip - the Classic Road to Hana. Other Maui Tours include Reverse Road to Hana, Loop Road to Hana, West Maui Coastline, and Sunrise and Sunset at Haleakala.
NATIONAL PARK AUDIO TOUR GUIDE
Visit America's top national parks with a GPS tour guide! Guide along on tours including Yellowstone National Park, Yosemite, Grand Teton, Hawaii Volcanoes, Shenandoah, Utah's Mighty 5, and more!
Bundle + Save - Get the Yellowstone National Park + Grand Teton Audio Tour Bundle for $23.99
AMERICA'S FAVORITE ROAD TRIPS - AUDIO TOUR GUIDE
The ultimate audio tour guide for scenic drives like the Road to Hana in Maui, Sedona, Lake Tahoe, and more! Also, check out day trips in Tuscon and Las Vegas. You'll seamlessly guide along these scenic road trips without missing any of the action. A tour guide by your side – it's that simple.

bluejetty:00122873:ios.description:
Khalti is Nepal’s most trusted digital wallet, now stronger and better through the merger of Khalti and IME Pay. This upgraded app combines IME’s trusted remittance legacy with Khalti’s digital innovation to offer a seamless and powerful experience.
More than just a payment app, Khalti stands for innovation, lifestyle, and reliability. It is designed to be inclusive, easy to use, and secure, helping you make everyday moments simpler and more meaningful.
Why the Merger?
We merged to give you a smarter, faster, and simpler wallet experience. IME Pay users can now access all Khalti features in one app, with a hassle-free migration of wallet balance, points, and transaction history. One login, one wallet, no stress.
New Features
Daami Points combine rewards from both Khalti and IME Pay into one system, so you earn more for every transaction. The Super Wallet lets you unlock new features and benefits the more you use the app. Plus, enjoy 3% interest on your wallet balance, helping your money grow while it stays safe. Smart Deposit, Nepal’s first wallet-based recurring deposit in partnership with Manjushree Finance where you can save a fixed amount regularly starting from Rs. 100 and earn good interest rates. Start Small, Dream Big!
Everything You Can Do
Top-Up & Recharge
Recharge NTC, Ncell and buy data packs
Buy recharge cards & Topup anywhere easily
Utility Bill Payments
Electricity (NEA, BPC, community providers)
Water, landline, cable TV (DishHome, Mero TV, NetTV, SimTV)
Internet bills (Worldlink, Subisu, Vianet, Classic Tech & more)
Flight Booking
Book domestic flights with real-time availability from airlines like Buddha, Yeti, Shree & more
Indrive Topup 
Drivers can do Indrive Topup easily from the App
Education Fees
Pay school and college fees directly from the app
Find your institute in our Smart Schools list
Government Services
Pay for Lok Sewa, IRD, DOFE, SSF, traffic fines, and more
File and renew company registrations (OCR), pay municipal taxes
Financial Services
Renew DEMAT/MeroShare
Pay insurance premiums (Nepal Life, Neco, Sanima, etc.)
Pay EMIs (Syakar, Hulas, MAW, Jeevan Bikas)
Credit card bill payments
Remittance
Receive money from abroad via WorldRemit, Remitly
Send/receive domestic transfers through City Express, Bhatbhateni, Nepal Remit & more
Khalti Bazaar
Shop in-app from brands like Cowmandu, The Village Café, Sparrow SMS & others
Scan & Pay with Khalti QR
Accepted at your local kirana pasal, restaurants, clinics, fashion stores & more
Bank Services
Transfer to any major bank in Nepal
Link your bank account with Khalti Bank Direct
Make direct payments from your linked bank
Send & Request Money
Send funds to friends and family or request money with a few taps
Coupons & Rewards
Apply Promcodes & Coupons at checkout to get instant cashback
Use Daami Points to unlock exciting rewards
Smart Deposit
Save regularly with Nepal’s first wallet-based recurring deposit
Choose your amount (Starting from 100 upto 5000), frequency (daily/weekly/monthly), and term (6–60 months)
Earn interest and build your saving habit with ease
KYC & Security
Upgrade your account with KYC for easy transactions and added security
Load Wallet Easily
Load via mobile/internet banking, debit/credit card, Khalti Pasal, Sewa Kendra, bank deposits & more
Ek Nepal. Ek App. Ek Wallet. Infinite Possibilities
Khalti is more than a digital wallet, it’s a movement to make finance easier, more accessible, and more rewarding. Whether you’re recharging your phone or saving for your future, Khalti is built to support you at every step.
Need Help or Have Suggestions?
We’d love to hear from you.
Email: support@khalti.com
Website: https://khalti.com
Blogs for more info: https://blog.khalti.com

bluejetty:00120559:ios.summary:
KidloLand Toddler Town Games is a fun educational app for preschool kids with 1000+ interactive games to play and learn easily. Begin your child's early learning journey with these exciting educational games!
KidloLand Toddler Town Games i
bluejetty:00120559:ios.description:
KidloLand Toddler Town Games is a fun educational app for preschool kids with 1000+ interactive games to play and learn easily. Begin your child's early learning journey with these exciting educational games!
KidloLand Toddler Town Games includes puzzles, popping bubbles, coloring, dot to dot, dress up, match the pairs, sorting, tracing games, and more. These games will boost their cognitive skills, hand-eye coordination, concentration, and imagination. You will be amazed to see how quickly your child learns different things.
These games are a great way for you to have some fun learning time with your child. Watch your toddler complete these fun games while learning at the same time. It is filled with cute, colorful graphics and funny animations that encourage your child to learn more!
Features of KidloLand Toddler Town Games are:
- Ideal For Preschool Kids
These games are ideal for kids in the preschool level (1-5 years). Kids will learn animals, numbers, shapes, colors and much more!
- Kid Friendly
All the games in this app are completely kid-friendly. Toddlers can play them easily.
- Different Categories
Choose from a wide range of game categories like Farm, Animals, Fun, Insects, Space, City, Marine, Vehicles and Birds.
- Available Offline & No Ads
These games can be played anytime and anywhere without internet. Completely ad-free.
- Cute Characters & Animations
Delight your kids with our cute and colorful characters and funny interactive animations.
The 'Free Games' section is completely free to play. The other categories can be unlocked via subscription.
Subscription Details:
- Subscribe to get access to full content including future updates: US $7.99/month or US $49.99/year.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Cancel subscription renewal anytime under Manage App Subscriptions in your iTunes Settings.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- The renewal cost will be same: US $7.99/month or US $49.99/year.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Use the subscription in any iPad/iPhone/iPod registered with your Apple account.
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
Privacy Policy: http://www.kidlo.com/privacypolicy.php
Terms of service: http://www.kidlo.com/terms_of_service.php
If you need help or have any feedback, email us at support@kidlo.com
Make your child's learning journey fun with KidloLand Toddler Town Games. Download now!

bluejetty:00021623:ios.summary: As a UR Medicine patient, you can use our MyURMedicine mobile app to access your MyChart, a free online tool, for UR Medicine patients, that gives you access to your medical record anytime, anywhere. The UR Medicine mobile app also helps yo
bluejetty:00021623:ios.description:
As a UR Medicine patient, you can use our MyURMedicine mobile app to access your MyChart, a free online tool, for UR Medicine patients, that gives you access to your medical record anytime, anywhere. The UR Medicine mobile app also helps you find and get directions to our hospitals, urgent care, imaging, and lab locations; view information on more than 1,300 of our specialists; and read up on the latest UR Medicine health and wellness information.
Using MyChart you can:
• View your test results, diagnoses, medications, and immunizations.
• Request appointments and prescription renewals.
• Send a message to your health care team.
• Organize all your medical information into one personal health record.
• View and pay your bill online.
• Upload health and fitness data, including data from the Apple Health app (when enrolled in self-tracking programs)
You need to have a MyChart account to access the MyChart features. 
For more information, visit mychart.urmc.edu, and click on “Sign Up (I don’t have access)" in the blue box to the left.

bluejetty:00159542:ios.description:
GQueues is the todo list and project manager built for Google Workspace. It lives inside the apps you already use — Gmail, Calendar, Drive — so your work stays organized without adding another system to check.
Simple and powerful, GQueues handles your daily to-do list, and it scales up to manage complex team projects without the setup overhead of enterprise project management tools.
WHY GQUEUES
• Rated 4.7+ by our users
• 15+ years of keeping work organized
• Deepest integrations with Google Workspace of any project and task manager
• Free to use, with paid plans when you're ready for more
ORGANIZE WORK AND PROJECTS
• Subtasks — break work into doable steps
• Recurring tasks — automate tracking for things that come back every day, week, or month
• Tags — organize your way and find anything in seconds
• Reminders — get notified for tasks with due dates
• Drag and drop ordering to prioritize at a glance
• Search across every queue, task, and note
PLAN YOUR DAY
• Block out time on your calendar to complete work
• See exactly what's due today, this week, or slipping overdue
• Smart Queues automatically gather what matters across all your projects
• Reschedule with a swipe when reality interferes with the plan

bluejetty:00085652:ios.summary:
Darkbox is your personal photo vault, locking away private photos and videos where only you can see them.

bluejetty:00085652:ios.description:
Darkbox is your personal photo vault, locking away private photos and videos where only you can see them.
Darkbox uses a triple- encryption technology which including password lock, Touch ID, album lock to protect private photos or videos. To make your app more private you can turn off Touch ID and change app icons. In addition, we have a powerful Cloud Storage function. With a 100G cloud storage space, you can save about 20,000 photos and videos, and protect your important information from being lost.
With Darkbox, your ultimate photo vault and absolutely secure private space, you will no longer have to worry about problems such as privacy being peeped at, lost files, insufficient storage space, etc.
ENCRYPTION FUNCTION
√ Use password lock to protect private photos, videos, GIFs
√ Customize to turn on/off Touch/Face ID
√ Single album lock which can offer double protection for your album
FAKE PASSWORD
√ When you enter the fake password, photo vault will open a completely different set of photos, keeping your real ones safe and hidden.
100G CLOUD STORAGE
√ Massive Cloud Storage space, items can be stored up to 20,000
√ Fast backup photos/video to the cloud, important data will never be lost
MANAGE YOUR ALBUM QUICKLY
√ Batch import photos & videos
√ Sort photos/videos by import date or created date automatically
√ Recover deleted photos & videos from Recently Deleted
BASIC FUNCTION
√ Customize album covers and personalized themes create your own personalized album
√ Slideshow viewing for photos with background music and different transactions which can offer your better viewing experience
√ Support sharing photos or videos to Darkbox from other apps
√ Universal Video Player to play almost all video formats: mov, mp4, mpv …
√ FaceDown Action: Flip the phone down to quickly switch to another app
√ Change app’s icon & theme as you like to make your privacy more private
√ Share photos & videos to all social media such as Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, etc
√ Integrated camera for taking photos & video directly within the app
√ Transfer photos/videos between Computer and Phone
If you are looking for a secure, reliable encrypted photo album app with mass storage space and simple user interface, Darkbox is your best choice.
FEEDBACK
If you have any questions or suggestions about photo vault, please feel free to contact us at support@imdarkbox.com and we will get back to you in time.
Darkbox PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
- Subscription fee will be charged according to different subscription plan which including VIP, SVIP and SSVIP.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Users can manage or unsubscribe in iTunes & App Store account management in the phone system settings.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto- renew is turned off at least 24- hours before the end of the period. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
- Free trial: Free trial (if any) will automatically renew the VIP version at $9.49/year upon expiration. You can go to the Account Settings to cancel the renewal before the trial ends. The current free trial will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to the premium version before the trial period ends.
Terms of Use: http://idarkbox.com/user- policy/index.html
Privacy Policy: http://idarkbox.com/privacy- policy/index.html

bluejetty:00186888:ios.description:
Join millions of families and discover BabyTV’s award-winning kids videos and nursery rhymes app, designed for little ones and 100% ad-free! BabyTV is the world’s leading TV channel for babies, toddlers and their parents, created to support preschool children in their early years. Our app offers quality kids’ videos in a safe, child-friendly environment, introducing your little one to the world around them with BabyTV’s beloved characters and educational content.
Age Rating
Perfect for toddlers and kids aged 5 & under, and BabyTV fans of all ages.
Kids Videos
Our app features hundreds of kids videos, including nursery rhymes, baby songs, and baby cartoon videos. Enjoy full episodes of BabyTV shows like "Charlie and the Numbers," "Billy Bam Bam," "The BabyTV Jungle Book," "Oliver," and more!
All-time Favorite Kids Songs & Nursery Rhymes
Enjoy all your favorite nursery rhymes and kids songs, such as "Morning Song," "Brother John," "Down by the Bay," and "Little Green Frog." Sing along with BabyTV’s top songs like "The Tiny Bunch," "ABC’s and 123’s," "Shapes Song with Charlie," and more.
Relaxing & Bedtime Content
Our bedtime series includes relaxing baby videos and songs to help your little ones sleep peacefully. Explore popular content such as "BabyTV Relaxing Videos," "BabyTV Songs for Sleep," and calming shows with soothing episodes your child will love.
Toddler Games & Fun Activities
Our app includes toddler games that introduce early concepts in a fun way. Help your child discover colors with Oliver, explore different animals with Lola, and recognize shapes and numbers with Charlie. Our games ensure your child is entertained while discovering new things.
Watch Offline
Download videos and watch offline at home or on the go!
Create Your Own Playlist
Quickly and easily create a playlist with your child's favorite episodes and songs for quick access. Use shuffle mode to enjoy a variety of content.
Why BabyTV is Great for Kids Ages 5 & Under:
- 100% ad-free, kid-safe environment
- Created with experts for quality kids videos and content
- Download videos to watch offline
- Hours of fun episodes, baby songs, and relaxing bedtime content
- Trusted characters and cartoons suitable for all ages
- New content added weekly
- Available in 15 languages (English, Spanish, Mandarin, Dutch, Polish, French & more)
Subscription
This service is offered as a renewed paid subscription over these plans:
Monthly Subscription - $5.99
6 Month Subscription - $29.99 (Save 1 Month!)
12 Month Subscription - $59.99 (Save 2 Months!)
Privacy & Safety
Your child’s privacy and safety is our top priority. That’s why there are no ads in our toddler & preschool kids’ TV app or on our channel. We will never share your personal information with 3rd parties or sell it. For more information, visit https://www.babytv.com/privacy-policy.
Terms of Use - https://www.babytv.com/termsofuse/

bluejetty:00070254:ios.description:
Did you like our Match 3D game? Where can you match pairs together to clear the screen and win the level?
Lion Studios is happy to announce our new triple pair matching 3D Tile Puzzle Game. We are excited to give you Match Tile 3D.
Match Tile 3D is an easy to learn and fun to play puzzle game.
This Game is designed to relax all your muscles, release your daily stress, and increase your memorization abilities. All of that while playing a fun and easy to play pair matching puzzle game.
How To Play Match Tile 3D:
Tap on three tiles that look the same and connect them into triples.
Keep doing that until you clear all tiles from the screen.
Keep having fun, start new levels and become a 3D puzzle master.
The Game has many different triple sets of 3D objects that are designed to be easy to memorize.
We have a lot of fabulous levels, including;
Cute animals
Sweet yummy food
Cool toys
Exciting emojis
 Surprising new shiny objects every week, all free.
Features
Relaxing game design & unique 3D objects to connect
Match Tile 3D is a game designed with your well-being in mind. 
With many fun & cute relaxing 3D objects, each level is more interesting than the one before. In each level, the difficulty of triples and the number of tiles also slightly increases to keep your brain challenged.
Well-designed brain trainer levels that help you to challenge yourself
Match Tile 3D will make it easier for you to memorize objects & details by playing our brain trainer levels. You will start to notice your memorizing abilities becoming better with time and that you master to solve challenging puzzles very fast.
Ready to play?
Start with the play button and complete the first tutorial level, which takes 10 seconds to teach you how to connect tiles into triples.
Try then to connect all sets of tiles to pass the first puzzle.
After completing the level, challenge yourself against the time and improve your matching skills. Over time you will master memorizing 3D tiles and objects while having lots of fun.

and dash through colorful environments. Perfect for fans of endless runners, action-packed 
arcade games, or anyone looking for quick, exciting gameplay. 
Run wild, dash fast, and have fun in Wildstride: Animal Run Fun – your next favorite endless 
runner adventure

bluejetty:00180431:ios.name: Rustavi Transport
bluejetty:00180431:ios.summary: Rustavi Transport is your all-in-one solution for navigating the city streets with ease. Whether you're a daily passenger or an occasional traveler, this app is designed to simplify your public transport experience like never before. With a
bluejetty:00180431:ios.description:
Rustavi Transport is your all-in-one solution for navigating the city streets with ease. Whether you're a daily passenger or an occasional traveler, this app is designed to simplify your public transport experience like never before. With a host of powerful features at your fingertips, getting around town has never been easier.
Plan Your Ride
Easily plan your trip around the city with our intuitive route planner. Simply select your starting point and destination on the map, and let Rustavi Transport take care of the rest. Now, you can plan your route by entering your starting and ending addresses within the city. Rustavi Transport offers the most optimal routes, considering various transport options, travel times, and your preferences.
Experience the Next Evolution: Real-Time Route Planning!
Unlock the Future of Transportation with Route Real-Time Alternatives! With our latest update, all transport data is calculated in real-time, ensuring precise route planning every time. Say goodbye to guesswork and hello to confidence as you navigate the city with precision
Live Bus Stop Arrivals
Stay ahead of your schedule with real-time arrival updates for stops. Whether you're waiting for a bus or minibus, Rustavi Transport keeps you informed, minimizing wait times and maximizing efficiency. Save time and effort by marking your favorite stops for quick and easy access. Whether it's your local bus stop or the station nearest to your workplace, Rustavi Transport ensures your most frequented locations are always within reach.
Comprehensive Schedules
Access detailed timetables for Buses at any time, allowing you to accurately plan your day. Whether you're heading to work, school, or a night out, Rustavi Transport keeps you informed and prepared for the journey ahead.
Mobility Payments
Rustavi Transport integrates QR code payment functionality, allowing users to purchase tickets and pay for fares across all transport modes directly from their smartphones. Simply add funds to your account, buy a ticket from the app, and scan the displayed QR code when boarding buses. This streamlined process is quick, efficient, and eliminates the need for physical tickets or cash transactions.
Download Rustavi Transport today and embark on a journey of convenience, reliability, and efficiency. Whether you're a experienced commuter or a first-time traveler, let Rustavi Transport be your trusted companion for all your public transport needs.

bluejetty:00061407:ios.name: Microsoft Teams
bluejetty:00061407:ios.summary: Whether you’re connecting with your community for an upcoming activity or working with teammates on a project, Microsoft Teams helps bring people together so that they can get things done. It’s the only app that has communities, events, cha
bluejetty:00061407:ios.description:
Whether you’re connecting with your community for an upcoming activity or working with teammates on a project, Microsoft Teams helps bring people together so that they can get things done. It’s the only app that has communities, events, chats, channels, meetings, storage, tasks, and calendars in one place—so you can easily connect and manage access to information. Get your community, family, friends, or workmates together to accomplish tasks, share ideas, and make plans. Join audio and video calls in a secure setting, collaborate in documents, and store files and photos with built-in cloud storage. You can do it all in Microsoft Teams. 
Easily connect with anyone: 
• Skype is now part of Teams. Continue where you left off with your chats, calls and contacts in Microsoft Teams Free. 
• Meet securely with communities, teammates, family, or friends.
• Set up a meeting within seconds and invite anyone by sharing a link or calendar invite. 
• Chat 1-1 or to your entire community, @mention people in chats to get their attention. 
• Create a dedicated community to discuss specific topics and make plans*.
• Work closely and collaborate by keeping conversations organized by specific topics and projects with teams and channels.
• Video or audio call anyone directly in Teams or instantly convert a group chat to a call. 
• Use GIFs, emojis, and message animations to express yourself when words aren’t enough.
Accomplish plans and projects together: 
• Send photos and videos in chats to quickly and easily share important moments.
• Use cloud storage to access shared documents and files on the go. 
• Organize shared content in a community — events, photos, links, files —so you don’t have to waste time searching*. 
• Get the most out of your meetings by using screen share, whiteboard, or breakout in virtual rooms.
• Manage access to information and ensure the right people have access to the right info, even when people join and leave projects.
• Use task lists to stay on top of projects and plans - assign tasks, set due dates, and cross off items to keep everyone on the same page. 
Designed to give you peace of mind: 
• Securely collaborate with others while maintaining control over your data.
• Keep communities safe by allowing owners to remove inappropriate content or members*.
• Enterprise-level security and compliance you expect from Microsoft 365**. 
*Available when using Microsoft Teams with your Microsoft account.
**Commercial features of this app require a paid Microsoft 365 commercial subscription or a trial subscription of Microsoft Teams for work. If you’re not sure about your company’s subscription or the services you have access to, visit Office.com/Teams to learn more or contact your IT department. 
By downloading Teams, you agree to the license (see aka.ms/eulateamsmobile) and privacy terms (see aka.ms/privacy). For support or feedback, email us at mtiosapp@microsoft.com. EU Contract Summary: aka.ms/EUContractSummary

bluejetty:00022193:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the rich history and vibrant culture of Ireland's capital with the "Dublin Travel Guide," your essential companion to exploring the heart of Dublin. From the historic halls of Trinity College to the lively pubs of Temple Bar, our app is designed to make your Dublin experience seamless and unforgettable. With augmented reality, offline maps, and comprehensive guides to public transportation, including Dublin's Luas and bus networks, navigating the cobbled streets of this storied city is easier than ever.
Unveil the best of Dublin with crisp HD photos and insider tips that lead you to the city's unparalleled experiences and activities. Our app ensures you don't miss out on Dublin's must-see attractions, whether you're savoring a pint of Guinness at its famed brewery, wandering through the medieval Dublin Castle, or tracing the steps of literary giants like James Joyce. Safety suggestions and a customizable travel itinerary allow you to explore Dublin with peace of mind, while our extensive touristic information introduces you to scenic spots just outside the city, like the serene Howth Head and the ancient ruins of Glendalough.
The "Dublin Travel Guide" app is your portal to the best tours, activities, and experiences Dublin has to offer. Delve into the city's rich tapestry of history, art, and music. Whether you're exploring the treasures of the National Museum of Ireland, attending a traditional music session in a local pub, or enjoying the green expanse of Phoenix Park, our app is with you every step of the way.
Our offline features mean that all the information you need is readily available, even without an internet connection. The augmented reality function transforms your exploration of Dublin, offering an interactive and immersive way to discover the city's charms.
Kickstart your Dublin adventure with the "Dublin Travel Guide" app. Ideal for history buffs, cultural connoisseurs, and everyone in between, our app invites you to experience the unique spirit and friendly welcome of Dublin. Download now and begin planning your ultimate Dublin journey. Experience the city's legendary hospitality, historic landmarks, and lively cultural scene with the best guide to Dublin. Let the Dublin Travel Guide app be your key to unlocking the magic of the Irish capital.

bluejetty:00163956:ios.description:

**Comprehensive Language Courses:
Immerse yourself in engaging language courses, meticulously designed to mimic real-life scenarios.Elevate your fluency and cultural understanding with each course.
