Have an AI-driven speaking assistant at your disposal. Personalized guidance, instant AI conversation, tailored lesson plans, and real-time feedback to help you reach your language learning goals efficiently.

Engaging in this variety of scenarios, from ordering a meal in a bustling cafe to strategizing travel plans, acing IELTS and TOEFL exams, and excelling in a professional workplace, is meticulously crafted to enhance your language proficiency and equip you for success in diverse real-life situations.

bluejetty:00092678:ios.description:
We know that you know the right way to play Spades but sometimes your friend plays a little suspect. No matter what rules you play by, Bookbag has you covered. No pen? No problem. Still using a pen? Problem. Please join us in this 21st century so we can show them how to get all the books in the bag, with Bookbag.
Tournaments (New beta!)
Multiple teams, one folding table, zero notepads. Build a bracket, add your teams, and use Bookbag to run your local tournaments. Choose from single elimination, double elimination, round robin, or group stage matchups. Help us build the future of hosting tournaments by reaching out with any feedback.
Rulesets
With over a dozen configuration options like score limit, nil bidding & more, you’ve just found your second partner. Hope there’s room at the table! Going to play somewhere else? Save and load anyone’s house rules with just a tap. Are we missing a rule? Contact us with feedback any time.
Scoring
Don’t risk miscalculation in front of other players. We’ve seen what can happen when auntie forgets how to carry the one. Based on your selected rules, Bookbag will automatically calculate the score for you after both teams have placed their books. 2 plus 2 is 4, minus 1 that's 3, quick maths.
Learn
Whether you’re schooling a beginner or just brushing up on your own skills, Bookbag’s got your back. Dive into our Learn section to master the game with a breakdown of the rules, strategies, and even some pro tips to make sure no one is trying to slip past the official playbook.
History
Keep track of games in progress as well as finished games on the history page. After a game is finished, generate a game summary to share with everyone involved. Also tell Tiffany she lost by 50 points last year on March 3rd. She forgot.
TV
You know Granny can’t see what you’re doing on that cellular phone. Give everyone involved a little more confidence by showing the scoreboard on the TV with Chromecast. A phone is for making calls... and scoring books.
Find us on social media @bookbagspades or https://bookbagspades.com/
Pst, before you go, hit that install button. I wanna see something...
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://bookbagspades.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00073541:ios.summary:
Thanks to everyone for making MyRadar so successful, with over 50 million downloads!
MyRadar is a fast, powerful, easy-to-use weather app that displays animated weather radar around your current location and to quickly show what weather is
bluejetty:00073541:ios.description:
Thanks to everyone for making MyRadar so successful, with over 50 million downloads!
MyRadar is a fast, powerful, easy-to-use weather app that displays animated weather radar around your current location and to quickly show what weather is coming your way. Just start the app; your location pops up with animated live radar, with radar loop lengths of up to two hours. This basic functionality provides the quickest way to get a snapshot of the weather on-the-go, and it's what has made MyRadar so successful over the years. Check your phone and get an instant assessment of the weather that will impact your day.
One of the most useful features in MyRadar is the ability to provide advanced rain alerts; our patent-pending process for predicting hyper-local rainfall is the most accurate in the industry. Instead of having to check the app all the time, MyRadar will send you an alert up to an hour in advance as to when the rain will arrive at your current location, down to the minute, including details on intensity and duration. These alerts can be a life saver when you're on-the-go and don't always have time to check the weather - our systems will proactively do the work for you and let you know in advance before the rain hits.
In addition to the live radar, MyRadar has an ever-increasing list of weather and environmentally-related data layers that you can overlay on top of the map; our animated winds layer shows a breathtaking visual representation of both surface winds and winds at the jetstream level; the frontal boundaries layer shows high and low pressure systems as well as frontal boundaries themselves; the earthquakes layer is a great way to stay on top of the latest reports on seismic activity, completely customizable as to severity and time; our hurricane layer allows users to stay on top of the latest tropical storm and hurricane activity throughout the world; the aviation layer overlays AIRMETs, SIGMETs and other aviation-related data, including the ability to track flights and display their IFR flight plans and paths, and the "wildfires" layer allows users to stay abreast of the latest fire activity around the United States.
MyRadar also has the ability to send weather and environmental alerts, including alerts from the National Weather Service, such as Tornado and Severe Weather alerts. A new feature introduced in this version of MyRadar includes the ability to receive alerts based off of Tropical Storm and Hurricane activity; you can configure the app to send you an alert any time a tropical storm or hurricane forms, or is upgraded or downgraded.
In addition to the free features of the app, additional upgrades are available, including real-time hurricane tracking - great for the start of hurricane season. The hurricane tracker provides additional data above and beyond the free version, including the cone of probability for tropical storm/hurricane forecast tracks, and it also includes a detailed synopsis from the National Hurricane Center. The premium upgrades also include the professional radar pack, which allows greater detail of radar from individual stations. Users can select individual radar stations around the US, select the radar tilt angle, and also change the radar product being displayed, including base reflectivity and wind velocity - great for experienced weather buffs looks to stay on top of possible tornado formation.
Download MyRadar today and try it out!
* Aviation Charts subscription (not required in order to use MyRadar) ($24.99 USD per YEAR)
* Payments will be charged to your iTunes account
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
* Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase.
MyRadar's Privacy Policy, visit: https://myradar.com/privacy
Full terms of service: https://myradar.com/terms

bluejetty:00183621:ios.description:
Settle group expenses without the stress.
Tired of messy IOUs, awkward money talks, and complex math after a trip or shared dinner? 
Settle Up is the smartest way to track shared expenses and manage "who owes whom" instantly. From simple bill splitting to complex multi-currency adventures, we handle the heavy lifting so you can focus on the fun.
Perfect for travelers, roommates, couples, event organizers, and friends. Join over 2.5 million users who have simplified their shared finances!
WHY SETTLE UP?
– Split anything: Whether it’s an even split, unequal weights, or multiple people paying for one item, we handle every real-life scenario.
– Smart settlements: Our unique algorithm calculates the fewest possible transfers to settle all debts, saving you time and transaction fees.
– Works everywhere: Sync data across other platforms. No internet? No problem — it works offline and syncs when you’re back.
– No app required: Share a group link so friends can view the balance in their browser without downloading anything.
POWERFUL FEATURES FOR REAL LIFE
– Global ready: Supports all currencies with real-time exchange rates for international travel.
– Ultra-fast sharing: Invite friends via a simple link or a QR code.
– Export & reports: Need a deep dive? Export your data to CSV for easy accounting.
– Instant transparency: Get notified the second someone adds an expense or settles up. Settle Up will even remind group members automatically and nudge them to settle their debts.
UPGRADE TO PREMIUM FOR THE FULL EXPERIENCE
Unlock the tools designed for power users and frequent travelers:
– Ad-free: Focus on your finances without distractions.
– Receipt photos: Snap and store bills directly in the group.
– Recurring & future expenses: Automate rent, subscriptions, and utility bills.
– Custom categories: Organize your spending with colorful, personalized labels.
– Export to Excel: Get a full expense report in a spreadsheet.
– Statistics: View charts on spend by categories and members.
Stop worrying about the math. Start enjoying the moment.
Download Settle Up today and sail through your next group expense!
Visit our Terms of Service and Privacy policy at: https://settleup.io/tos.html

bluejetty:00073124:ios.description:
Here is a castle full of secrets.
Play more than 3,000 puzzle stages 
Packed with special blocks and magic blocks with jewels. 
In the secret castle, lives a queen who is full of love but has lost her smile.
Some of the earlier stages will instantly be cleared 
when you align three of the same blocks. 
Not having fun? The puzzles are increasingly difficult but interesting.
We present the best puzzle game to you, who is always lovely.

[How to Play]
Match more than 3 of the same jewels horizontally or vertically.
Use items to break through difficulties.
[Game Features]
No hearts required, free game for life. 
Internet connection is not required to play.
Dynamic puzzle game with more than 3,000 stages.
[Note]
1. When changing to a new device, save the game progress by pressing Run Game - Setting - Save, then open the game on a new device by loading the save game through Run Game - Setting - Load. 
2. It is a free game but includes paid items. (ad removal, coins, items)
3. The game includes banner, front, and reward advertisements.

bluejetty:00186079:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch into your FAVORITE teacher of Vietnamese.
◆ The most essential words and phrases of the language, each with native speaker audio. 
◆ Master your accent with the Speech Studio. Simply record yourself saying a phrase and then hear your voice next to the teacher’s. You’ll be AMAZED how quickly your foreign accent melts away.
◆ All audio is downloaded to the device and accessible even in airplane mode or without expensive international roaming fees.
◆ Nemo is NOT BUILT AROUND LESSONS at all. It is meant to be picked up and put down throughout the day, whenever you have a few minutes to spare.
◆ Builds a foundation of Vietnamese empowering you to speak CONFIDENTLY in EVERYDAY CONVERSATIONS. 
◆ NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE of Vietnamese required.
Nemo® is specially DESIGNED to tap the remarkable power of your mobile device, and your brain, to their fullest. 
PERSONALIZED FOR YOU
Nemo is your personal trainer, tracking your PROGRESS across every single word and phrase.
◆ Practice Vietnamese the way you'll use it. Nemo is fully customizable.
◆ Nemo immerses you in the sounds of Vietnamese so you naturally speak with ease.
◆ Dive into WHAT YOU WANT to learn at any time.
◆ You control which words to practice – skip words you don’t want to learn or already know.
◆ Turn on Review Mode to study what you practiced earlier in the day to BOOST your memory retention.
◆ Hear English descriptions of all words, in a flashcard format.
◆ Quiz your mastery of the vocabulary.
◆ Nemo introduces words to you progressively to develop familiarity and reviews them at the right moment so they enter your LONG TERM MEMORY.
TARGET THE MOST COMMON WORDS
Maximize your time investment by targeting the most basic and high frequency words of the language.
Upgrade to the complete version to:
◆ Get off the beaten path or find comfort with DIRECTIONS, TRAVEL and HOTEL phrases.
◆ Decode menus with the most common FOOD words.
◆ Shop and find bargains like an insider with must-know SHOPPING phrases.
◆ Learn words useful for your time in vietnam.
◆ Build your proficiency with the most important verbs and SENTENCE BUILDING BLOCKS in Vietnamese.
◆ Spark new friendships with COMPLIMENTS and CONVERSATION STARTERS.
Use your new skills to make friends, impress old friends, bring smiles to children, get out of jams, experience new things, speak confidently, and make your travel and cultural experience more rich and fulfilling.
Download this FREE app now!

bluejetty:00185193:ios.description:
These recordings were locked away and were meant to be viewed by Barry only for reference and archival purposes. Until now!
Hi Everyone. Barry here.
Since the days of going on those long tours are coming to a close, I thought this might be a good time to remind you all about ManilowTV.
I think many of you know that ever since I started performing I have hit the "record" button; be it audio or video. Recordings of every show I've ever done are in a big vault. (Right next to my baby shoes and the Copacabana jacket!).
All of these recordings were meant only for reference and archival purposes. I would look at the shows each night after a concert, make notes, and give them to the staff so that we could tighten the show or change things.
But watching them brings back so many great memories! I know you will enjoy seeing them.
That's what ManilowTV is all about.
Each month for the past six years, Marc and I have looked through hundreds of video tapes and DVD's and picked a performance that we think you would enjoy and have shown it on ManilowTV.
Even though some of the shows were recorded on one camera and the video and audio is not professional network quality, I think they are very exciting. I think you will too.
These shows bring back such great memories. Big laughs, some tears and such talent! Lady Flash! Big bands, small bands, choirs! England! Germany! Australia! Japan! So many American cities!
You'll see it all on ManilowTV.
I hope you check it out.
And keep the Kleenex nearby.
Love,
Barry
With this subscription, you will receive:
• Access to five concerts every month, handpicked by Barry, straight from his own personal archive.
• Automatically beam videos from your phone to your Chromecast or AirPlay enabled devices
• Comment on videos with the rest of the community
• For existing subscribers, you can simply sign in to your account to get access. No need to resubscribe.
• No Internet required! Sync videos to watch offline, or connect with WiFi, 3G and 4G
• Pick up where you left off, no problem
• Tell your friends about your favorite videos with Twitter, Facebook, texts, and email, right in the app
To access all features and content you can subscribe to ManilowTV on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Privacy Policy: http://www.manilowtv.com/privacy
Terms of Service: http://www.manilowtv.com/tos

These recordings were locked away and were meant to be viewed by Barry only for reference and archival purposes. Until now!

Hi Everyone. Barry here.

Since the days of going on those long tours are coming to a close, I thought this might be a good time to remind you all about ManilowTV.

I think many of you know that ever since I started performing I have hit the "record" button; be it audio or video. Recordings of every show I've ever done are in a big vault. (Right next to my baby shoes and the Copacabana jacket!).

All of these recordings were meant only for reference and archival purposes. I would look at the shows each night after a concert, make notes, and give them to the staff so that we could tighten the show or change things.

But watching them brings back so many great memories! I know you will enjoy seeing them.

That's what ManilowTV is all about.

Each month for the past six years, Marc and I have looked through hundreds of video tapes and DVD's and picked a performance that we think you would enjoy and have shown it on ManilowTV.

Even though some of the shows were recorded on one camera and the video and audio is not professional network quality, I think they are very exciting. I think you will too.

These shows bring back such great memories. Big laughs, some tears and such talent! Lady Flash! Big bands, small bands, choirs! England! Germany! Australia! Japan! So many American cities!

You'll see it all on ManilowTV.

I hope you check it out.

And keep the Kleenex nearby.

Love,
Barry

With this subscription, you will receive:
• Access to five concerts every month, handpicked by Barry, straight from his own personal archive.
• Automatically beam videos from your phone to your Chromecast or AirPlay enabled devices
• Comment on videos with the rest of the community
• For existing subscribers, you can simply sign in to your account to get access. No need to resubscribe.
• No Internet required! Sync videos to watch offline, or connect with WiFi, 3G and 4G
• Pick up where you left off, no problem
• Tell your friends about your favorite videos with Twitter, Facebook, texts, and email, right in the app

To access all features and content you can subscribe to ManilowTV on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.

* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.

Privacy Policy: http://www.manilowtv.com/privacy
Terms of Service: http://www.manilowtv.com/tos

bluejetty:00023324:ios.name: Family Hotel: Home Renovation
bluejetty:00023324:ios.summary:
Family Hotel: a plot-driven match-3 game with new mechanics, memorable characters and  exciting side-quests. Build a hotel of your dreams and enjoy romantic story happening in front  of your eyes!    
Enter the world of Family H
bluejetty:00023324:ios.description:
Family Hotel: a plot-driven match-3 game with new mechanics, memorable characters and  exciting side-quests. Build a hotel of your dreams and enjoy romantic story happening in front  of your eyes!    
Enter the world of Family Hotel, the latest romance-based match-3 puzzle game!   
You are going to turn a run-down countryside manor into the high class family inn. Play match-3  to clear the rubble and let your imagination flow as you start the building restoration and bring it  back to its former glory. Enjoy your new hotel life!    
Work alongside Emily and Max, the unusual duo behind the Family Hotel. When the  co-managers first meet, it seems unlikely they’ll stand long enough to turn their vision into  reality. As they join their forces and cooperate, though, the two realize just how much in common they have. They develop a one of a kind mansion design that could make them  famous.    
Together, they’ll be able to build, furnish and customize each of the hotel’s rooms. Replace the  worn-out fountain, add new unique decors and features, and prepare your new fun hotel to  welcome hundreds of visiting guests. They will all have quests that you can help them complete  for additional rewards!    
Learn more about each of the characters in the game. Discover the details of Emily’s past and  uncover the mystery that surrounds Max’s family. Chat with your patrons in the lobby and delve  into one of the richest plots a match-3 game has ever had!    
Will your project grow into a thriving business or spiral out of control and crash to the ground? Will you be able to renovate a hotel or the whole idea is a failure? Is love in the air for the two  protagonists or will they fight until they split? The future of Family Hotel is entirely in your  hands!    
Here is what makes our hotel simulator game unique:  
• Refreshing match-3 gameplay with dynamic combos, romance and mind-blowing power ups.  
• Meaningful romantic choices that actively influence the campaign.  
• A mysterious duo of protagonists whose future and fate you’ll be able to shape.  
• Exciting side-quests, hotel stories and mini-games that will keep you glued to your phone.  
• Opportunity to furnish hotel and decorate it just the way you want.  
• An entire mansion to explore, restore and decorate as you see fit.    
Enjoy the hotel adventures with our fantastic match-3 building game!

bluejetty:00128747:ios.summary:
Race to the top and become the best kart racer in BOOM KARTS - a fast paced online multiplayer PVP racing game!
REAL TIME ARCADE MULTIPLAYER RACING!

bluejetty:00128747:ios.description:
Race to the top and become the best kart racer in BOOM KARTS - a fast paced online multiplayer PVP racing game!
REAL TIME ARCADE MULTIPLAYER RACING!
Enter the world of Boom Karts and battle it out online against your friends and players from all around the world! Get behind the wheel and race around a variety of tracks in this arcade karting game. The races are in real time so you will always be right in the frantic action!
DRIFT, BOOST & WIN!
Master the art of drifting to become a pro racer! Charge up your nitro tanks by maintaining a long drift and activate a nitro boost that blasts you ahead of the competition. 
TEAM RACING!
Create or join a racing team with your friends. Create custom races, request or share upgrade parts, chat with your friends and much more! Blast your way to be the best team online!
POWER UP YOUR GAME
Perfect driving is not enough - take out the competition with a wide arsenal of bombs, soap bars, chili peppers and other crazy weapons and power-up items. Discover layer upon layer of playstyles and countermoves as you find new creative ways to ruin someone's race.
CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS IN PVP MODE
Create your own custom lobbies where you can pit your skills against your friends in frantic PVP kart races. In Boom Karts, you have control over your custom games. Easily create your lobby and choose which track you race on, how many laps, the amount of players and even which power ups will show up during the race! Take your karting to the next level!
CUSTOMIZABLE KARTS AND AVATARS!
Create your own racer style by using a combination of outfits, accessories and kart skins. Choose from helmets, hats, t-shirts or a variety of other accessories to make your avatar stand out from the crowd then pick your favourite kart skin to race in. Unlock even more just by playing the game and opening chests. Find the driver style that suits you!
COLLECT & UNLOCK A VARIETY OF DIFFERENT KARTS!
Collect blueprints to unlock new karts for you to race in! Each kart you unlock has different stats and upgrades. Which kart will be perfect for your driving style? Find your favourite kart!
GAME FEATURES
• ONLINE ARCADE PVP RACES! - Race in real time against players from all around the world!
• TEAMS - Create or join a racing team!
• UPGRADABLE PARTS! – Upgrade a variety of unique parts for your kart! Some upgrades will have unexpected surprises!
• CUSTOMIZATION! - Choose how your kart and racing avatar appear, pick from a wide range of combinations of clothes/colours and accessories. Drive your way!
• FAST PACED! - Quick races allow you to pick up and play instantly; get your thrill of speed at any moment with quick matchmaking!
• POWER UPS! - Boost yourself or hinder your opponents with a wide variety of fun power ups that can turn the tide of races!
• UNLOCKABLES – Unlock new driver customizations and find blueprints to unlock new karts to upgrade and drive! How will your driver look and which kart will you choose to drive?
• CHALLENGES - Need to test yourself? Race on the challenge tracks where you beat the clock, race against a ghost or be challenged to drift over a 1000m!
Ready... Set... BOOM!
Boom Karts is a free-to-play online kart racing game where speed is the goal! Beat your opponents to the podium or tackle the challenges to earn your bragging rights. Challenge your friends in online multiplayer games with custom lobbies. Upgrade and customize your karts and avatar with items earned through game play. If you have any issues or need any assistance then please email our support team at: https://www.fingersoft.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/BoomKarts/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/BoomKarts
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/boom.karts/
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/fingersoft
Terms of Use: https://fingersoft.com/eula-web/
Privacy Policy: https://fingersoft.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00023603:ios.description:
Classic Solitaire meets MONOPOLY in this new FREE mash-up brought to you by Hasbro and the original creators of Solitaire! Now is your chance to play these two classic games for FREE and become a MONOPOLY millionaire. Easy to play but impossible to put down, MONOPOLY Solitaire is a relaxing card game with an exciting board game twist. 
MobilityWare and Hasbro have teamed and created MONOPOLY Solitaire. MONOPOLY Solitaire combines the property collecting, timeless fun players know and love of MONOPOLY with Mobilityware’s classic Solitaire gameplay
Earn MONOPOLY Points and roll the dice as you play each solitaire hand. Work your way along Mayfair, collecting properties, building houses and hotels as you go. You’ll use your hard-earned cash from playing your best solitaire game! Puzzle your way through each solitaire challenge to earn more rolls and get ahead of your opponents. Collect rent from all your properties and ace the game by being the best, richest landlord in Mayfair!
Play free classic solitaire and the MONOPOLY board game in a way you’ve never experienced before and build your MONOPOLY empire! Enjoy one of the most iconic board games from Hasbro coupled with the most popular classic solitaire card game from MobilityWare. Are you ready to challenge yourself and become the best, richest landlord in the world of MONOPOLY? Join us and download MONOPOLY Solitaire for FREE today!
Game Features:
-Enjoy all your favourites from the classic MONOPOLY GAME BOARD, but be careful. If you don’t play your cards right, jail is just around the corner!
-Use STRATEGY to master Mayfair.
-Enjoy ENDLESS SOLITAIRE levels!
-PASS GO to collect Rent. You win more each time you pass!
-Test your luck with the CHANCE CARDS. Can you change your fate?
-EARN MONOPOLY POINTS and MONOPOLY moves by completing solitaire deals. You can play as many solitaire card games as you want!
-COLLECT PROPERTIES, buy HOUSES and HOTELS and EARN RENT to win the game! Just like the classic MONOPOLY game you remember.
-Play the game FREE and WHENEVER YOU WANT as a single solitaire player.
With over 250 million MONOPOLY games sold and 290 million Solitaire downloads worldwide this FREE game offers mobile gamers a unique gameplay experience, combining the challenge of the best classic solitaire with the timeless fun of MONOPOLY.
In MONOPOLY Solitaire, completing deals of solitaire earns dice rolls and MONOPOLY board game points to send players off on the chase for fortune. As you make your way around the board, collect properties to build houses and hotels as you establish your real estate empire. Progress through the game and avoid jail to unlock your favourite tokens from the actual MONOPOLY board game. With endless solitaire levels to complete, the fun is limitless!
The classic board game and the classic card game, together!
Download and play the game for FREE now!

bluejetty:00131317:ios.description:
Huckleberry is your all-in-one baby tracker and parenting partner, trusted by 5+ million families worldwide, from your first contraction to your baby's first steps. Our award-winning baby tracker app helps new parents track baby sleep, feeding, and growth with expert guidance at every stage.
Backed by a team of pediatric experts, Huckleberry supports every family's journey, as a maternity app through the late stages of pregnancy, a newborn tracker in the early days, a baby sleep tracker, and solid foods log as your child grows. We turn guesswork into confidence, one stage at a time.
CONTRACTION TIMER
Time contractions with one tap. Track duration, intensity, and frequency. The first tool in your Huckleberry journey, built for expecting parents preparing for a newborn.
SWEETSPOT®: YOUR SLEEP TIMING COMPANION
A most-loved feature that predicts your baby's ideal nap and sleep times with remarkable accuracy. No more guessing about wake windows or watching for tired cues. SweetSpot® learns your child's unique rhythms to suggest optimal sleep schedules.
TRACK GROWTH & DEVELOPMENT
Our baby growth tracker helps you follow your child's development over time. From breastfeeding or bottle feeding to diapers and first foods, our baby tracker gives you peace of mind. See trends at a glance and share them easily with your pediatrician.
BERRY: 24/7 PARENTING GUIDANCE
24/7 instant parenting backup that adapts to what you need, when you need it. Using expert-vetted and contextually aware AI-powered guidance, Berry works through the messiness of parenting with you. From sleep regressions to growth questions to "is this normal?" You always have backup.
STARTING SOLIDS
Confidently introduce new foods, whether it's purees, baby-led weaning, or both. Track allergens and note any sensitivities or reactions. Build a list of foods your baby's tried, what they liked (or didn't!), and get ideas for what to offer next. Get age-appropriate tips to safely serve common foods as purees or baby-led weaning.
FREE APP FEATURES
• Contraction timer for labor prep
• Solids tracking: allergens, reactions, food ideas, and serving tips
• One-touch tracker for sleep, diaper changes, feedings, pumping, growth, milestones, weight, potty training, activities, and medicine
• Complete breastfeeding timer with tracking for both sides
• Sleep summaries, history, and averages
• Track multiple children with individual profiles
• Reminders for medication, feedings, and more
• Sync with multiple caregivers across devices
PLUS MEMBERSHIP
• All free features, and
• SweetSpot®: predicts ideal wake windows and sleep times (2+ months)
• Schedule Creator: age-appropriate sleep schedules
• Insights: data-driven tips and miniplans for sleep, feeding, solids, and growth (0–18 months)
• Enhanced Reports: discover your child's growth, sleep, and feeding trends
• AI Logging: track your day through text, voice, or photo
PREMIUM MEMBERSHIP
• Everything in Plus, and
• Berry: 24/7 guidance with our expert-vetted AI chat
• Custom Sleep Plans: expert-designed sleep training plans, with regular check-ins as your baby grows
GENTLE, EVIDENCE-BASED APPROACH
Our sleep guidance never requires "crying it out." We blend trusted sleep science with gentle, family-centered solutions that respect your parenting style and fit your baby's unique wake windows, growth, and sleep regressions.
AWARD-WINNING RESULTS
Huckleberry ranked #1 in the iOS medical category globally. We help families across 179 countries achieve better sleep. Up to 93% of families using our baby sleep solutions report improved sleep patterns.
Whether you're expecting, tracking your newborn's development, navigating a sleep regression, starting solids, or tackling toddler milestones, Huckleberry gives your family the tools and guidance to flourish at every stage.

Privacy Policy: https://www.huckleberrycare.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00160512:ios.description:
Tor Web Browser: Redefine Your Browsing Experience
Step into the world of Tor Web Browser, an intuitive and powerful web solution that balances simplicity with advanced features. Whether you need essential browsing capabilities or sophisticated automation tools, Tor Web Browser adapts to your needs and enhances your digital experience.
• Free Lite Browser: Core Features for Effortless Browsing
The free version of Tor Web Browser offers a streamlined, ad-supported experience with all the necessary tools for daily web browsing:
- Basic Navigation: Quickly move between web pages with intuitive controls like Back, Forward, Refresh, Share, and a detailed browsing history.
- Ad-Supported Access: All essential features are available at no cost, supported by minimal ads that keep your browsing smooth without unnecessary interruptions.
• Unlock Advanced Features with Pro
Upgrade to Tor Web Browser Pro for an enhanced, customizable experience. With Pro, you'll gain access to premium features that provide more control and convenience:
- Ad-Free Browsing: Say goodbye to ads and enjoy a distraction-free browsing environment.
- Automatic Page Reload & Scroll: Automate your browsing with Auto-Reload and Auto-Scroll, allowing hands-free interaction with web pages that require regular refreshing or scrolling.
- Exclusive Wallpaper Themes: Personalize your browser with a collection of exclusive wallpapers, carefully curated and updated regularly to suit your style.
- App Security Lock: Keep your browsing sessions private with an added layer of security. Set up a personalized passcode to lock the app, ensuring your content is always protected.
- Important: After enabling the lock feature, it's essential to remember your passcode as it will be required every time you open the app for added privacy.
• Flexible Subscription Plans
Choose from a variety of subscription plans to unlock full access to all Pro features and enjoy the ultimate browsing experience:
- Weekly Subscription: Get Pro access for one week, perfect for short-term users.
- Monthly Subscription: Enjoy a full month of premium features with our most popular plan.
- Yearly Subscription: Experience Pro without interruptions for an entire year.
- Lifetime Subscription: Make a one-time payment and receive lifetime access to all Pro features, ensuring you’ll always have the best experience without ongoing payments.
• How It Works:
- Lite Browser: Always free and accessible, featuring core browsing tools for everyday use.
- Pro Subscription: Unlock additional features like Auto-Reload, Auto-Scroll, exclusive wallpapers, and more through one of our subscription plans.
• Subscription and Billing Information:
- Payment: Subscriptions are charged based on the plan you select and processed through your iTunes account after purchase confirmation.
- Auto-Renewal: All subscriptions automatically renew unless you disable auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Renewal charges will be applied within 24 hours of the end of your current subscription term.
- Managing Subscriptions: You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime via your Account Settings, giving you full control over payment options or subscription status.
• Free Trial and Refunds:
- Trial Period: If you take advantage of a free trial, any unused portion will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
- Refund Policy: Refunds are not provided for unused portions of the subscription. Please review Apple's App Store policies for more detailed information.
- For any inquiries or assistance, feel free to contact our support team through the provided channels.

Además, podrás recibir tus pedidos en minutos, conversar directo con tu shopper y crear listas con tus productos favoritos.
Tottus App es la aplicación de delivery al instante de las compras de tu Supermercado Tottus
Con Tottus App podrás:
• Llevar los productos directo desde el supermercado Tottus a la puerta de tu casa en pocos minutos y hacer el seguimiento de tu pedido.
• Disfrutar de gran variedad de productos y la calidad de nuestras marcas propias
• Acceder a ofertas y descuentos exclusivos de la App, aprovechar nuestros beneficios como despachos gratis y descuentos en productos seleccionados.
• Encontrar todos los ingredientes para tu parrilla, somos expertos en carnes, y una gran variedad de comidas para todos los gustos: vegana, vegetariana, saludables, gourmet y las mejores frutas, verduras ¡Y mucho más!
• Selecciona la forma de pago que prefieras y que mas te acomode

bluejetty:00070424:ios.name: Dinosaur Police Games for kids
bluejetty:00070424:ios.summary: Unleash your child's inner detective with our thrilling children's detective game! Dinosaur Town is in turmoil, reeling from a series of thefts. There's a desperate need for a hero, and police officer T-Rex is ready for the task. Join T-Rex
bluejetty:00070424:ios.description:
Unleash your child's inner detective with our thrilling children's detective game! Dinosaur Town is in turmoil, reeling from a series of thefts. There's a desperate need for a hero, and police officer T-Rex is ready for the task. Join T-Rex and become the detective the town needs in this dinosaur game for kids.
Each crime scene in our dinosaur police games is a hive of vivid interactions. The distressed dino victims need your help! Visit each crime scene and sift through the clues based on the victim's reports. With your meticulous investigation, the truth won't stay hidden for long!
Test your logical thinking skills as you collect evidence and identify the thief. Keep the evidence in mind, compare it with each suspect's characteristics, and voila, the true culprit will be revealed!
But the adventure doesn't stop there. With eight unique police vehicles at your disposal, including a helicopter and a speedboat, get ready for adrenaline-filled police car games for kids. The criminals are making a run for it! Quick, get in your vehicle and give chase – it's cops and robbers, dinosaur style! Navigate through various obstacles such as falling rocks and waves to capture the bad guy. With six thrilling police chase scenes, your little one won't have a chance to get bored!
Take the wheel, solve mysteries, capture criminals, and help the citizens of Dinosaur Town reclaim their possessions in our offline kids games. This kids crime-solving police game is not just fun, but it's also a learning experience, making it a great choice among preschool educational games.
Features:
• Explore six themes: theatre, house, school, museum, hospital, game center
• Dive into 18 carefully designed, interactive crime scenes
• Choose from eight unique police vehicles, including a helicopter and a speedboat
• Engage in six thrilling police chase scenes
• Meet 25 vivid characters
• Enjoy offline gameplay
• No third-party advertising for uninterrupted play
About Yateland:
Yateland crafts educational apps that inspire preschoolers across the globe to learn through play. We stand by our motto: "Apps children love and parents trust." Discover more about Yateland and our apps at https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Yateland is committed to protecting users' privacy. To learn more about how we handle these matters, please read our full privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.
Download now and ignite your child's adventurous spirit with Yateland's interactive crime-solving game!

bluejetty:00039143:ios.description:
Embark on a compelling journey into the heart of darkness with "Dark Forest Survivor." Following a harrowing plane crash that leaves you stranded in an eerie forest, your survival instincts are pushed to their limits. As you navigate the shrouded landscape, scavenge vital resources, and construct a secure shelter, you'll grapple with the stark reality that the darkness is more than a threat—it's a lethal presence that lingers at every turn.
Your primary objective is to repair your damaged plane and escape the clutches of the unforgiving forest. Every decision, whether it involves gathering supplies, fortifying your shelter, or enhancing your own attributes, can tip the scales between survival and surrendering to the encroaching night.
Amidst the pervasive darkness, light sources become your lifeline, pushing back against the relentless obscurity that hungers for your demise. Your shelter isn't merely a haven—it serves as a testament to your unyielding determination to conquer the unknown.
Embrace the multifaceted challenge of "Dark Forest Survivor" as you hone your survival skills and enhance your own attributes. Can you navigate the treacherous forest, mend your plane, and emerge as the triumphant victor in this enigmatic and perilous expedition? Your destiny beckons from within the depths of the dark forest.

Q: Why does the music occasionally skip?

Q: Why are some stations blank at times?

bluejetty:00042210:ios.description:
Think of Richmond Moves as a whole new way to get around Richmond — a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, affordable, and green.
With a few taps, book an on-demand ride in the app and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way. 
How it works:
- Book a ride on your phone.
- Get picked up on a nearby corner.
- Share your ride with others.
- Save cash and reduce carbon emissions. 
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our corner-to-corner algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
AFFORDABLE.
Aggregating people into one vehicle brings down prices. Enough said. 
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride. 
Questions? Reach out at support-richmond@ridewithvia.com. Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00059620:ios.description:
Open the app. Breathe. Feel better. Breathe is meditation, breathing exercises and timer without detours — no onboarding, no endless course. Just start.
WHAT DO YOU NEED?
Relax, energize, focus or sleep better? Breathe asks you one question and shows you the right ritual — whether breathing exercise or silent meditation. No scrolling through hundreds of sessions.
- Relax: Physiological Sigh, Box Breathing, Quick Break Timer
- Energize: Energizing Breath, Wim Hof, Morning Boost Timer
- Focus: Coherent Breathing, Deep Work Timer (Pomodoro)
- Sleep: 4-7-8 Breathing, Evening Routine Timer
MEDITATION TIMER
Your space for silent meditation. The timer is the heart of Breathe — fully configurable, with everything you need:
- Duration freely adjustable or endless mode
- Warmup phase (3, 5 or 10 seconds)
- 6 bells: Gong, Singing Bowl, Harp, Wind Chime, Bell, Buddhist Bell
- Interval bells at your own rhythm
- Background sound or silence
- Vibration and haptic feedback
4 ready-made timer rituals — all free:
- Quick Break (5 min) — a short pause in between
- Deep Work (25 min) — Pomodoro focus
- Morning Boost (5 min) — morning meditation
- Evening Routine (10 min) — wind down ritual
6 BREATHING TECHNIQUES
Science-backed techniques — from Stanford researchers, Navy SEALs and Dr. Andrew Weil. An animated breathing circle guides you through each exercise. From 1 minute.
- Box Breathing (4-4-4-4) — stress relief and focus
- Physiological Sigh (3-1-6) — fastest relaxation, Stanford research
- 4-7-8 Breathing — fall asleep in minutes
- Wim Hof Method — energy and alertness
- Coherent Breathing — optimal heart rate variability
- Energizing Breath — morning activation
OVER 30 SOUNDSCAPES
Rain, wind, ocean, forest, fireplace, birdsong and more. Plus 19 music tracks for deep relaxation. Choose your sound as background for timer or breathing exercise.
YOUR RITUAL
Create your own ritual in 4 steps: choose timer or breathing exercise, set your sound, adjust duration and bells, name it. Your morning ritual, your evening routine — exactly how you need it.
5 THEMES
Ocean, Sunrise, Forest, Infinity, Desert — each theme transforms the entire look of the app.
- Start instantly, no setup needed
- Meditation timer with endless mode and interval bells
- 6 breathing techniques, science-backed
- 14 nature sounds + 19 music tracks
- 5 visual themes
- Stats, reminders and session calendar
- 4 timer rituals completely free
- Try every breathing exercise 3 times free
Breathe Premium is available as a subscription. Price and availability may vary by region. Details in the app.

bluejetty:00137363:ios.description:
Welcome, the guardian of order! Your new role as the prison manager in this immersive simulation game set in the heart of the criminal underworld. As you step into your position, your task is to bring order to the chaos and expand your prison using your unique skills. Open new cells, manage inmates, upgrade facilities, and earn money systematically as you navigate the complexities of prison life.
Develop Your Prison:
Begin by building new cell blocks, upgrading facilities, and expanding your prison. Enhance your infrastructure to accommodate more inmates and maintain order within your walls.
Inmate Management:
As the prison manager, your responsibilities include placing prisoners strategically, meeting their daily needs, and ensuring the smooth operation of your facility. Monitor stress levels and intervene promptly to prevent conflicts from escalating.
Earn Money and Rise:
Success in this game means generating steady income to further improve your prison. Invest in security upgrades, expand capacity with new cells, and establish your reputation as a top-notch manager in the criminal underworld.
Attention and Strategy:
Every decision you make will have consequences. Pay close attention to inmate behavior, devise strategic interventions to maintain order, and prevent chaos from erupting within your facility.
Build and Manage Your Prison Empire:
Immerse yourself in the world of prison management as you build and expand your empire from scratch. With a focus on strategic planning, attentive management, and unwavering control, rise to the top and establish yourself as the ultimate manager of law and order in the criminal world.
Privacy Policy: https://www.udogames.com/legal/privacy-policy/

PRAYER TIME
bluejetty:00040871:ios.description:

• Light, dark or automatic appearance, with text-size options.
Available in 19 languages. No account registration is needed to use the prayer features.
Need help? Open Settings, then Contact us, or visit the FAQ through the support link.

bluejetty:00039837:ios.description:
Enter the digital world of myDEI and enjoy the features of the new PPC application wherever you are! 
Sign up to myDEI in three simple steps to manage your account easily and quickly, activate products and services, benefit from personalized energy-saving tips from PPC, register your meter readings online, and more. Discover the new PPC myRewards loyalty and rewards program which includes the PPC myRewards Coupons service that rewards you with offers and discounts from top brands and the PPC myRewards Miles service that allows you to earn and redeem miles in collaboration with AEGEAN Miles+Bonus.
Account update
Manage your energy supply and property information. Handle your bills easily or set up a standing order.
• Information on consumption bill and settlements
• Consumption history
• Frequency selection
• Option to receive electronic or paper bill
Products & services activation
In-app selection of electricity products or activation of add-on services 
• Find out the benefits and advantages of each product or service
• Select the product that best meets your needs
• Quickly activate add-on services for additional benefits
Energy saving 
Learn more about your energy consumption and how it is distributed among your household's appliances. Set your own consumption reduction target and use the PPC myEnergy Coach's personalized energy-saving tips to achieve it.
• Consumption monitoring and evaluation
• Personalized energy-saving recommendations
• Distribution of consumption among household and/or commercial appliances
• Estimation of energy and cost savings from replacing appliances
• Comparison of consumption with similar households and/or businesses
Submission of meter readings
Take control of your electricity bill by registering your meter readings online using the e-SelfMetering tool and it will be issued based on your consumption up until that moment. Choose whether you want to be notified of the available date for registering readings via SMS and/or e-mail.
• Simple meter reading submission
PPC myRewards Coupons
Discover exclusive discount coupons and offers from top brands.
• Unique offers for all your needs
• Discounts and deals on shopping, getaways, food and coffee, and much more
• Coupons available via SMS, e-mail, or PDF format
PPC myRewards Miles
Earn miles by activating PPC products and services and pay your PPC bills by redeeming miles, in collaboration with AEGEAN Miles+Bonus.
PPC Fiber
Enjoy the best fiber optic experience at home, with fast and stable internet for all your digital needs. Manage your PPC Fiber connections and pay your bills

bluejetty:00128586:ios.description:
忘忧围棋 — Go, Chinese Chess & AI Analysis
Play Go, challenge AI, solve life-and-death puzzles, study game records, and enjoy Chinese Chess—all in one app!
Founded in 2012, GoBuddy (Wangyou Go) brings together online Go matches, AI opponents, AI game reviews, tsumego puzzles, professional game records, live matches, and Chinese Chess. Whether you're a beginner, a young learner, or an experienced player, find your own way to enjoy the game.
【PLAY GO | Online Matches & AI Opponents】
• Play Go online against real players and friends.
• Challenge AI opponents at different skill levels.
• Review opening, middle-game battles, and endgame decisions.
• Explore alternative moves and tactical variations.
From 9×9 practice boards to full games, learn through play.
【GO AI ANALYSIS | Smart Review & Win Rates】
• AI move suggestions help you compare candidate moves.
• Win-rate graphs highlight turning points and mistakes.
• AI variations let you examine possible continuations.
• Position analysis helps assess territory and the balance of play.
• Use AI tools while playing, watching, or studying game records.
Review not only the result, but also the decisions behind each move.
【GO PUZZLES | Tsumego, Tesuji & Endgame】
• Life-and-death puzzles (tsumego): practice living, killing, and reading.
• Tesuji problems: discover clever moves, connections, and cuts.
• Endgame (yose) exercises: compare points and move order.
• Choose exercises that match your experience and practice daily.
Build your reading skills one problem at a time.
【GO EDUCATION | Logic, Focus & Reasoning】
Go is a strategy game that invites careful observation, prediction, and decision-making.
• Logical reasoning: understand liberties, connections, and cause and effect.
• Forward thinking: anticipate responses and compare variations.
• Calculation: read several moves ahead in local fights.
• Concentration: focus on shapes, threats, and key points.
• Spatial thinking: consider groups, territory, and whole-board balance.
• Planning: adjust strategies as a position develops.
• Independent thinking: make your own judgment before checking AI.
• Patience and sportsmanship: respect rules, opponents, and results.
Go is not a substitute for formal education, but it offers a fun setting for practicing these habits.
【GO FOR KIDS | Beginner & Family Learning】
Start with the board, liberties, captures, and basic life-and-death shapes. Practice against beginner-level AI, try simple puzzles, study game records, and review decisions together. Parents and children can discuss moves, test ideas, and learn from mistakes at a comfortable pace. Go can be a shared activity for children, teens, and adults alike.
【PHOTO RECOGNITION | Turn Images into Go Positions】
Photograph a board or import a saved diagram, including puzzles from books. Convert recognized positions into an interactive board for further study and AI analysis.
【CHINESE CHESS | Xiangqi & Endgame Challenges】
• Play Xiangqi against computer opponents at different levels.
• Compete with other players online.
• Invite friends through shared WeChat game links.
• Solve daily Chinese Chess endgame challenges.
• Progress through endgame puzzle levels.
• Review match records and rankings.
Enjoy both Go and Chinese Chess in one app.
【PRO GAME RECORDS | Replay & Live Go】
• Browse professional Go game records and classic matches.
• Replay moves, study branches, and examine key decisions.
• Save and manage your personal game records.
• Follow live professional Go games.
• Use AI analysis to investigate important moments.
【GO COMMUNITY | Friends & Conversation】
Chat during games, message friends, and share images or Go variation diagrams. Invite players for another match and manage your friends and blocked users.
【WITH GO PLAYERS SINCE 2012】
From online Go and AI reviews to tsumego, game records, live matches, and Xiangqi, Wangyou Go offers tools to play, practice, and explore. Learn every move.
Website: https://www.gog361.com
Weibo: @忘忧围棋

Precision Hub: Your All-in-One Health & Nutrition Ecosystem
Precision Hub is the ultimate command center for your family’s wellness. By seamlessly integrating our Smart Body Scales, Body Composition Scales, and Digital Nutritional Scales, the app transforms raw data into a clear roadmap for a healthier lifestyle. Whether you are tracking muscle mass or mastering your macro-intakes, Precision Hub brings your fitness and kitchen together in one centralized platform.
Key Features:
● Dual-Scale Integration: Sync your Body or Body Composition Scale to assist in monitoring physical changes and your Nutritional Scale to track calories, macros, and portion sizes in real-time.

● 360° Wellness Tracking: View a complete picture of health—from body fat percentage and BMI to daily caloric intake and nutrient density.

Take charge of your family’s health journey from the scale to the plate. Download Precision Hub today and start living a more balanced, data-backed life!

bluejetty:00185612:ios.description:
Hatch, raise, and breed over 1,500 Dragons on magical islands! Raise a village of dragons from babies to epic adults and breed them to discover new species!
Become the best Dragon Caretaker - you can be the first to discover the ultra rare Diamond Dragon! 
DRAGON STORY FEATURES:
- COLLECT strong, mysterious, and fun dragons from over 20 species! Each dragon moves with a lively, and sometimes quirky, personality!
- BREED different dragon types to hatch new hybrid dragon eggs! Can you DISCOVER the rare dragons from each color combination?
- BATTLE your dragons to win awesome prizes and compete in Tournaments!
- GROW magical food on farms to feed your dragons. Then watch them grow and evolve through 4 unique stages!
- WIN new dragon eggs, habitats and decorations through monthly World Events with bonus community prizes!
- DECORATE your islands with colorful habitats, castle towers, flowers, and more!
- Stunning graphics, animations, and sounds bring your dragon city to life!
- Invite your Facebook or Storm8 friends to play with you. Gift GOLD and help each other raise dragons!
- New dragons and events released weekly!
Dragon Story is the BEST dragon game for your iPhone, iPad or iPod Touch with more Dragons than anyone else!
Which dragons will become your favorite? Mighty Fire Dragons, whimsical Air Dragons, mysterious Magic Dragons and many more await you in Dragon Story!
Dragon Story is an online only game. Your device must have an active internet connection to play.
Please note that Dragon Story is free to play, but you can purchase in-app items with real money. To delete this feature, on your device go to Settings Menu -> General -> Restrictions option. You can then simply turn off In-App Purchases under "Allowed Content". In addition, Dragon Story may link to social media services, such as Facebook, and Storm8 will have access to your information through such services.

bluejetty:00159850:ios.description:
Become better with every ride with Bikeometer — your all-in-one cycling companion built to help you track, analyse, and improve every journey on two wheels. Whether you're a weekend rider, a daily commuter, or a dedicated cyclist chasing personal records, Bikeometer turns every ride into meaningful data and lasting progress.
Our Key Features:
Bike Ride Tracking: Effortlessly record and monitor your bike rides with precision. Bikeometer uses GPS technology to map out your routes, ensuring accurate ride data every time you head out.
Live Stats: Stay informed in real-time with live statistics displayed during your rides — speed, distance, duration, and more, all at a glance.
Speed and Altitude Analysis: Measure your speed as you conquer thrilling terrains. Bikeometer calculates your average and maximum speeds, as well as precise altitude data, giving you valuable insights into your performance.
Ride Advanced Analysis: Gain a comprehensive understanding of your biking performance. Bikeometer provides in-depth ride analysis with detailed breakdowns of every metric that matters.
Everyday Progress Tracking: Witness your progress over time through intuitive charts and graphs, and celebrate your accomplishments — daily, weekly, monthly, and beyond.
Beautiful, Distraction-Free Design: Enjoy a clean, modern interface with a full-screen speedometer mode and customisable themes so the app looks exactly the way you want it.
Route Mapping: See exactly where you've been with detailed route maps for every ride — revisit your favourite paths or share them with friends.
Personal Records: Bikeometer automatically highlights your fastest rides, longest distances, and biggest climbs — because every milestone deserves recognition.
Download Bikeometer now and experience the joy of bike ride tracking, live stats, speed and altitude analysis, advanced ride insights, and everyday progress tracking. Let's pedal together towards a healthier, fitter, and more fulfilling biking journey!

bluejetty:00031664:ios.description:
Want to effortlessly click on any web? Auto Clicker has got you covered.
Our simple and fast auto-clicker app makes it easy to automatically click on social media platforms, games, novels, and news websites on the web. Download Auto Clicker now and start exploring!
WHY CHOOSE AUTO CLICKER？
【Easy to Use】
-With Auto Clicker, it helps you to do repeated taps at any location with any interval you specify.
【Support Multiple Click Modes】
-Auto Clicker supports single & multi-click modes, you can set the action interval and repeat mode, which includes infinitely/limit time/number of cycles;
-Just tap a single position repeatedly at specified intervals, or set multiple clicks at different positions, and then drag the cursor to move it anywhere, and click to edit the interval;
【Easily & Fast Slide Up】
-You can easily swipe on any web page, such as social media platforms, games, novels, news...
【More Auto Tools】
-In addition to an automatic clicker, we also support an auto scanner, wooden fish, click counter, auto-save, and other functions, and are continuously updated.

bluejetty:00095970:ios.name: Can Jam Craft
bluejetty:00095970:ios.summary:
Recycle & Create: A Relaxing Sorting Adventure
Tidy up the conveyor belt by sorting colorful cans into the right bins! Tap glowing cans in the correct order to clear the line—but watch out, space is limited. Master the rhythm of recycling,
bluejetty:00095970:ios.description:
Recycle & Create: A Relaxing Sorting Adventure
Tidy up the conveyor belt by sorting colorful cans into the right bins! Tap glowing cans in the correct order to clear the line—but watch out, space is limited. Master the rhythm of recycling, then turn your collected materials into stunning upcycled art!
How to Play
1. Sort Smart, Recycle Faster
Tap incoming cans in the correct sequence to toss them into matching bins.
Keep the belt moving! If bins overflow, you’ll need to rethink your strategy.
Use power-ups wisely to clear jams or shuffle stubborn cans.
2. Craft Beautiful Can Creations
Every recycled can fills your Material Meter—collect enough to unlock crafting mode!
Combine your cans into dazzling sculptures, wind chimes, or mosaic art. The more you recycle, the bigger your masterpiece!
Why You’ll Love It
Satisfying Sorting – Chill yet challenging gameplay that rewards precision.
Creative Rewards – Unlock new art designs with every level completed.
Quick & Strategic – Fast taps meet smart planning to keep bins from clogging.
Eco-Friendly Vibes – A cozy game that makes recycling fun (and oddly addictive).
Perfect for short bursts or long play sessions. Can you recycle, strategize, and craft your way to the top? Download now and start turning trash into treasure!
(No bins were harmed in the making of this game.)

bluejetty:00136438:ios.description:
Weather just got a whole lot funnier!
Is the weather the most boring thing on earth? Quite possibly! Here at Funny Weather (as the name suggests) we decided to take weather & make it fun.
No more painfully cringe-y small talk about the weather with coworkers (sorry Ted from Accounting). Now when you need your weather, simply open Funny Weather & instantly receive your weather -- along with one of our hilarious weather jokes!
Jokes & colors change based on the temperature & precipitation, so you'll always get a fresh experience. 
Phrases range from funny to downright offensive; get the weather & your feelings hurt all in one!
Think you're funny? You can even submit your own jokes to share with other users!
Features
- Hilarious weather forecasts (profanity included!)
- Funny Weather widgets available for users of iOS 14+
- Accurate weather reports provided a reputable source, Dark Sky.
- Hourly forecasts 
- 5-day forecast
- Share forecasts with your friends
- Submit your own jokes!
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://epsilonv.com/privacy/funny_weather.txt

bluejetty:00073157:ios.summary:
Fax App turns your iPhone and iPad into a complete fax machine: scan, sign, and send faxes to any number worldwide — and get your own fax number to receive them right in the app. No fax machine, no landline, no account setup.
SEND A FAX IN
bluejetty:00073157:ios.description:
Fax App turns your iPhone and iPad into a complete fax machine: scan, sign, and send faxes to any number worldwide — and get your own fax number to receive them right in the app. No fax machine, no landline, no account setup.
SEND A FAX IN A MINUTE
• Scan paper documents with the built-in camera scanner
• Attach files: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Pages, Numbers, Keynote, JPG, PNG, TIFF, HEIC, TXT, RTF, CSV
• Add pages from Photos and Files, or share documents straight from Mail, Google Drive, Dropbox, and other apps
• Pick recipients from your contacts — country codes are handled for you
PREPARE DOCUMENTS LIKE A PRO
• Sign with your finger right on the page — no printing, no rescanning
• Draw and add text anywhere on the document
• Reorder or remove pages before sending
• Add a cover page with sender info, callback number, a note, and marks like Urgent or Confidential
GET YOUR OWN FAX NUMBER
• Pick a local number from hundreds of US & Canada options
• Incoming faxes land right in the app — read, forward, or share them anywhere
• Instant notifications the moment a fax arrives
KNOW YOUR FAX ARRIVED
• Live status for every fax: queued, sending, delivered
• PDF delivery receipt with a confirmation code — real proof of delivery
• Clear failure reasons (busy line, no answer) with one-tap retry
STAY ORGANIZED
• Complete history of sent and received faxes, with search
• Drafts save automatically and sync, so you can start on iPhone and finish on iPad
• Resend or forward any fax in two taps
Whether it's a contract, a medical form, a tax document, or a lease — Fax App gets it there and gives you the receipt to prove it.
Sending faxes and personal fax numbers require a Fax PRO subscription.
---------------------------------
Subscription information:
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The renewal price depends on the selected plan. You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings at any time.
Privacy Policy: https://doc.faxapp.store/legal/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://doc.faxapp.store/legal/terms-and-conditions
Questions? We're happy to help: support@faxapp.store
* iPhone and iPad are trademarks of Apple Inc.

bluejetty:00156471:ios.summary: O aplicativo "FAZ - Zona Azul Digital Fortaleza" foi criado para substituir a folha em papel do estacionamento rotativo da Zona Azul da cidade de Fortaleza / CE. Em apenas alguns toques, o usuário da capital consegue comprar um Cartão Azul
bluejetty:00156471:ios.description:
O aplicativo "FAZ - Zona Azul Digital Fortaleza" foi criado para substituir a folha em papel do estacionamento rotativo da Zona Azul da cidade de Fortaleza / CE. Em apenas alguns toques, o usuário da capital consegue comprar um Cartão Azul Digital (CAD). É simples e prático!
Cadastre-se e pague com Cartão de Crédito, Débito ou Boleto.
Baixe agora e tenha em mãos o aplicativo FAZ - Zona Azul Digital Fortaleza!
- O que é a Zona Azul Digital?
O app FAZ - Zona Azul Digital Fortaleza é uma ferramenta para substituir a folha em papel da Zona Azul em Fortaleza. Agora, o motorista escolhe a vaga no estacionamento rotativo e rapidamente pode ativar um Cartão Azul Digital (CAD).
- Como funciona o FAZ - Zona Azul Digital Fortaleza?
Em apenas 4 passos, você compra tempo de estacionamento rotativo na Zona Azul da capital: 
> Pare seu carro na vaga escolhida da Zona Azul; 
> Cadastre-se no aplicativo em menos de um minuto; 
> Insira a placa, regra e o tempo de permanência; 
> Pague por cartão de crédito, débito ou boleto. 
Pronto! Você acabou de comprar um Cartão Azul Digital!
- Serei avisado se meu tempo estiver terminando?
Não se preocupe! 
O app da Zona Azul Digital Fortaleza avisa quando o seu Cartão Azul Digital estiver perto de expirar!
- E o preço?
O valor para comprar Cartão Azul Digital no app FAZ - Zona Azul Digital Fortaleza é o preço oficial da cidade: R$ 2,00. É moderno e sem complicações! E você não paga nenhuma taxa adicional para terceiros. 
- Como é feita a fiscalização?
A fiscalização também é digital! Você não precisa deixar mais nada no para-brisa do seu veículo ao encontrar vagas para estacionar.
- É seguro? 
Toda a comunicação do app da Zona Azul Digital Fortaleza é feita de forma blindada e segura. Seus dados do cartão de crédito possuem proteção extra, com uma camada de segurança adicional. 
Tudo isso com uma interface intuitiva e amigável! Você não perde a paciência e não perde dinheiro com taxas extras de terceiros! É só garantir o seu FAZ - Zona Azul Digital Fortaleza!
- Quando o Cartão Azul Digital deve ser utilizado?
O aplicativo de Cartão Azul Digital para a Zona Azul deve ser utilizado para regularizar o estacionamento rotativo do seu veículo em Fortaleza quando a placa de sinalização indicar obrigatoriedade do uso do cartão azul na vaga.
Com o app do Cartão Azul Digital de Fortaleza você substitui o antigo papel nas vagas de estacionamento rotativo. É só comprar o Cartão Azul Digital no aplicativo!
Baixe agora o app FAZ - Zona Azul Digital Fortaleza!

bluejetty:00149997:ios.name: CeCe Migraine Management
bluejetty:00149997:ios.summary: Wish you had a simple way to track your migraine triggers and symptoms? Meet CeCe – an intuitive, personalized migraine management app that helps you better understand your life with migraine. CeCe now syncs with the CEFALY Connected migrai
bluejetty:00149997:ios.description:
Wish you had a simple way to track your migraine triggers and symptoms? Meet CeCe – an intuitive, personalized migraine management app that helps you better understand your life with migraine. CeCe now syncs with the CEFALY Connected migraine treatment device to let you monitor your treatments in real time.
Use CeCe on its own to:
- Log migraine attacks
- Track your triggers, symptoms and treatments
- See how your attacks evolve over time
- Keep a detailed migraine journal
- Set optional reminders to help you adhere to your treatment plan 
- Generate graphs and charts to identify your unique migraine patterns 
- Download PDF reports of your migraine evolution and trends to share with your healthcare provider
Use CeCe with CEFALY Connected to:
- Monitor your CEFALY session intensity so you can gradually increase your stimulation over time
- Show your remaining session time and battery life
- Automatically log your CEFALY sessions, so you can see your treatment progress 
CeCe is private: Your personal information is stored securely and never shared with any third party. It’s free and easy to use, with a migraine-friendly design and no ads or clutter.
CeCe was developed by CEFALY Technology as a tool to help those with migraine regain control of their lives. CEFALY is an FDA-cleared, wearable medical device that’s clinically proven to help reduce migraine frequency and relieve migraine pain. You don’t need to purchase CEFALY in order to use the CeCe app.
DISCLAIMER: This app is intended for informational purposes only. The CeCe app does not constitute medical advice or diagnosis and is not intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of a physician or other qualified health provider with any questions regarding migraine or any medical condition.

bluejetty:00178053:ios.description:
Unicorns are loved by little girls and boys everywhere, and if your child enjoys unicorn games, this app is a fun and educational place to play.
Unicorn Games is a collection of unicorn games for kids, featuring a unicorn jumping game, spot the difference games, tap sounds, flashcards, and a Count With Unicorns book. Children explore colorful scenes filled with unicorns while learning through play in a safe, kid-friendly environment.
Created by teachers with over 15 years of childcare experience, these unicorn games support early learning using simple, calm gameplay. The app features original unicorn artwork, including unicorns, baby unicorn characters, and flying horse-style unicorns often known as Pegasus. It is designed especially for toddlers and young children who enjoy unicorns and gentle horse game play.
Jump and Play
In these unicorn games, kids can run and jump with unicorns while collecting fun objects across different environments. This unicorn game helps build hand-eye coordination, focus, and early problem-solving skills.
It also introduces children to horse games for girls, my horse-style play, and simple horse game activities, all centered around unicorns.
Tap Sounds and Flashcards
The tap sounds and flashcards in these unicorn games encourage curiosity and exploration. Children tap objects to hear sounds, see color changes, and reveal words.
When a baby unicorn appears, the activity becomes a simple flashcard experience that supports letter recognition, word awareness, and early language development through unicorn games.
Spot the Difference
The unicorn spot the difference games challenge children to look closely and find one small change in each scene. With multiple levels in every theme, these unicorn games help improve visual attention and concentration while keeping play enjoyable and frustration free.
Count With Unicorns
Counting is easy and rewarding in these unicorn games. Children count unicorns up to twenty while hearing each number spoken aloud.
This interactive activity supports early math skills and confidence through repetition and learning through play.
Why Parents Choose Unicorn Games
Unicorn Games is designed as one of those cool games for girls and boys that parents can feel good about. Featuring unicorns, baby unicorn characters, and flying horse-style unicorns, this collection of unicorn games grows with your child through regular updates and continues to support learning through play.

bluejetty:00066409:ios.name: 9292 travel planner + e-ticket
bluejetty:00066409:ios.summary: 9292 combines all timetables for train, bus, tram, metro, and ferry of all public transport operators in the Netherlands in one app. Plan your journey, buy an e-ticket, track the vehicle with live locations, and stay up-to-date on the lates
bluejetty:00066409:ios.description:
9292 combines all timetables for train, bus, tram, metro, and ferry of all public transport operators in the Netherlands in one app. Plan your journey, buy an e-ticket, track the vehicle with live locations, and stay up-to-date on the latest changes – everything for your journey from A to B. The journey planner provides you with the fatest travel advice based on real-time information from NS, Arriva, Breng, Connexxion, EBS, GVB, Hermes, HTM, Keolis, Qbuzz, RRReis, RET, Syntus, U-OV, Waterbus, and more. With the 9292 app you have all public transport information at your fingertips. In the event of construction work or cancellations, the app automatically provides alternative travel advice.
Why 9292?
• Personalise your journey from A to B
• Real-time information in one app from 10+ public transport operators (incl. Flex-OV)
• Rated 4.5
• The expert in public transport information for 30+ years
• 5+ million users
E-ticket for your entire journey:
• No OV-chipkaart or debit card required during your trip
• Direct overview of travel expenses
• Pay with iDeal, creditcard, or Apple Pay
• Open gates with the QR-code
Useful features:
• Personalise your home screen: Add your favorite locations and routes to your home screen by using the plus sign. Generate a travel advice with just one click.
• Plan from the map or ‘current location’: Don't know the address of your start or end point? Or are you traveling to a place without an address, such as a location in a park? Simply choose your point on the map, or use GPS to plan from or to your 'current location'.
• Departure times: View real-time departure times of a stop or station via the menu.
• Live locations: View the live location of the train, bus, tram, or metro via the map icon in your travel advice.
• Crowd expectation: View the expected occupancy per mode of transport in your travel advice.
• Save travel advice: Save your travel advice via the plus sign in the top right corner of the travel advice. You can find your saved travel advice via the menu.
• Start or end your journey by bike or scooter: Plan your journey and indicate whether you want to walk, cycle, or travel by scooter at the start or end of your journey via ‘Options’. You can also opt for an electric bike or shared bike. The planner automatically shows available rental locations nearby.
• Rent and view shared mobility: Find all rental locations of OV-fiets, Dott, Donkey Republic, Lime, Check, and Felyx via the menu. Are you travelling by Donkey Republic shared bike in cities such as Amsterdam, Rotterdam, or The Hague? Rent it directly via the 9292 app!
• Music for during your journey: Click on the button ‘Playlist for this journey’ at the bottom of the travel advice. Log in to your Spotify account and receive a playlist based on the length of your journey.
Feedback and customer service:
We are continuously working on new features to improve your public transport travel experience. Do you have any questions, tips or other feedback? Please contact our customer service:
• Do you have a question, remark, or problem? Chat with us via Instagram, Facebook, or Whatsapp. During the week and on public holidays from 08:00 to 20:00, on weekends from 09:00 to 18:00. Or send an e-mail to reizigers@9292.nl
• Questions about travel advice or price advice? Call 0900-9292 (only available if you are calling from within the Netherlands). On weekdays from 07:30 to 19:00, on weekends and public holidays from 10:00 to 16:00. Not in the Netherlands? Send an e-mail to reizigers@9292.nl, or contact us via social media.
• Questions about e-tickets? Send an e-mail to ticketing@reizigers.nl

bluejetty:00024489:ios.description:
How smart do you think you are? Hopefully you have enough brain power to grade the answers from your students! Kids say the funniest things and it is up to you to catch what is right and what is wrong. Give students A’s or F’s based on their answers. Careful, not all of them are geniuses so it is up to you to catch the wrong answers!
Students will try to be funny and outwit you with your answers. It may be funny, but it will still be wrong! Fail that kid! We don’t appreciate their attempts to be comedians. Make sure they know math, english, or geography. Some of the answers might even have you feeling like a smart, brainy professor. Help these kids out and prep them for college - you are on your teaching journey!
 Game Features:
1. Make the right choice!
Hopefully you are smarter than these 5th graders! Some questions might even have you stumped!
2. Many levels to play
So many fun and challenging questions for you to answer and grade.
3. Fun for the whole family
Whether you are a teacher, a substitute, a professor, or not in education at all - this game will have you laughing and thinking.
4. Simple and Addicting Gameplay
Once you start you won’t be able to stop. Answer questions, break up fights in recess, watch over detention - it’s like you are back in school again!
Whether you are a fan of puzzlers, word games, trivia games, quiz games, brain teasers, or you just like answering questions, then Papers Grade Please is the game for you!

--------核心功能介紹--------
