bluejetty:00141727:ios.description:
說得AI 是一款集編、拍、演、剪於一身的全能 AI 口播創作神器，整合 AI 提詞器、數位人、智慧剪輯、智慧文案、網感模版剪輯、AI 消除、AI 網感封面、虛擬背景、圖片說話、文案擷取、高亮字幕、敏感詞檢測等強大功能，幫助口播創作者大幅提升創作效率與品質，輕鬆拍出優質口播影片、衝上熱門！
--------核心功能介紹--------
【網感模版】重磅上線！
 不會剪輯也能一鍵做出更有網感的口播影片！內建豐富熱門剪輯範本，涵蓋知識分享、好物推薦、房產財經、教育培訓等多種口播情境，一鍵自動加入標題、動態字幕、關鍵字、音效、貼圖和 BGM 等剪輯元素，告別繁瑣剪輯與後製，原始影片也能快速變成精緻成片！
【智慧文案】全面優化升級！
 從靈感到成稿，AI 幫你一鍵生成更有網感、更適合口播的精彩文案！只有一個想法？依照快捷範本寫下需求交給 AI，即可生成專屬腳本；也能透過連結或檔案一鍵匯入，或從熱門腳本庫找到熱門範本進行智慧改稿。縮寫、擴寫、改用途、換平台，都能輕鬆完成！
【AI提詞器】
 依照語速自動捲動的提詞板，讓你告別痛苦背稿和生硬念稿！無論語速變快變慢，或臨時加詞、跳詞，提詞板都能牢牢跟上你的節奏！可搭配實體提詞器、單眼相機、藍牙遙控器、手機遙控器、自拍棒和穩定器等裝置，功能超強大！
【AI懸浮提詞】
 提詞板可隱形懸浮於其他 App 上方使用，搭配各種相機與直播軟體都沒問題。支援提詞過程中切換腳本，適用於直播帶貨、視訊會議、線上面試等情境。
【數位人口播】
 無論是打造專屬於你的數位分身，還是直接使用現成角色，說得AI 都能幫你更有效率地製作出鏡頭表現力十足的數位人口播影片。支援數位人口播一鍵更換背景，一支影片素材就能輕鬆因應多平台發布與不同口播情境！還能一鍵將單一語言腳本轉換成中、英、法、德、日等 27 種語言的口播影片，影片生成與翻譯一次完成！
【AI消除】
 影片裡有字幕、浮水印、貼圖、後製文字，畫面不夠乾淨？AI 消除幫你一鍵清除！支援自動移除影片中的後製元素，也可手動選擇需要消除的文字或浮水印，智慧還原影片畫面，讓素材更乾淨、更方便二次創作，也更適合跨平台發布。
【數位人帶貨】
 只要上傳商品圖片，AI 就能自動幫你搭配模特兒、寫文案、配音、剪影片，全自動一鍵生成符合商品風格、結合數位人口播與商品展示的多鏡頭混剪帶貨影片！支援自訂模特兒和腳本，並支援中文、英文、日文等 6 種語言！
【圖片說話】
 上傳一張圖片和台詞，圖片中的人物、動物或動漫角色就能開口說話！還有豐富的聲音庫任你挑選。無論是製作廣告素材、線上課程影片，還是讓老照片、動畫人物或寵物開口說話，圖片變影片就是這麼簡單！
【文字快剪】
 智慧辨識影片中的卡詞、停頓片段，一鍵刪除無效內容；支援直接透過文字快速剪輯影片，不會剪輯也能一鍵成片！
【文案擷取】
 無論是影片、音訊、圖片還是文件，不管是連結或本機檔案，都能一鍵快速擷取文案。
【AI網感封面】
 AI 智慧生成圖片，快速做出有設計感的封面！還能一鍵仿製熱門封面！內建上百款全網熱門封面範本，一鍵套用，幫你輕鬆吸睛！
【字幕重點標示】
 AI 自動辨識字幕重點，一鍵高亮關鍵字，輕鬆標出金句、觀點和重要資訊！內建大量熱門字幕高亮範本供你挑選。
【虛擬背景】
 同時支援無綠幕即時去背與綠幕專業去背兩種技術方案。一秒完成場景布置，還有 1000+ 精美背景圖片涵蓋多種情境，省時、省力又省成本，支援抖音、快手、微信視頻號等多平台直播！
【AR演員】
 內建豐富 3D 虛擬演員，可與主播同框互動，也能獨立表演；還支援多個虛擬演員同時出鏡。無需後製，就能直接輸出趣味十足的成片。
【影片加字幕】
 先進演算法精準辨識字幕，一鍵加入，大幅減少錯字校正時間。還能自動生成標題與畫布背景，原始影片瞬間完成精緻後製，一鍵成片！
【教學服務】
 提供豐富多元的「直播教學課程」與「口播學院課程」，一步一步帶你學會製作口播影片。
【美顏美妝】
 專為口播打造的專業級美顏特效！既能一鍵套用流行妝容，也能個人化調整五官等細節，輕鬆拍出好氣色！
【自由重拍】
 說錯也能立即逐句退回重錄，不用整支影片重拍，大幅節省時間！還能在任意位置暫停，完成換人、換裝、換背景後繼續拍攝，前後影片無縫銜接，輕鬆完成分鏡拍攝！
【AI影片降噪】
 一鍵去除雜音並優化人聲，不花大錢也能擁有好音質！
【更多功能】
 鏡像翻轉、台詞電腦端雲端編輯、支援外接音訊裝置……更多有趣進階玩法，等你來解鎖。

1、確認購買後，您的支付寶帳戶將被收取費用。訂閱將自動續訂，除非您在目前訂閱週期結束前至少 24 小時關閉自動續訂。您的帳戶將於目前訂閱週期結束前 24 小時內被收取續訂費用，實際續訂金額以訂閱頁面顯示為準。
 2、如需取消訂閱，請在支付寶 App 登入當時付款所使用的支付寶帳號；開啟支付寶後進入【我的】頁面，點選右上角【設定】→【支付設定】→【免密支付／自動扣款】→【杭州蓋視科技有限公司】→【關閉服務】，再依照頁面提示完成取消。
 3、使用者協議：https://teditcam.vistring.com/user_agreement
 4、隱私權政策：https://teditcam.vistring.com/privacy_policy

 提詞板可隱形懸浮於其他 App 上方使用，搭配各種相機與直播軟體都沒問題。支援提詞過程中切換腳本，適用於直播帶貨、視訊會議、線上面試等情境。

【數位人口播】

【AI消除】
 影片裡有字幕、浮水印、貼圖、後製文字，畫面不夠乾淨？AI 消除幫你一鍵清除！支援自動移除影片中的後製元素，也可手動選擇需要消除的文字或浮水印，智慧還原影片畫面，讓素材更乾淨、更方便二次創作，也更適合跨平台發布。

【數位人帶貨】
 只要上傳商品圖片，AI 就能自動幫你搭配模特兒、寫文案、配音、剪影片，全自動一鍵生成符合商品風格、結合數位人口播與商品展示的多鏡頭混剪帶貨影片！支援自訂模特兒和腳本，並支援中文、英文、日文等 6 種語言！

【圖片說話】
 上傳一張圖片和台詞，圖片中的人物、動物或動漫角色就能開口說話！還有豐富的聲音庫任你挑選。無論是製作廣告素材、線上課程影片，還是讓老照片、動畫人物或寵物開口說話，圖片變影片就是這麼簡單！

【文字快剪】
 智慧辨識影片中的卡詞、停頓片段，一鍵刪除無效內容；支援直接透過文字快速剪輯影片，不會剪輯也能一鍵成片！

【文案擷取】
 無論是影片、音訊、圖片還是文件，不管是連結或本機檔案，都能一鍵快速擷取文案。

【AI網感封面】
 AI 智慧生成圖片，快速做出有設計感的封面！還能一鍵仿製熱門封面！內建上百款全網熱門封面範本，一鍵套用，幫你輕鬆吸睛！

【字幕重點標示】
 AI 自動辨識字幕重點，一鍵高亮關鍵字，輕鬆標出金句、觀點和重要資訊！內建大量熱門字幕高亮範本供你挑選。

【虛擬背景】
 同時支援無綠幕即時去背與綠幕專業去背兩種技術方案。一秒完成場景布置，還有 1000+ 精美背景圖片涵蓋多種情境，省時、省力又省成本，支援抖音、快手、微信視頻號等多平台直播！

【AR演員】
 內建豐富 3D 虛擬演員，可與主播同框互動，也能獨立表演；還支援多個虛擬演員同時出鏡。無需後製，就能直接輸出趣味十足的成片。

【影片加字幕】
 先進演算法精準辨識字幕，一鍵加入，大幅減少錯字校正時間。還能自動生成標題與畫布背景，原始影片瞬間完成精緻後製，一鍵成片！

【教學服務】
 提供豐富多元的「直播教學課程」與「口播學院課程」，一步一步帶你學會製作口播影片。

【美顏美妝】
 專為口播打造的專業級美顏特效！既能一鍵套用流行妝容，也能個人化調整五官等細節，輕鬆拍出好氣色！

【自由重拍】
 說錯也能立即逐句退回重錄，不用整支影片重拍，大幅節省時間！還能在任意位置暫停，完成換人、換裝、換背景後繼續拍攝，前後影片無縫銜接，輕鬆完成分鏡拍攝！

【AI影片降噪】
 一鍵去除雜音並優化人聲，不花大錢也能擁有好音質！

【更多功能】

bluejetty:00019248:ios.summary:

Key features include:
 - Over 10 pl
bluejetty:00019248:ios.description:
Get ready for destruction, chaos, and mayhem in Monster Evolution: Hit and Smash! Take on the role of a giant monster who has evolved to massive proportions and wreaks havoc on everything in its path.
Key features include:
 - Over 10 playable monsters
 - Realistic destruction physics
 - Stunning 3D graphics
 - Unique and challenging levels
 - Immersive monster sounds and background music
 - Addictive gameplay
The origin of this monstrous creature is unknown, but it continues to grow stronger with each passing day. Unleash its rage and become an unstoppable force, tearing down buildings, crushing cars, and flattening trees in a realistic demolition simulator.
Is it a dinosaur from the Jurassic era, a dragon, or an extraterrestrial hunter? You decide. What's certain is that it looks more epic than any other dinosaur in all known dinosaur games.
The game uses a physics-based destruction model, making it fun and satisfying to destroy objects. Everything is up for grabs, including cars, houses, trees, ships, gas stations, cranes, and even spaceships.
Choose from several modes of play, including a special free play mode. Complete quests to unlock new levels, or earn resources in free play to upgrade your monster and possibly even unlock new ones. Check for updates regularly for new locations, modes, monsters, and more.
Are you ready to wreak havoc? Let the destruction begin!- More than 10 playable monsters
- Realistic physics of destruction
- Modern and beautiful 3D graphics
- Lots of unique game levels
- Detailed and realistic monster sounds and background music
- Unique and interesting game play
Where this monster came from is probably not clear, but now it is evolving and becoming stronger and stronger every day. Evolution is not in vain - the dinosaur monster has added a new destructive power to its huge arsenal. Turn on the RAGE and become an invincible aggressive force, destroying everything on its path! Demolish buildings, smash houses to pieces with an epic monster in a real demolition simulator!
Whom, in fact, is this incredible monster decide for yourself. Perhaps this is a dinosaur of the Jurassic period, perhaps a dragon, or an alien hunter. Whom he was not - he looks very epic, more epic than any dinosaur of all known dinosaur games.
The game uses a realistic physical model of destruction, so it's very interesting and effective to destroy buildings and other objects! Absolutely everything that can be encountered can be destroyed - cars, houses, trees, ships, gas stations, freight cranes, SPACE SHIPS and much more.
There are several ways to play – including special FREE play mode. Go through the quests to open more levels or play on free mode to earn more resources – it’s your choice! You will need these resources to increase the power of your monster, and maybe even open new ones. Maybe you could even change appearance of the dinosaur one day, who knows! Don’t forget to check for updates – new locations, new modes, new monsters and many interesting things!
Are you ready? Let’s destroy, smash and break!

bluejetty:00071252:ios.description:
Rank and track your Apple Music listening habits by song, artist, genre and more!
• Rank your entire library by play counts, time listened, or skips.
• Search for stats on any song, artist, album, or genre in your library.
• Filter your library by song location: iCloud Music Library, on your device, or both.
• Select a song or artist to see detailed stats in “Explore” mode. You can also quickly find related content, such as stats for other albums from the artist you’re viewing.
• Graph your top songs, artists, albums, or genres.

• Enable all graphs, including a daily play count graph for any song in your library.
• Filter by the year you added the song to your library.
• Enables all Library Summary reports, and automatically generated reports (by week, month and year).
• …and much more!

bluejetty:00088485:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00088485:ios.description:
Randonauting Adventure is to discover something new in the world around you that may relate to something else in your life or even give you clarity on something you might be struggling with. 
Especially a great update for you is that AI Randonauting has been successfully developed by us. You can chat with AI Randonauting to create interesting adventures for yourself.
Randonauting Adventure is the first ever quantumly generated adventure game that takes you on a journey of true randomness. The adventure is yours to have and the legend will be yours to tell. 
This app provides you with totally random coordinates within a set radius. You can then choose if you’d like to adventure to the point. It’s been said by the Randonauting Adventure community that breaking out of what’s called your “probability-tunnel” can bring about serendipitous experiences and provide great fun while journeying into the world around you.
This quantum random number generator app creates a random location on your map to which you can travel to. At that location you may find something that may appear to be a “coincidence” for you. Do this often enough and you’ll soon realize that these are not “coincidences” but actually synchronicities instead. 
This app will bring you meaningful experiences and provide great fun while journeying into the world around you.
Randonauting Adventure uses both pseudo and quantum entropy sources for randomization which provides a set of coordinates that can be opened in a map to navigate to.

- 오직 이 공간에서만 제공하는 클럽전용 특가/캐시백 e쿠폰 상품들을 구매하고 바로 사용할 수 있어요.

◎ 앱 접근 권한 안내
[필수적 접근권한]
 - 없음.
[선택적 접근권한]
- 추적 : 맞춤형 광고 제공
- 위치정보 : 서비스 위치 확인, 주소 찾기
- 카메라 : 상품평/문의/QR코드 사진 또는 동영상 촬영
- 사진/미디어/파일 : 이미지 캐시, 글 작성 파일 읽기 또는 저장
- 주소록(연락처) : 선물하기 받는 사람 연락처 입력
- 알림 : 쇼핑혜택, 이벤트, 배송 정보 알림

bluejetty:00030532:ios.description:
The NBC Chicago app is your trusted source for local news, NBC 5 Storm Team weather forecasts and breaking alerts. Stay connected with live coverage, Doppler radar, traffic updates and 24/7 news streaming tailored for Chicago, Cook County and the surrounding Chicagoland area.
Get trusted local reporting, real-time weather updates and live coverage from NBC 5 Chicago in one app. Follow stories across Chicago and the surrounding suburbs, including breaking news, politics, elections, public safety, severe weather, traffic, transit, entertainment and urgent updates that affect your day.
Why use the NBC Chicago app?
If you live or work in Chicago, Illinois or the surrounding suburbs, the NBC Chicago app offers live local coverage, investigative reporting and real-time alerts to keep you informed throughout the day.
What can you do with the NBC Chicago app?
Follow Chicago local news and community
* Get instant push notifications for local, national and world headlines
* Read exclusive articles and watch video reports from NBC 5 Chicago journalists
* Catch up on stories you missed in the integrated Alerts Center
* Follow key topics including local economy, public safety, transit and education
Follow elections and politics
* Follow complete coverage of electoral races in Chicago, Cook County, statewide Illinois political contests and local races
* Track primary and general election results, ballot measures and local proposals
* Watch live election debates and analysis with NBC 5 anchors
Stay ahead of the weather with live radar
* Check current conditions, hourly forecasts, 10-day projections, air quality and UV index
* Access NBC 5 Storm Team live Doppler radar to track rain, winter storms, snow accumulation and severe temperature drops
* Add custom weather widgets to your Home Screen to quickly check forecasts for your area
24/7 live streaming and special coverage
* Watch live NBC 5 Chicago newscasts and special coverage on demand
* Follow investigative journalism from NBC 5 Investigates and consumer guidance from NBC 5 Responds
Personalize your NBC Chicago experience
* Sign in with an NBCUniversal Profile to save articles and videos to watch later
* Manage alert preferences and newsletter subscriptions all in one place
Who is the NBC Chicago app for?
It is designed for residents and commuters across Chicago, Cook County, DuPage County, Lake County, Will County, Kane County, Northwest Indiana and Chicagoland who need real-time weather tracking, traffic and local news updates.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I customize news, election and weather alerts?
Yes. You can filter push notifications by topic and location, receiving only the severe weather alerts, breaking news, election updates or community notices you choose.
Can I watch live newscasts inside the app?
Yes. You can stream NBC Chicago News 24/7, live NBC 5 Chicago newscasts, press conferences and special breaking coverage from anywhere.
NBC Chicago provides local news, NBC 5 Storm Team weather forecasts, live radar, traffic updates and 24/7 streaming for Chicago, Cook County and the Chicagoland area.

bluejetty:00073639:ios.description:
Apply for an Electronic Travel Authority (ETA) to travel to Australia.
An Australian Government mobile app that you can use to lodge an Australian ETA application. The ETA allows eligible passport holders to travel to Australia for short-term stays for tourism or business visitor purposes. 
It is recommended that you apply well ahead of when you want to travel. It is suggested that you do not make travel arrangements until your ETA has been granted. See the ETA website to find out more and check your eligibility to apply:
https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/visas/getting-a-visa/visa-listing/electronic-travel-authority-601
Please note, Australian citizens are ineligible to apply for an ETA. For more information, see: 
https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/entering-and-leaving-australia/entering-australia/crossing-the-border/travel-documents-for-australian-citizens-and-permanent-residents
Support videos to assist with using the Australian ETA App are available as follows:
Scanning your passport: https://bordertv.au.vbrickrev.com/embed?id=ba6716a7-6c16-42dc-bf75-53caa8c36a61
Reading the ePassport chip (front page): https://bordertv.au.vbrickrev.com/embed?id=20860fc6-30ea-43bd-802f-ca35ee17c873
Reading the ePassport chip (back page): https://bordertv.au.vbrickrev.com/embed?id=bfe3c5c3-b7bd-487b-a0f1-8be80ae704ea
Reading the ePassport chip (data page): https://bordertv.au.vbrickrev.com/embed?id=c36923d1-e910-4891-b33a-73382b4d70ba
Taking a live photo of yourself: https://bordertv.au.vbrickrev.com/embed?id=f3a9ec56-d973-4df6-82a5-3d63ed792239
Please note that use of the Australian ETA App incurs a non-refundable service fee of $AUD20.

bluejetty:00018517:ios.description:
Yeel - Send & Receive Money 
Yeel - Mobile Payment Platform for Africa and Middle East to Send and Receive Money from Anywhere at Anytime.
Things you can do on the Yeel app:
• Send money to family and friends anywhere and at any time.
• PayMe feature lets others to scan your mobile device and pay you instantly. It acts as your own digital terminal for payments.
• Make person-to-person payments.
• Pay all your bills such by scanning Merchant QR Code.
• Get access to your funds anywhere by using the cash-out feature at an authorized Yeel Agent worldwide.
• RealTime InterBank Payments
• Quick link to your friends, family, and trusted merchant accounts, and with one tab, you can pay or transfer money instantly and securely.
• Check your account balance and save beneficiaries.
• Agent Locator feature to find Agent for CashIn-CashOut worldwide.
• Get detailed transaction history.
• Get quick monthly reports and share it via multiple channels - email, WhatsApp, etc. 
• Fund remittance from your Australian bank account to Anywhere.
Now retailers/ shop owners can accept customer payments:
• For Free – Zero Commission
• Receive money instantly and securely
• Safe, trustworthy and secure. 
• Post a piece of paper with your QR code and let your customers pay you instantly by scanning the QR code.
Additional Benefits:
• Moves countries closer to cashless-digital financial ecosystem.
• Empowers communities excluded from full participation of national financial services.
• Creates employment for Out-of-School youth.
• Provides a highly-secure, QR-code based, and cloud-hosted cashless payment platform
(AliPay of Africa)
• Enables demonetization and digitization of the national currency- increases revenue
collections, reduces illicit financial transactions.
• Enables A2A (anyone to anyone) payments from anywhere, 24x7.
Current Digital Banks & Remittances:
• Daryeel Bank
• Amana Bank
• Iftin Express
• Amana Express
• And counting... 
Download the app now and start sending money or pay your bills using QR code. 
Reach us at:

bluejetty:00140847:ios.name: Measure Tools: AR Room Planner
bluejetty:00140847:ios.summary:
Measure Your Room. Test Furniture Options. Walk Your Style. Regret Nothing.
"The greatest tool I could have while renovating the house. Saved me so much time." - Hannah
Use your phone to measure your room, then preview realistic 3D furnit
bluejetty:00140847:ios.description:
Measure Your Room. Test Furniture Options. Walk Your Style. Regret Nothing.
"The greatest tool I could have while renovating the house. Saved me so much time." - Hannah
Use your phone to measure your room, then preview realistic 3D furniture in it, at the exact size you set, in live AR. Walk around it, restyle it, and make better decisions before spending money or moving anything.
SEE HOW IT LOOKS, FEELS & FILLS YOUR ROOM
A measurement only proves it fits. Painter's tape on the floor leaves a sticky, messy outline. Flat, no height, no bulk, no sense of how the room will feel. Measure Tools places the furniture item itself in your room: real size, real volume, standing on your floor in live AR. Walk up to it. See how it looks in your light, how it fills the corner, how much room it really leaves.
• 31 adjustable pieces across 5 categories: sofas, seating, tables, beds, storage
• Draw it in place: two taps for the base, raise the phone for the height, then match the exact dimensions of any listing, any store, any carpenter's sketch
• 37 material finishes: woods, fabrics, leathers, metals and stones. Plus free color choice
• Placed a fit-check box first? One tap turns it into the real piece, same size, same spot
TRY THE WHOLE LAYOUT, NOT ONE PIECE
Rooms fail in the in-between: the walkway that disappears, the drawer that can't open, the corner that suddenly feels tight. Place the full arrangement: sofa, table, chairs, storage. See the distances left between the pieces. Then step inside and walk the paths you'll use every day, before anything is bought or moved.
FLOOR PLANS IN 2D & 3D
Chain measurements into a floor plan, then view it flat or explore it in 3D. Calculate area instantly, perfect for flooring estimates and renovation planning.
A COMPLETE MEASURING TOOLKIT
• Measure point-to-point distances, heights, and angles with the AR ruler, no tape measure needed
• Room dimensions and area in minutes
• Horizontal surface mode to measure around obstacles
• Find angles precisely with the built-in clinometer
• Bubble level and onscreen ruler included
• Save, organize, and share your measurements and layouts
• Works in both Imperial and Metric
WHO IT'S FOR
• Checking if furniture will fit before you buy
• Decorating a new home or planning a renovation
• Commissioning custom furniture that doesn't exist yet
• Real estate, interior design, and staging work at true scale
Guided Setup: learn to scan your room properly and take accurate measurements with a simple step-by-step tutorial.
Join more than 1 million people who have measured, planned, and furnished their homes with Measure Tools since 2017.
Download Measure Tools: AR Room Planner. Measure your space, plan it in 3D, and see the furniture in it before you buy.

bluejetty:00179912:ios.name: RÚV
bluejetty:00179912:ios.summary: RÚV spilar upptökur fyrir sjónvarps– og útvarpsrásir RÚV, í beinni útsendingu á símum og spjaldtölvum. Hlaðborð yfir nýtt efni í boði eru sýnd fyrir sjónvarps– og útvarpsefni. Leit og dagskrá er einnig í boði. Hægt er að horfa á sjónvarpsrá
bluejetty:00179912:ios.description:
RÚV spilar upptökur fyrir sjónvarps– og útvarpsrásir RÚV, í beinni útsendingu á símum og spjaldtölvum. Hlaðborð yfir nýtt efni í boði eru sýnd fyrir sjónvarps– og útvarpsefni. Leit og dagskrá er einnig í boði. Hægt er að horfa á sjónvarpsrásirnar og hlusta á útvarpsrásirnar. Útvarpið heldur áfram þó farið sé úr spilaranum og hljómar í bakgrunni, þegar slökkt er á símanum eða spjaldtölvunni og hægt er að velja útvarpsrásir með hraðsnertingu (e. 3D Touch).
Útvarpið er öllum aðgengilegt, hvar sem er í heiminum. Fréttir í sjónvarpi eru einnig aðgengilegar allsstaðar en sumir dagskrárliðir eru ekki aðgengilegir utan Íslands, ef RÚV hefur ekki sýningarrétt. AirPlay og Chromecast stuðningur.
RUV plays Icelandic tv and radio channels from The Icelandic National Broadcasting Service. There are featured tv and radio panels, search and schedule. The radio plays in the background and may be activated with 3D Touch.
All the tv shows are in Icelandic or have Icelandic subtitles. The radio is in Icelandic also. Many of the tv shows are restricted and thus, can not be watched outside of Iceland.

bluejetty:00158113:ios.summary:
Make gaming magical with Wand Pro Remote
Control gameplay assists, explore interactive maps, discover collectibles, and get in-game guidance for your favorite PC games directly from your phone.
Available exclusively to Wand Pro members, Wa
bluejetty:00158113:ios.description:
Make gaming magical with Wand Pro Remote
Control gameplay assists, explore interactive maps, discover collectibles, and get in-game guidance for your favorite PC games directly from your phone.
Available exclusively to Wand Pro members, Wand Remote connects to the Wand desktop app and lets you customize your experience without remembering hotkeys or switching between screens.
Features:
Interactive Maps
Explore interactive game maps for your favorite titles. Discover collectibles, resources, quests, secrets, bosses, and points of interest with detailed community-powered maps. Track your live location in supported games, find exactly where you need to go, and use teleportation to take you directly to the location when available.
Whether you're hunting collectibles in Palworld, exploring Elden Ring, completing objectives in Cyberpunk 2077, uncovering secrets in Red Dead Redemption 2, navigating Fortnite, or preparing for adventures in Subnautica 2, Wand Maps helps you find what you're looking for faster.
Gameplay Assists
Enable and adjust gameplay assists with a single tap. Fine-tune settings using sliders, buttons, and presets without needing to memorize hotkeys or leave your game.
Game Guides & Progress Tracking
Access game guides, walkthroughs, and in-game assistance directly from your phone. Find hidden items, track objectives, discover optimal routes, and get the information you need while you play.
Remote Controls
Use your phone as a second screen for supported games. Control features remotely, make quick adjustments, and keep your focus on the action.
Thousands of Supported Games
Wand supports thousands of PC games, including popular titles such as Palworld, Elden Ring, Cyberpunk 2077, Hogwarts Legacy, Red Dead Redemption 2, Fortnite, Subnautica 2, and many more.
Connect Wand Remote to your Wand desktop app and unlock a smarter way to play. Available on iPhone and iPad with interactive maps, game guides, live location tracking, and gameplay controls.

bluejetty:00064472:ios.name: 24.hu - Friss hírek
bluejetty:00064472:ios.summary:
Könnyen használható és gyors applikáció, megbízható hírforrás.
Tájékozódhatsz a legfontosabb belföldi és külföldi eseményekről, hírekről, a közélet és a gazdaság legfontosabb aktualitásairól. Naprakész lehetsz sport, tudomány és tech témákb
bluejetty:00064472:ios.description:
Könnyen használható és gyors applikáció, megbízható hírforrás.
Tájékozódhatsz a legfontosabb belföldi és külföldi eseményekről, hírekről, a közélet és a gazdaság legfontosabb aktualitásairól. Naprakész lehetsz sport, tudomány és tech témákban. De ha szórakozásra vágysz, a 24.hu-val ez is lehetséges: olvashatsz a legfontosabb tévés műsorokról, mozis hírekről, hírességekről, sorozatokról a szórakozás és kultúra rovatokban. Olvashatod cikkeinket, nézheted videóinkat és hallgathatod podcastjainkat is.
A vezető hírek után rögtön elérhető a
hírfolyam (belföld, külföld, szórakozás témák), valamint
hamburgermenüből szabadon válogathatsz a rovatok között.
További funkciók:
- Saját hírfolyamot válogathatsz össze a téged érdeklő témák alapján (Híreim menüpont)
- Szűrési lehetőség a 24.hu aloldalaira is, mint a Sokszínű Vidék, a Rangadó; valamint a TV24 alkalmazás is csak egy kattintás.
- Személyre szabott cikkajánló az egyedi olvasási szokásaid alapján
- Mentett cikkek: kedvenc cikkeidet elmentheted, majd egy külön menüpont alatt később megtekintheted őket
- Olvasott cikkek: a már elolvasott híreket egy külön menüpont alatt elérheted 
- Hallgathatod legfrissebb podcastjainkat (leállíthatod bármikor, és onnét indíthatod újra, ahol abbahagytad), de akár az örökzöld témájú podcastok között is válogathatsz
- Nézheted a 24.hu videóit, amik aktualitásokhoz kapcsolódnak, vagy akár riportjainkat fontos és érdekes témákban 
- Értesítések beállítása: beállíthatod, hogy szeretnél-e értesítéseket (push notifications) kapni a kiemelt hírekről, a 24.hu kedvelt napindító infócsomagjáról, a Reggeli pakkról, vagy a napi összefoglaló cikkünkről, a Napi szummáról. Ezeken kívül külön Sport és Tech&Tud hírek értesítő is beállítható.
- Offline mód: segítségével aktív internetkapcsolat nélkül is olvashatod a híreket
- Olvasónapló és olvasójegy
- Galéria funkció: a beágyazott képek kattintásra nagyíthatók
- Állítható betűméret
- Szabadszavas keresés
Mit találsz még az alkalmazásban?
A friss híreket egy helyen! 
• Magyarország és a világ történései
• sport
• mobil és tech újdonságok
• tudomány
• időjárás
• szórakozás, kultúra (filmek, sorozatok, fesztiválok, utazás)
• népszerű hazai műsorok
• hasznos információk (óraátállítás, benzinár, útinform, balesetek, közúti hírek)
• lottó
• ünnepek

Epic survival run! Racing adventure that will keep you on your toes till the very end! Race, Clash, and Win!
Get your gang together, run with the crowd, and clash against the rival team!
GATHER THE BIGGEST CROWD
Start running alone and gather people on your way to collect a massive crowd. Lead your team through all sorts of moving, rotating, and expanding obstacles. Calculate your moves on the run and save as many members of the crowd as possible.
RACE THROUGH THE OBSTACLES
Let’s see how far you can get in this crazy survival race! Dodge swinging axes and colossal crushing spheres! Avoid monstrous circular saws, deadly red buttons, and a thorny abyss to make it to the finish line.
WIN FINAL CLASH
Run the crowd until you reach the castle at the end of the level. Crush your rivals in the final battle and capture the fortress!
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
GATHER as huge a crowd as you can:
DODGE obstacles
COLLECT keys
CLASH wall-on-wall
FIGHT against bosses
CAPTURE castles
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
GAME FEATURES
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Survival city game
Lots of unique levels
Deadly traps and impossible obstacles
Crisp bright graphics
Super smooth swipe control
Satisfying color explosions
Rewards and gifts
And this is just the beginning… More levels and artful traps and obstacles are coming soon!
Do you think you have the guts to take your crowd through this insane obstacle course? Download the game and try your luck today!
We are looking forward to getting feedback from all of you! Please leave your reviews, so we can keep making the game even better.

• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase

--------------------------------------------
◈ 主要功能
bluejetty:00087721:ios.description:

我们的应用提供了完美的打卡系统，帮你记录练字的日期、每天练字的时间以及练字的个数，我们立志成为你的练字临帖伴侣，为你的成功保驾护航。
--------------------------------------------
◈ 主要功能 ◈
--------------------------------------------
1、支持各种古现代名家字体：楷书、行楷、隶书、篆书、瘦金体、草书。
2、临摹：支持Apple Pencil临摹和描红功能。
3、字帖：米格、宫格等字格、国风字帖定制、支持连接打印机直接打印、导出pdf、导出图片总有适合你的方式。
4、完善的打卡系统：让练字临帖成为一种习惯，我们的打卡工具记录你的成功之路。
5、字体设置：支持各种字体样式的设置，调到你最舒适的状态，练字不应该将就。

7、字体搜索：不用担心找不到心仪的字体。

9、作品集: 记录每一次你的临摹描红成果。
10、中文笔顺: 正确笔顺练字，效果更佳。
11、集字：书法字典，收藏名家字形临摹。
--------------------------------------------
◈ VIP功能 ◈
--------------------------------------------
1、可以使用应用内所有名家字帖，任意编辑内容生成字帖

3、可以无限次使用导出字帖
4、可以长按查看名家字帖的笔画顺序
5、可以根据自己的喜好进行去标点设置
6、可以无限次使用字帖字典功能进行查询
7、可以查看应用内所有高清原帖

bluejetty:00120012:ios.description:
CrisisGo helps prepare those individuals that are responsible for others during a crisis. By taking Emergency Response Plans out of an organization’s three-ring binder and putting them onto smart phones, iPads, and desktops, CrisisGo is putting emergency response plans into the palm of the hands of those who need it most. 
Use CrisisGo for: 
• Sending alert notifications to responders 
• Providing crisis checklists, communication messaging, and ongoing crisis text messaging 
• Presenting building maps for evacuations and rosters 
• Allowing for individual and broadcast video communications that are then recorded to the server 
Key Features: 
• A login and password from your organization is required 
• A web portal is used to update emergency plans to publish content to your iPhones and iPads 
• Continuous improvement is achieved by validating an emergency plan using the crisis checklist during drills 
• Make your organizations emergency plan actionable 
CrisisGo is the most complete mobile crisis response software available.
CrisisGo is now working with school districts across the nation and in Canada to transform their existing emergency response plans into actionable checklists for their staff. 
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life
Questions? Contact our support team anytime at support@crisisgo.com.

bluejetty:00080672:ios.description:
At OneTap, our mission is to reinvent how we share content and utilize the keyboard on our iOS devices. OneTap Keyboard elevates your iOS experience with innovative OneTap Keyboard Shortcuts, transforming how you interact with your device.
What are OneTap Keyboard Shortcuts?
OneTap Keyboard Shortcuts empower you to use ChatGPT, share specific photos, links, text phrases, and files directly from your keyboard. Simply download the OneTap App, add OneTap's Keyboard to your device's keyboard settings, and create your custom Keyboard Shortcuts within the app. These shortcuts are instantly available on your keyboard, making sharing content seamless and efficient.
OneTap also has a Clipboard feature, which you access right from your keyboard. Anything you manually copy will show up on this tab and is available to copy again whenever you need to. You can long press on a piece of content on the Clipboard that you want to turn into a OneTap shortcut so that you can copy & paste that content even faster. 
Features:
- Share photos, links, files, or text phrases from your keyboard with OneTap Keyboard Shortcuts.
- Clipboard quickly copy the content you’ve already copied previously. 
- Use ChatGPT4 directly from your keyboard with OneTap AI Keyboard Shortcut.
- Create folders to organize your keyboard shortcuts.
- Share folders with friends or colleagues, giving them access to your shortcuts.
- Integrate OneTap into Siri Shortcuts for enhanced productivity.
- OneTap is compatible with all iOS devices.
Access OneTap's Keyboard by tapping the world icon on the bottom left of your keyboard. Here, you'll find all your custom shortcuts along with the ChatGPT shortcut. Tap on any shortcut to use it instantly.
Transform your keyboard into a powerful tool for productivity and communication. Share content effortlessly, use ChatGPT anytime, and keep your favorite items just OneTap away. No more searching for your resume, favorite photo, or important links. Everything you need is now within reach.

bluejetty:00041246:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00041246:ios.description:
Opensignal is a fully-featured mobile connectivity and network signal speed test tool. 
Speed test, including download, upload and latency - for 3G, 4G/LTE, 5G and WiFi
Find the best network provider in your area. Compare coverage on Sprint, T-Mobile, AT&T and Verizon.
Video streaming test - check streaming experience for Netflix, YouTube and others 
Compare what you’re paying for to what you’re actually getting by measuring connection quality on an Apple map with a database of signal and speed test results
Completely free and no adverts. Our mission is to create an open-source map of connectivity so that everyone in the world can enjoy the best mobile connection available
Features
- Test tab with speed test and video streaming quality to analyze mobile video performance with results for time spent buffering, loading and playback
- Signal dashboard and ping test - for testing latency response 
- Connectivity map to show locations of 3G and 4G/LTE tests
- Network stats with average speeds for download, upload and latency and network strength on major providers
- Historical log of your WiFi and 3G, 4G/LTE and 5G speed tests to check connectivity over time
Opensignal Speed Tests
Opensignal speed tests measure your real experience of mobile connectivity and signal. The speed test runs a 10 sec download test, 10 sec upload test and ping test to determine the speed you will likely experience. The speed test runs on common internet CDN servers. The result is calculated with the middle range of samples. 
Check if you're getting the network quality you're paying for from your mobile network or internet provider. Use our coverage maps to compare networks and data speed in your area. Opensignal works with WiFi mobile broadband internet.
Video Speed Tests
Slow video load time? Video buffering? More time waiting than watching? A good average network speed isn’t enough for a great video experience. Opensignal’s video test gives you the full picture of your network experience. Opensignal video tests show you exactly what to expect with HD and SD videos. 
Watch a 15 sec video snippet to test and log load time, buffering, and playback issues in real-time.
Monitor how video quality changes with time and location. Review video test results in History to see if your network experience has changed over time.
Coverage Map
Opensignal’s coverage maps show signal strength down to street level using speed test and signal data from local users. With network stats on local network operators, you can check speeds ahead of a trip, find out if you will get a signal in remote areas, check your signal against others in the area to see if you’re getting the best service, arrange the best local SIM and check the signal strength when travelling.
Improving Network Connectivity
We provide an independent source of truth in mobile network experience: A data source that shows how users experience mobile network speeds, gaming, video and voice services worldwide. To do this, we collect data on the signal strength, network, location and other device sensors. You can stop this at any time in the settings. We share this data with network operators globally and others in the industry to drive better connectivity for all. 
Do Not Sell My Info: https://www.opensignal.com/ccpa

• Emissão de pedidos e orçamentos
• Gerenciamento de ordens de serviço (OS)
• Leitor de código de barras

• Controle de estoque

PARA QUEM É?
Para pequenas empresas, comércios e varejistas.
Para prestadores de serviços e equipes externas.
Para todos que querem ganhar tempo e impulsionar suas vendas!
GRÁTIS PARA USAR, AINDA MELHOR INTEGRADO

bluejetty:00022610:ios.description:
***PLEASE NOTE: This game is officially supported on the following devices only: iPhone 4s, 5, 5s, 5c, 6, 6s, 6 Plus, SE, 7, 7 Plus, iPod Touch 6th Gen, iPad Mini 1, 2, 3 & 4, iPad 2, 3rd Gen, 4th Gen, iPad Air 1 & 2, and iPad Pro.***
Five years ago, Carl Johnson escaped from the pressures of life in Los Santos, San Andreas, a city tearing itself apart with gang trouble, drugs and corruption. Where filmstars and millionaires do their best to avoid the dealers and gangbangers.
Now, it’s the early 90’s. Carl’s got to go home. His mother has been murdered, his family has fallen apart and his childhood friends are all heading towards disaster.
On his return to the neighborhood, a couple of corrupt cops frame him for homicide. CJ is forced on a journey that takes him across the entire state of San Andreas, to save his family and to take control of the streets.
Rockstar Games brings its biggest release to mobile yet with a vast open-world covering the state of San Andreas and its three major cities – Los Santos, San Fierro and Las Venturas – with enhanced visual fidelity and over 70 hours of gameplay.
Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas features: 
• Remastered, high-resolution graphics built specifically for mobile including lighting enhancements, an enriched color palette and improved character models. 
• Enhanced for the iPhone 5 series and iPad 4th Gen and above with dynamic detailed shadows and real-time environmental reflections.
• Physical controller support for all Made for iOS controllers.

bluejetty:00064401:ios.description:
Word search has never been this much fun. Get ready to play the most exciting new word search game, filled with multiple game modes for endless fun. Fun word search game mode you can play:
• Classic - Just swipe to highlight and select words you see on the screen. You can play this word find game with or without a timer. If you want a real challenge, try turning up the difficulty as high as it goes!
• Casual - Play a great word search game story in this fun and relaxing mode. Find all the words as efficiently as you can and complete each vocabulary puzzle to move on to the next level. Beat every stage and you'll unlock a ton of great bonuses!
• Extra - Features multiple word search mini-modes that let you play word games and word find puzzles such as Mixed Case, Lost Letters, and Hidden Words. Each mode offers a unique experience that makes it more difficult to solve the puzzle. Great for a different kind of word challenge!
• Multiplayer - Join in a real-time 1 on 1 PvP multiplayer action game with friends and family. Try out this fun social word find experience as you solve puzzles and compete for a high score. Be careful, it's fast, furious, and addictive!
• Up Words - Find words that appear in the opposite direction, challenge your brain like never before in this fun new game mode of word search.
• Rush Mode - Push your skills to the limit as you find words as fast as you can! Endless hours of words searching fun, all with varying levels of difficulty.
A scramble word search game is the best way to relax. Get ready to solve fun word puzzles. Once you play it, you'll want to share it with your friends. Our free word search game also has fun categories like shopping, travel, fashion, etc.
How to play Word Find Puzzle?
This wordsearch game has different game modes to increase the fun. Choose any mode to begin playing. You can also select your favorite category. Words to find are shown above the grid. Letters are arranged horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to double the fun. You have to find them to win the game. You can also choose a grid size ranging from easy to extreme. 
You can also play the best word search game with levels. Each level of this word find game is more fun than the previous one. As you find all the words, you win coins and rewards and go to the next level. 
Key Features of this Free Word Search Game:
- The best collection of word search puzzles around
- Multiple difficulty levels, including easy, normal, and hard
- Tons of free word games to play every day
- Online Multiplayer Word Find Puzzles 
- New free word puzzles added regularly
- Helpful hints to guide you when you get stuck
- Word search is suitable for both children and adults
This top word search puzzle for adults has many categories you cannot miss:
Animals, Birds, Aquatic Animals, Nature, Veggie, Fruits, Sports, and Seasons are very popular categories in our free word search puzzle.
Play categories like Winter, Summer, Fall, Spring, Valentine's day etc and expand your vocabulary.
You can also play the word search puzzles related to the festivals like Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving, and Easter.
This fun and challenging word search game, includes educational vocabulary building as well as unique and exciting hidden word modes! The game has all the best puzzles, daily challenge crosswords, and brain building vocabulary you need to have fun. This one amazing word search game does it all! Hope you enjoy the wordsearch game in English and other languages!
Download & Enjoy the best free scramble word find daily on holidays. Play word search game in English, Français, Čeština, Dansk, Deutsch, Español, Italiano, Melayu, Norsk, Português, Türk etc!

bluejetty:00138255:ios.description:
Every day, thousands of coaches, trainers, athletes and clients log into TeamBuildr to access quality, structured strength and conditioning programs in addition to features that help streamline any program, gym or team - all in a single app.

FOR COACHES
- Preview and review workout sessions for all of your athletes and clients
- View key stats for each athlete’s training session such as tonnage, reps, and session duration
- Track progress over time for your athletes including 1RM’s, times, bodyweight and other metrics
- Communicate with your athletes individually or as groups using our in-app chat feature complete with Push notifications
- Dynamic leaderboards showing results for any combination of athletes and clients
- Coach post to the Feed including links, videos, and images to specific groups of athletes or clients
FOR ATHLETES
- Get individualized training from your coach every day in-app
- Record form on video for coach/trainer to review
- Receive detailed workouts with precise %-based weights and instructional videos
- Message your coach, friends and teammates in-app or share pictures and video on the Feed
- Store all your exercise history, including 1RM’s and other PR’s, in the mobile app complete with linear graphs
The TeamBuildr mobile training experience is streamlined, fast and efficient so that coaches continue coaching and athletes can focus on training.
Have an Apple Watch or other wearable? You can sync your data from Apple Health to TeamBuildr and track your daily Exertion alongside your workouts!

bluejetty:00013721:ios.description:
STORIES FROM THE EDGE
TooFar Media publishes stories by Rich Shapero that test the limits of mind. His protagonists are seekers adrift in a sea of dreams, a domain of illusion and startling vision. They encounter strange gods and unearthly presences, conjured from within or appearing with a mission that cannot, at first, be understood. Their thoughts, like their author’s, are warped toward a state that is different than the one we’re born into—a state more profound, where the truths of our practical world unravel and reveal themselves as the illusions they are. Like the seekers themselves, readers grapple with surprising ideas about human potential.
TooFar Media is also a creative sandbox. Each of our sixteen titles is both a novel and a multimedia experiment combining book, music, art, animation, and video. We have a small core team and dozens of collaborators—writers, musicians, artists, animators, and people with knowledge meaningful to our stories.
Our content is freely available to anyone with an interest.

bluejetty:00019023:ios.name: Da Vinci Pinball
bluejetty:00019023:ios.summary:

– Stunning graphics paint a landscape of mysterious symbols and interactive machin
bluejetty:00019023:ios.description:
Answering the calls for another stellar pinball offering, Gameprom presents Da Vinci Pinball, a pinball monument to the intellectual wellspring of Leonardo!
– Stunning graphics paint a landscape of mysterious symbols and interactive machinery, all rendered in Gameprom's award-winning style and brought to life with our own physics engine, praised for its realism.
– Race along the pathways of knowledge to bring new discoveries to Mankind.
– Medieval weapons, elements of architecture and geometry, mechanical components, and Leonardo's tank and flying machine are all there to explore.
– Embark upon the journey of the Renaissance Mind with Da Vinci Pinball!
FEATURES INCLUDE:
– inventive mechanisms providing engaging and open-ended gameplay
– beautiful, high resolution color graphics (from the design team who
received the 2010 Apple Design Award)
– realistic physics and lifelike table operation
– original soundtrack and voice
– three camera views, each displaying the table in high resolution
– 3D (anaglyph) stereographic capability
– high quality audio with stereo pinball sounds
– numerous unique and challenging missions
– gameplay can follow a sequential plotline or be played spontaneously
GAME CHALLENGES:
– Invent the Bicycle - hit three droptargets
– The Path to Truth - pass along the accelerator and past the spinners
to a hole pocket
– Fire the Arbalest - activate the arbalet entry, then hit 4 droptargets
in the sub-table arbalest minigame
– Shoot the Cannon - hit all droptargets and enter the cannon
– Multiball #1 - knock the balls free from their holes
– Multiball #2 - knock the balls free from their holes
– Decode the Codex Minor - cross all lit symbols to illumine the Codex Minor
– Multi-barreled Gun - land in the left hole pocket three times, then
enter the accelerator
– Release the Helicopter - pass through the mechanical dredge and hopper
– Invent the Crane - send three balls into the crane trap
– Decode the Codex Major - cross all lit symbols to illumine the Codex Major
– Construct the Flying Machine - pass over all lit symbols to light both Codices

bluejetty:00173570:ios.summary: Introducing Brick Breaker: Journeys, an energetic and action-packed brick crusher puzzle game with a spin! Embark on an exciting adventure in this free and fun brick breaking game that takes you through fast-paced and nostalgic journeys fil
bluejetty:00173570:ios.description:
Introducing Brick Breaker: Journeys, an energetic and action-packed brick crusher puzzle game with a spin! Embark on an exciting adventure in this free and fun brick breaking game that takes you through fast-paced and nostalgic journeys filled with endless challenging stages! It’s time to put your strategy skills to the test.
Dive into a reimagined classic puzzle game with a unique twist: no paddles, just an array of balls for you to aim and fire at complex brick patterns. Blast your way through each level and experience the thrill of clearing all the bricks to advance to the next stage. Put your skills, logic, and puzzle brain power to work to clear the boards, but don’t worry, you’ll be able to unlock plenty of power-ups to help you blast through all the bricks. 
Key Features:
- Brick Breaker: Journeys is FREE to play!
- Journeys: Explore 10-stage sets with unique mechanics, endless brick patterns and boards, thanks to our innovative stage generator.
- Extended Aiming Guide Line: Enjoy this free feature that helps you predictively aim three 'bounces' ahead, making your brick breaking experience even more engaging.
- Generated Stages: Tackle over 3,000 fun stages across 300 Journeys, all created by our state-of-the-art stage generator.
- Power-Ups: Unlock unique power-ups like lightning and bombs to destroy indestructible bricks.
- Diamond Collection: Collect diamonds hidden within bricks and exchange them for Ball Skins in the in-game shop.
- Ball Shop: Unlock unique ball skins and customize the look of your shooting ball. 
- XP: Level up your game by collecting XP at the completion of each stage.
- No Wi-Fi needed! Play anytime, anywhere, offline or on airplane mode.
Experience the puzzle game that feels like a fun blast from the past! The gameplay feels like the classic ‘Breakout’ game but with a futuristic look and feel. Explore the endless possibilities of generated stages, and don't forget to collect diamonds to personalize your game with Ball Skins. Brick Breaker: Journeys is a high octane puzzle game in which you’ll have to use logic, problem solving skills, and expert precision to clear the boards. Let’s see if you have what it takes to blast through all the bricks in one shot!
Ready to embark on this fun brick crushing adventure? Download Brick Breaker: Journeys now and become the ultimate brick breaker champion! 
Please see our privacy policy at http://mobilityware.com/privacy-policy.php
Please see our Terms of Service at http://mobilityware.com/eula.php

bluejetty:00091856:ios.name: Joy: Baby & Parenting Experts
bluejetty:00091856:ios.summary: Joy is a parenting app built around real human experts you can actually talk to. A real lactation consultant, a real sleep specialist, a real parent coach are available every hour of every day to answer your question with your baby's name a
bluejetty:00091856:ios.description:
Joy is a parenting app built around real human experts you can actually talk to. A real lactation consultant, a real sleep specialist, a real parent coach are available every hour of every day to answer your question with your baby's name and your specific situation in mind.
Joy has real certified experts who are there with you at 3am when your baby won't stop crying. Joy is built for the moments when you're wondering if cluster feeding is normal, or whether your baby's poop is the wrong color, or why no one warned you about the four month sleep regression. Answers when you don't know if something is wrong or if this is just what it is all supposed to feel like.
24/7 access to certified parenting experts
Type your question into the app and a real human expert responds within minutes. Lactation consultants for feeding. Sleep specialists for the regression you weren't warned about. Parent coaches for everything else. They've seen every question you have. They're not going to judge you for asking.
A baby tracker that actually helps you understand what's happening
Log feeds, sleep, diapers in seconds. Spot patterns you couldn't see on your own and share with your pediatrician. Most parents say the moment they realized ""oh, my baby IS getting enough"" was the moment they could finally breathe again. Our team of experts can review your tracker history before or during any conversation so you're not starting from scratch.
Hundreds of expert written articles for every stage
A library of articles and videos for whatever stage you're in right now. Newborn sleep. Cluster feeding. Starting solids. The 4 month sleep regression. Toddler tantrums. Potty training. Preschool transitions. Written by certified specialists, not scraped from the internet.
Member discounts from brands parents actually trust
Member offers on the stuff you're going to buy anyway including diapers, wipes, gear, sleep sacks, and home essentials. From brands we actually use ourselves. All items are curated by parents, for parents.
What parents are saying
"I can sleep again. That's what Joy gave me. I asked Sandra at 2:37am and she texted back in three minutes and walked me through it."
"I got told 'your baby is okay' by a real human and I think that's the sentence I'd been waiting for since I left the hospital."
"The lactation consultant alone would cost $300 an hour. I get unlimited access for $12 a month."
"I texted them about my toddler's tantrum and got a real answer from a real person who'd seen it before. That's it. That's what I'd been missing."
Frequently asked questions
- Are these real human experts or AI?
Both options are available to you. We have real humans and AI support trained on our expert certified parent coaches, IBCLC lactation consultants, and sleep specialists. AI is used to surface relevant content, never to replace expert advice. You can use either depending on your needs.
- How fast do experts respond?
Most messages are answered in under 10 minutes, day or night.
- Is Joy only for newborns?
No. We're with you from pregnancy through preschool. Newborn, infant, toddler, big kid. We don't go anywhere when your baby gets older.
- How much does Joy cost?
Pricing is shown clearly in the app. New members get a free trial.
- Can I cancel anytime?
Yes. Cancel in 30 seconds inside the app. No phone calls, no friction.
We're parents. We built this because we needed it. Backed by certified experts. Trusted by tens of thousands of families.
Questions? support@joy.co
Privacy: joy.co/privacy-policy
Terms: joy.co/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00156460:ios.description:
Pass your DMV permit test, motorcycle license, or CDL exam — all from one app.
DMV Study covers every written test you need for 2026: car, motorcycle, and commercial driver's license. Pick your state, choose your license type, and start practicing with questions built from official DMV manuals.
THREE LICENSES, ONE APP
Whether you need a regular driver's license, a motorcycle endorsement, or a CDL with HazMat and Air Brakes — DMV Study has the practice tests, explanations, and study tools to get you ready.
Car (Class D)
Prepare for your learner's permit or driver's license renewal with state-specific questions on road signs, traffic laws, right-of-way rules, and safe driving practices.
Motorcycle
Study for your motorcycle permit or endorsement with dedicated questions covering two-wheel handling, protective gear, lane positioning, and riding in traffic.
CDL (Commercial Driver's License)
Practice for your Class A, B, or C CDL permit. Includes General Knowledge, Air Brakes, HazMat, Tanker, Doubles/Triples, Passenger, School Bus, and Combination Vehicle tests.
WHAT MAKES DMV STUDY DIFFERENT
Available in English and Spanish — switch languages anytime
State-specific questions for all 50 states, updated for 2026
Detailed answer explanations so you understand the why, not just the what
Exam simulator that mirrors the real DMV test format and timing
Progress tracking to see your strengths, weaknesses, and readiness
Offline mode — study without an internet connection
No ads during study sessions — zero distractions
HOW TO USE DMV STUDY
Select your state and license type (car, motorcycle, or CDL).
Study through practice exams with instant feedback after each question.
Review explanations and focus on topics where you need improvement.
Take a timed exam simulation when you feel confident.
Head to the DMV ready to pass on your first attempt.
BUILT BY A REAL DRIVER
DMV Study was created by a licensed CDL holder who passed the real exam. Every question is designed from firsthand experience — not auto-generated filler. That is the difference between studying with someone who has been through it and studying with a random quiz app.
Free to start. Download now and begin your first practice test today.
Terms of use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/.

Here your main task and goal is public safety accomplishing different missions with the help of Helicopters simulators, bike simulators and beat enemies using extra ordinary weapons like AK47, Suppressors. 
As a responsible police officer it’s your main duty to have a keen eye on the criminals activities and perform the actions for crime control.

In police games, get help from fellow police cars in a cop chase to catch running gangsters in less time around the city. It’s your obligation to stop crime in police games. Prepare yourself as a brave cop for the safety of citizens in police car games. The city is in bad security, so protect people in this police simulator game. The life of the common man is in danger in the city so now it’s your duty to secure the area, clear from gangs in the police chase simulator.
You have to work for better security by patrolling in a police car and arrest robbers in police games. You have to be careful while police car chases as they also have weapons in the police chase simulator. In this cop simulator game, your target is to kill the gangsters in the city. The main job in police games is to chase street robbers. Choose your police moto bike in the garage and begin a police car chase. The best thing about this police car game is that you have brand-new US Police cars and moto bikes. US police game is not an ordinary car racing game because this has additional features of cop simulator. 
As a brave officer in cop simulator, you have to track down all criminals in police games. In this cop car simulator, your main objective is to finish all street crimes. Speed up your cop car chase & capture robbers on the highway. It’s time to show driving skills to grab street racers in the dodge police game. In this police games 2020, this is your main responsibility to guard civilians against street criminals. In this cop car chase, go through city traffic and avoid hurdles in city. Robbers are smart enough to dodge police cars but you must drive fast to catch them.Smash them badly in this police games 2020. Take out a gun and start shooting criminals while chasing them in a cop car simulator. Accelerate your cop car on city roads to take down robbers. 
In some missions police chase the robbers with special forces until their death to rescue the civilians and make the city crime free. In case of emergency police officer is required to come up with a defence plane and with his whole police department to fight against the enemies till the death of the last enemy. This cop simulator also have a cop dog simulator thrilling mission. Where the trained police dogs are required to find the criminals, rescue officer and save the defence system. Traffic cop makes sure to implement the traffic rules.

- 10 outstanding guns including snipper, short gun, AK47 and assault rifle and many more
- each mode consists of multiple Thrilling Missions
- 5 helicopters in the police Department
- 5 bikes for police drift
- 5 Police Dogs to chase the robbers and for defense of civilians

bluejetty:00174682:ios.summary: Do you need a ride? Or are you craving a pizza? Ride wherever you want or order food delivery with DiDi, the world's largest mobility app and professional food delivery platform! Order a car in just three taps and travel more relaxed and co
bluejetty:00174682:ios.description:
Do you need a ride? Or are you craving a pizza? Ride wherever you want or order food delivery with DiDi, the world's largest mobility app and professional food delivery platform! Order a car in just three taps and travel more relaxed and comfortable. Order delicious food from your favorite restaurants with fast delivery. Download the app and enjoy our special discounts!
Download the DiDi Rider app now and guarantee a quality, economical and safe private transport service. You can also enjoy great food anytime, anywhere. Order your favorite pizza, hamburger, and tacos. A complete app to make your day easier.
DiDi offers these services:
DiDi Express: cheap and safe trip with a qualified driver.
DiDi Economy: cheaper travel, but with the same quality as the DiDi Express.
DiDi Taxi: request a taxi by cell phone to travel more comfortably (available in some cities).
DiDi Delivery: deliver or receive your order, package, or document cheaply.
DiDi Flex: you choose the price of your trip.
DiDi Food: enjoy great food anytime, anywhere.
DiDi Moto: Enjoy better rates and faster rides.
More savings on your travels and safe deliveries
With the DiDi Rider you can travel economically! Order a taxi or a private driver and take cheap trips wherever you want. Do you want a mobility app where you can save money? Then download DiDi Rider!
Food Delivery
Order food from restaurants easily with DiDi! In just 3 simple steps, you can enjoy your favorite delivery without leaving your home.
Your safety is the most important thing
Safe travel first. All DiDi drivers go through a selection process, where only the best are judged. With an extra step of security, you can share your trip in real time with trusted contacts. In an emergency, press the safety button. Travel safely with DiDi!
Choose your payment method
Select the best payment method, credit or debit card, via the app, or cash payment (only available in some cities). DiDi offers discount coupons and exclusive promotions for you to travel cheap. Enjoy it!
Ease of ordering cheap travel deliveries
With DiDi Rider you can travel or order package deliveries with ease. Just enter your current location and destination, and we'll find the nearest private driver or taxi driver. You can see the driver's location in real-time and how long it will take to arrive. Request one of our services, such as DiDi Taxi, to travel cheaply on the largest transport platform in the world!
How to request a trip on the DiDi platform
Download the DiDi Rider app and create an account.
Enter your location and destination.
Select payment method: credit card, debit card or cash payment (available in some cities).
Click "Confirm" and we will find a driver nearby. You will be able to see all vehicle and driver information, including their real-time location and how long it will take to arrive.
Give your opinion at the end of the trip: so that DiDi maintains its quality of service.
With DiDi Rider, you can order safe travel, fast deliveries and enjoy a low fare and a private transfer service with a qualified driver. Also, you can choose to pay cash or card when ordering a cheap trip.

bluejetty:00042066:ios.summary: Make your relationship last, and have fun doing it! Lovewick’s free relationship tracker app has everything you and your partner need to grow & stay in love: 1000+ fun couples questions, 100s of unique date ideas, research-based romantic ad
bluejetty:00042066:ios.description:
Make your relationship last, and have fun doing it! Lovewick’s free relationship tracker app has everything you and your partner need to grow & stay in love: 1000+ fun couples questions, 100s of unique date ideas, research-based romantic advice & relationship reminders like anniversary and date night countdowns!
Think of us as a free couples app, a free relationship app for couples, or a free all-in-one relationship tracker. Whatever the label, our app acts as a couples question game, date ideas library, and mini couples journal that all create more intimacy in your relationship and help you make quality time and memories as a couple -- use alone or as a paired app for couples to sync questions, memories, and date ideas across devices.
New relationship questions and date ideas are added to our free couples app weekly!
FEATURES
■ Couples Questions Game & Therapist-Endorsed Relationship Card Decks
- Access 1,000+ free, evergreen (anytime) couples questions across 6 relationship card deck categories: intimacy, interests, personality, values, family, and money
- Explore premium sets of couples questions based on relationship milestones: meeting families, moving in together, getting engaged or married, and many more!
- Unlock relationship advice and date ideas as you play the couples questions game, and save date night ideas you like to your Relationship Wishlists
- Answer questions in person, over video call, or through typed notes if paired and a long distance couple!
■ Date Night & Intimacy Inspiration Library with 100s of Unique, Romantic Ideas For Couples
- Explore 750+ free date ideas, intimacy ideas, and romantic gestures crowdsourced from other creative couples, and filter by constraints like time, cost, or having a long distance relationship
- Save ideas to Wishlists to collaboratively plan date nights, future trips, and more! Hide ideas from your partner if they like surprises
■ Relationship Reminders & Notes: Forget-me-nots
- Be thoughtful more easily with notes on what your partner likes and doesn’t like and reminders for important dates. Write down anniversaries, birthdays, and preferences like coffee orders, favorite flowers, and clothing sizes, all in one place.
■ Couples Memories & Relationship Tracker Timeline
- Celebrate your journey as a couple with a neatly arranged memory timeline that grows as you check-off dates and experiences from your Wishlists or share important experiences outside the app (happy date nights, road trips, graduations or promotions, or when you finally make things official, etc.)
- If you’re paired on the app, both add photos and notes to your relationship tracker timeline and feel proud of your relationship growth
■ Perfect For Any Stage Of A Romantic Relationship
Lovewick’s free couples app grows with your relationship!
* New relationship? Learn about each other through couples question card decks; your partner doesn’t have to be paired with you on the app in order to answer!
* Long distance relationship? Spice up video calls with long distance couple questions and distance-friendly date ideas
* Thinking about getting engaged or married? Feel confident to take that next step in your relationship and build habits to support a happy marriage
* Growing your family? Couples can “babyproof” their relationship with our “starting a family” collection and use Lovewick for date ideas that fit into their busy lives
Ready for a relationship wellness app that you’ll actually enjoy?
Lovewick’s couples question game, cute date ideas, and research-based tips help couples reflect, play, and grow in their relationships. Use our relationship tracker app for free, or upgrade to Lovewick Plus ($29.99/yr, $14.99/qtr, or $9.99/mo) for premium question sets and no daily question limit.
https://lovewick.com/privacy-policy/
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Our team would love any feedback or ideas to improve. DM on socials or email support@lovewick.com. Thanks!

bluejetty:00087751:ios.description:
Where the World Collects Watches
Welcome to our Collector’s Circle and the mobile app for The 1916 Company, a digital toolbox for the modern watch collector and your gateway to the community that loves them. Whether you’re managing a growing collection or exploring your next – or first – watch acquisition, our app brings the full experience of The 1916 Company to your fingertips. Daily editorial and engaging video content. Tools for collection management. Seamless access to new and pre-owned timepieces. A direct line to our Client Advisors around the world. Now, we invite you to explore our all-new Community hub, your destination to discover, connect, and share around the clock.
All-New Community Features
We redesigned The 1916 Company app to bring the community experience front and center, with user profiles, bios, notifications, and customizable privacy settings to add a new layer of personality and personalization. This is your destination for Wrist Time, thoughtful discussions, meaningful connections, and insight into our Collector’s Circle. A preference center and alert system keep you in the loop with real-time updates on likes, comments, and replies.
Wrist Time, Reimagined
A refreshed design and new functionality help you uncover your watch-wearing habits, share wrist shots, and explore trends across the community. Track what’s on your wrist and log dates, notes, and activities that give context to your collection and help you evaluate which watch to wear today. As you record your Wrist Time, there’s an option to share it with all of us, sparking conversation and connection across our community.
Thoughtful Discussions
Join the conversation in a space built for passionate collectors and curious enthusiasts alike. Discover industry news, brand releases, and global happenings. Explore debates sparked by original editorial and seek advice from the community. Whether you’re sharing a perspective or posing a question, this is where connection takes shape.
Original Content for Every Collector
Insight, opinion, and expert perspectives – all in one place, tailored to the modern collector. Check out videos and articles by Jack Forster, Tim Mosso, and other leading voices. Explore collector anecdotes, horological 101s, and deep dives into the technical, historical, and cultural aspects of watchmaking as you stay informed, curious, and connected to collecting culture.
Manage Your Collection
Digitally store and maintain your watch collection from your profile. Collection tools help to organize images, warranty details, service records, and more. Here you can access Wrist Time tracking and connect with Client Advisors for quotes on pieces you wish to sell or trade.
Wish Lists
Keep track of the watches you’re dreaming about. Add to your Wish List for easy reference, future planning, or conversations with a Client Advisor. It’s your curated shortlist – organized, accessible, and just a tap away. Set preferences and receive alerts when pieces become available.
Shop the Latest
The 1916 Company is an authorized retailer of the world's most prestigious watch and jewelry brands, including Rolex, Patek Philippe, Breitling, Cartier, De Bethune, IWC, Omega, Tudor, and more. Browse and shop our authorized portfolio and discover our extensive pre-owned collection, which includes Rolex Certified Pre-Owned watches. Curate your shopping feed based on favorite brands, add to your wish list, and get inspired with daily new arrivals.
Your Dedicated Client Advisor
Start a conversation with one of The 1916 Company’s dedicated Client Advisors anytime, anywhere. In-app messaging is organized in your 1916 Inbox for seamless communication and support.
Visit Us Around the World
Our network includes more than 20 boutiques, showrooms, and Collector’s Lounges around the world, granting you access to new and pre-owned timepieces, fine jewelry, and a dedicated team to help you navigate with ease.

bluejetty:00135071:ios.description:
Die Digitale Ausgabe der SZ:
Jeden Tag bestens informiert mit dem Qualitäts-Journalismus von der Süddeutschen Zeitung und dem SZ-Magazin.
Optimiert für Smartphone und Tablet bringt die digitale Ausgabe der Süddeutschen Zeitung die Möglichkeiten des digitalen Erzählens mit den Vorteilen der klassischen Zeitung zusammen. 
Erleben Sie große Geschichten opulent erzählt, hören Sie die tägliche Glosse “Das Streiflicht” oder tauchen Sie ein in interaktive Grafiken. Dazu: Eine kuratierte Auswahl mit Aktuellem und Hintergründigem aus Ressorts wie Politik, Wirtschaft, Feuilleton, Medien, Sport und Wissenschaft. Für Sie schon um 19 Uhr am Vorabend verfügbar: Damit Sie schon heute wissen was morgen wichtig wird.
Neben der Zeitung bekommen Sie in der App auch jeden Donnerstagabend das neuste SZ-Magazin.
***********************
Inhalte: 
• Die täglichen Ausgaben und die Wochenendausgabe
• Jede Woche das aktuelle SZ Extra der München-Redaktion mit Kultur- und Freizeittipps 
• Sonderausgaben zu Themenschwerpunkten 
• Viermal im Jahr die SZ Langstrecke mit den besten Geschichten der SZ
• Entdecken Sie jeden Tag neue knifflige Rätsel
• Das tägliche „Streiflicht“ zum Anhören
• Interaktive Grafiken und Multimediareportagen
• Podcasts zu aktuellen Themen
SZ-Magazin:
• Alle Inhalte des SZ-Magazins
• Die Kolumne „Sagen Sie jetzt nichts“ in interaktiver Optik
• „Das Beste aus aller Welt“ zum Anhören, gelesen von Axel Hacke persönlich
• Das „Gemischte Doppel“ als animiertes Memo-Spiel
• Die Kolumne „Kochquartett“ als bebilderte Kochschule
Regionale Berichterstattung:
Für die Landkreise um München bieten wir eine regionale Berichterstattung an. Sie können komfortabel in den Einstellungen Ihren präferierten Lokalteil wählen:
Landkreis München, Dachau, Ebersberg, Erding, Freising, Fürstenfeldbruck, Starnberg oder Bad Tölz – Wolfratshausen.
***********************
Funktionen:
• Offline-Modus: Bereits heruntergeladene Ausgaben sind auch ohne Internetverbindung verfügbar.
• Meine Artikel: Speichern Sie Ihre favorisierten Artikel und lesen Sie sie später weiter.
• Schriftgröße: Legen Sie Ihre gewünschte Schriftgröße für ein optimales Leseerlebnis fest.
• Hell/Dunkelmodus: Die App unterstützt den Hell/Dunkelmodus für ein komfortables Lesen Ihrer Ausgabe.
• Vorlesefunktion: Nutzen Sie die Vorlesefunktion in den Artikeln der Digitalen Ausgabe.
• Archiv: Alle Ausgaben der letzten zwei Jahre sind für Sie im Archiv hinterlegt. Einzelne Artikel finden Sie über die Suchfunktion. 
Erfahren Sie mehr unter sz.de/zeitungs-app
***********************
Sollten Sie Fragen, Anregungen oder Probleme mit der SZ-Zeitungs-App haben, kontaktieren Sie uns gerne per E-Mail unter sz-digital@sz.de. 
Rechtliches: 
Datenschutz der SZ: https://sz.de/zeitungsapp_datenschutz
AGB der SZ: https://sz.de/agb

bluejetty:00141310:ios.description:
Authenticator allows you to securely store and generate two-factor authentication codes for all your online accounts, directly on your device.
Key Features:
1. Secure and Private. All data within Authenticator is encrypted at all times, even when backed up to iCloud, ensuring that only you have access to your information.
2. Encrypted Backups. Easily create a secure, encrypted backup in Authenticator, safeguarding your data if you lose your device or switch to a new one.
3. Cross-Device Sync. Authenticator automatically syncs your accounts across all Apple devices, including your Apple Watch.
4. Quick Access Widget. Use the Authenticator widget for fast access to your 2FA codes right from your Home Screen.
5. Apple Watch and Touch ID Unlock. Unlock the app instantly using Apple Watch or Touch ID for quicker access.
6. Menu Bar Integration. Keep Authenticator accessible directly from your Menu Bar.
7. Offline Code Generation. Even when offline, Authenticator generates secure codes, allowing you to authenticate safely even in airplane mode.
8. Easy Multi-Account Import. You can seamlessly import accounts from Google Authenticator, Password Managers, or Files.
9. Designed for Apple Devices. Enjoy a fully native experience on all Apple devices with features like Data Sync, Gestures, Widgets, and Dark Mode.
10. Support for Major Services. Authenticator supports major platforms like Facebook, Coinbase, Amazon, Gmail, Instagram, Roblox, and thousands more, including 8-digit tokens.

Payment is charged to your iTunes Account upon purchase confirmation.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends.
You can manage your subscriptions and disable auto-renewal through your App Store account settings, up to 24 hours before the next payment is due.

bluejetty:00180470:ios.description:
Your all-in-one Athan and daily prayer companion
Stay connected to your faith with a beautifully designed app that provides accurate prayer times, personalized Athan notifications, and helpful Islamic tools for daily worship. Whether you are at home, at work, or travelling, the app helps you stay consistent with prayer and connected to your faith.
Key features
- Accurate prayer times 
Prayer times are automatically adjusted to your location and can be configured using your preferred calculation method, school of thought, and angle settings.
- Visual and audio Athan alerts 
Receive timely Athan reminders with a selection of audio options and clear visual notifications.
- The Holy Quran 
Read the full Quran with Arabic text, translations, and optional transliteration. Continue reading and reflecting wherever you are.
- Tasbih counter 
Track your dhikr with a simple digital Tasbih designed for daily remembrance and focused sessions.
- Qibla compass 
Find the direction of the Kaaba with an animated compass and map, especially useful while travelling.
- Hijri calendar 
Follow important Islamic dates, including Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, and Eid al-Adha.
- Daily duas from Hisn’ul Muslim 
Explore authentic supplications organized by category and bookmark your favourites for quick access.
- Names of Allah and Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) 
Learn the 99 names of Allah and the names of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), together with their meanings and translations.
Download the app to support your daily worship with accurate prayer times, Athan reminders, Quran access, Qibla guidance, and other essential Islamic tools.
Try Premium free for 3 days
Access the full range of Premium features with a 3-day free trial. After the trial, the subscription renews as a monthly plan unless cancelled. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time from your device settings. Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased.

bluejetty:00014783:ios.name: SWOODOO: Flüge, Hotels & Autos
bluejetty:00014783:ios.summary:
SWOODOO durchsucht Hunderte von Reise-Websites und zeigt dir Optionen an. So kannst du wählen, was am besten zu deinem Trip passt. Beobachte Preise, lege ein Budget fest, stelle deinen Reiseplan zusammen und mehr.
DAS BIETET UNSERE APP.
•
bluejetty:00014783:ios.description:
SWOODOO durchsucht Hunderte von Reise-Websites und zeigt dir Optionen an. So kannst du wählen, was am besten zu deinem Trip passt. Beobachte Preise, lege ein Budget fest, stelle deinen Reiseplan zusammen und mehr.
DAS BIETET UNSERE APP.
• Sichere dir den gewünschten Flug: Vergleiche Flugoptionen von Hunderten Websites und grenze sie mithilfe unserer Filter auf die für dich passendsten ein.
• Hotelpreise nur in der App. Finde Mobile Deals für ausgewählte Hotels.
• Car -Sharing: Suche neben klassischen Anbietern auch nach Car-Sharing – für mehr Optionen und eventuell bessere Preise.
• Erfahre, wenn sich Preise ändern: Beobachte Suchergebnisse für deinen Trip und lass dich bei Preisänderungen benachrichtigen.
• Suche innerhalb deines Budgets: Du kannst nur 300 € ausgeben? SWOODOO Explore zeigt dir deine Flugoptionen – passend zu jedem Budget.
NUR IN DER SWOODOO APP.
• Flugstatus: Erhalte einen Alarm, wenn sich an deinem Flug etwas ändert, oder beobachte Flüge, um zu sehen, ob du es zu deinem Anschlussflug schaffst.
• Trips offline: Alle deine in Trips geladenen Ticketbestätigungen und Reservierungen sind zugänglich – egal, ob du gerade WLAN hast oder nicht.
• Miss dein Gepäck: Richte deine Kamera auf deine Tasche oder deinen Handgepäckkoffer. Wir teilen dir dann mit, ob das Gepäck die richtige Größe hat, sodass keine Gebühr anfällt.
WIR LIEBEN FEEDBACK.
Du hast eine Frage und brauchst Unterstützung? Schicke uns unter https://www.SWOODOO.com/help eine Nachricht und wir helfen dir gerne weiter.
MEHR ZUM ANGEBOT VON SWOODOO.
Finde Flüge, Hotels, Ferienunterkünfte, Mietwagen und mehr – filtere dann anhand der für dich wichtigsten Kriterien. Wie etwa ein haustierfreundliches Boutique-Hotel mit Pool. Oder eine 4-türige Limousine mit Anmietung am Flughafen, mit der du sofort mobil bist. Wir bringen tolle Angebote von deinen bevorzugten Reise-Websites an einem Ort zusammen.
DUCHSUCHE HUNDERTE FLUG-WEBSITES AUF EINMAL.
Dank Optionen zum Filtern und für Flexibilität kannst du schnell suchen und buchen, was am besten zu deinem Trip passt.
MEHR OPTIONEN, MEHR ERSPARNISSE.
Finde Mobile Deals und weitere exklusive Angebote in der App. Richte Preisalarme ein, um zu erfahren, wenn Preise für Flüge, Mietwagen und Hotels fallen, an denen du interessiert bist.
ERSTELLE DEN REISEVERLAUF SCHON BEIM PLANEN.
Unser Trips-Tool sammelt alle deine Pläne an einem Ort. Lass dich über Flug- und Gate-Änderungen benachrichtigen, greife on- oder offline auf Bordkarten zu und teile deinen Reiseverlauf im Freundeskreis – alles an einem Ort. Du kannst deinen Posteingang synchronisieren oder manuell beliebige Bestandteile deines Trips hinzufügen – von Bestätigungen für Ausflüge und Restaurants bis zu Notizen zu Sehenswürdigkeiten.
MIETWAGENANGEBOTE.
Suche für über 70.000 Stationen, um den perfekten Mietwagen zu finden. Buche ohne Risiko, indem du nach Richtlinien mit kostenloser Stornierung filterst.
BUCHE EIN HOTEL … ODER EIN ZUHAUSE.
Schau dir deine Unterkunftsoptionen von großen Hotelketten und Resorts bis hin zu lokalen Boutique-Hotels, Apartments, Hütten, Strandhäusern und mehr an. Filtere nach kostenloser Stornierung, falls du Sorge hast, dass sich deine Pläne ändern.
Plane deinen nächsten Trip mit SWOODOO. Lade jetzt die App herunter, um mit der Planung eines tollen Trips zu beginnen.
