bluejetty:00023538:ios.description:
Dinosaur Fire Truck Games - Firefighter Adventures for Kids!
Jump into exciting Fire Truck Games and let your child become the heroic dinosaur firefighter! Kids will drive their own Fire Engine, put out fires, and rescue adorable dinosaurs in danger.
Dinosaur Fire Truck Games blends Preschool Learning and fun puzzle-solving adventures. Perfectly designed as a Toddler Game, your little firefighter will learn about water physics, gravity, and creative problem-solving, all while exploring charming islands and exciting missions.
Game Highlights: 
• Fun Fire Truck for Kids, easy-to-control water cannons! 
• Firefighter Game with intuitive physics puzzles for curious minds. 
• Explore Fire Stations, Mines, Forests, and more—rich, captivating worlds await! 
• Safe and engaging Fire Rescue missions with no third-party ads. 
• Develop Fire Safety awareness through playful adventures. 
• Stimulate creativity and logic skills in exciting Kids Adventures.
Key Features: 
• Over 30 unique Fire Rescue levels designed especially for preschoolers! 
• 6 vibrant islands: sunny beaches, pastoral windmills, mysterious forests, machine factories, and thrilling chemical plants. 
• Imaginative villain vehicles: fiery dragon trucks, octopus trucks, drilling machines, and more! • 36 bonus quick-challenge levels—act fast and save the day! 
• Offline-friendly: play anytime, anywhere, even without the internet!
Parents, watch your child’s eyes sparkle with joy and pride as they become a Fire Truck Driver and bravely save their dinosaur friends. Dinosaur Fire Truck Games teaches valuable lessons about teamwork, Firefighter Simulation, and real-world physics—all wrapped in endless fun.
Ready, set, rescue! Your child's heroic firefighting adventure starts here!
About Yateland:
Yateland's educational apps ignite the passion for learning through play among preschool children worldwide. We stand by our motto: "Apps that children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, please visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Yateland is committed to protecting user privacy. To understand how we handle these matters, please read our complete privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00034089:ios.description:
Want to exercise your brain and solve logical puzzles in a screw puzzle game? Welcome to Screw Master: Color Nuts Jam!
Test your srcrew puzzle skills with nuts and bolts jam challenges in the new Screw Master: Color Nuts Jam! It's not just about unscrewing nuts—it's a test of your IQ level, strategy, and patience. 
Ready to become the master of Screw Puzzle? Take on the challenge now and explore this colorful screw pin puzzle world!
Challenge your problem-solving skills with "Color Nuts Jam", an exciting logic puzzle game. Navigate through puzzles filled with nuts and bolts, strategically deciding which screws to untangle first. Plan carefully as each move affects the puzzle's layout, ensuring smooth progression in this engaging screw jam bolts puzzle and unpuzzle experience.
As you progress, encounter increasingly complex logic puzzles that will test your timing and strategic thinking. Master each level by placing every screw correctly, and unlock new and stimulating challenges along the way!
FEATURES
Diverse Puzzle Layouts: 
• Progress from easy to challenging levels, each escalating in difficulty for a thrilling challenge!
• Encounter a variety of nuts and bolts—only those adept at screw pin jam puzzles can unravel the mysteries!
Logical Hints: 
Access useful tools to tackle the toughest nuts and bolts screw pin jam puzzles in our logic games, helping you "unscrew it!" when faced with challenges.
User-Friendly Interface: 
Enjoy clear visuals and seamless animations that enhance screw jam gameplay, with vibrant color jams for an immersive experience.
Scoring and Rewards: 
Earn points and unlock rewards as you advance, motivating you to solve screw puzzles effectively and achieve higher scores!
ASMR Screw Game: 
Beautiful design with satisfying in-game sounds of nuts and bolts. Immerse yourself in the tactile experience as you strategically pull the pin and solve intricate puzzles in this engaging nuts and bolts screw puzzle.
Test Your IQ: 
Challenge your mind with "Screw Master: Color Nuts Jam"! Solve intricate screw pin jams, strategize your moves, and unlock rewards as you progress. Prove your puzzle-solving prowess today!
HOW TO PLAY
• Unscrew each board in the correct sequence to lower them one by one.
• Strategically plan your moves to manipulate nuts and bolts and overcome all screw pin jam puzzles.
• Fill each screw box with screws of the same color; complete all to win.
• Use multiple boosters to effectively unlock screws and handle tough situations.
Experience the thrill of "Screw Master: Color Nuts Jam", where quick thinking and precise moves are key to solving the screw pin-jam puzzle. Master the art of unscrewing nuts and bolts and maneuvering pins to conquer each level with satisfaction. Whether you're challenging yourself or enjoying leisurely play, this screw pin jam puzzle game offers exciting fun for all ages. Download our screw pin jam puzzle game now to start unraveling puzzles and mastering the art of unscrewing!
We sincerely hope you can have an enjoyable screw puzzle experience in Screw Master: Color Nuts Jam! Our screw pin puzzle game team is always working to optimize the unscrew puzzle game's features and your experience. So if you've run into any issues about our logic games while playing or have any suggestions, please don’t hesitate to contact us at ScrewMaster2024@outlook.com.

bluejetty:00150675:ios.description:
California CDL Prep Test:
The California CDL Prep Test is a comprehensive study tool designed to help individuals prepare for the California Commercial Driver License (CDL) exam. This app provides users with an interactive and engaging way to study for the CDL exam. The app covers all of the key topics, including:
* Vehicle inspection
* Vehicle control
* Air Brakes
* Hazardous Materials
* Transportation of passengers
The app includes a variety of practice questions for the CDL exam. These questions are based on the California Commercial Driver handbook. Users can track their progress and identify areas where they need more practice, allowing them to focus their studying on the areas where they need the most improvement.
App tracks the users completed practice tests. The app tracks their progress, allowing them to identify areas for improvement and track their overall progress. 
You should be able to "bookmark" questions so that you can study them later.
In addition, the app provides a list of weak questions based on practice tests on CDL Prep Test.
In the California CDL Permit Practice Test, there are multiple-choice questions. You must correctly answer questions based on the passing marks or mistakes allowed for that particular test.
Features:
- Study and Practice tests
 - Driving rules
 - Knowledge test
 - Air Brakes - Combination
 - Bus Endorsement
 - Hazmat Endorsement
 - Double Endorsement - Tank Endorsement
 - Passenger Endorsement
- Bookmark questions
- Preview answers after the test is submitted.
- Resume and Restart the test
- Questions with explanation
- Keep Track of Your Progress
- List of Weak/Wrong Questions for Improvement
- Review Previous tests
- Appearance ( Auto / Light / Dark )
- Test
 - Result on-the-spot with score
 - Review test questions with answers and filter about right and wrong answers
The California CA CDL Prep Test app is user-friendly and accessible, allowing individuals to study and prepare for the California DMV CDL exam.
The app aims to provide individuals with a comprehensive and convenient study resource to help them pass the CDL exam and obtain their commercial driver's license in California. Whether you are a first-time CDL candidate or a seasoned professional, this app is an essential tool for passing the California CDL exam and achieving your commercial driver's license.
Content Source
Our app includes a variety of practice questions for the Driver's license exam for Commercial Vehicles. These questions are based on the official handbook of different states.

This app is simply a fantastic tool for self-study and exam preparation. It has no affiliation with or endorsement from any government organisation, certificate, test, name, or trademark.

bluejetty:00131841:ios.description:
Free 90-day trial!
Add your sheet music, guitar tabs, fake books, and scores, and leave your paper behind. Organize, annotate, practice, and perform with the most powerful yet easy-to-use music viewer and manager.
Whether you’re a student or teacher, whether you play in a band, sing in a choir, or gig on the weekends, and no matter what your style of music is, you can count on the app’s reliability for live performances and go paperless with confidence.
Build Your Library
• Import PDF files from the Files app, a web browser, or from many other apps and sources.
• Scan your music with the camera-based document scanner.
• Import images from the Photos app.
Organize Your Music
• Describe and classify your music in great detail with information like title, composer, artist, genres, tags, instruments, key, duration, time signature, rating, difficulty, tempo, web link, and notes.
• Add scores with multiple movements or books with multiple songs, then organize them into sections.
• Create collections to make groups of music, such as setlists, virtual binders, or books.
• Easily find the music and collections you’re looking for with filters. With a few taps, for example, you can see all music that’s in a major key with a 4/4 or 6/8 time signature, having a tempo between 120 - 135 beats per minute.
• Create smart folders to automatically keep your music and collections organized.
Add Audio Tracks
• Add tracks from the Music app.
• Record your own audio.
• Import audio files.
• Adjust pitch and playback speed.
• Turn pages automatically while audio plays.
Stay In Tune
• Tune your instrument using the device microphone.
• Generate a tone using a variety of instruments and sounds.
• Adjust the A4 frequency.
• Select from 10 temperaments to customize the tuning.
Practice and Perform
• View music in portrait or landscape mode.
• Scroll music horizontally or vertically.
• Turn pages by swiping, moving the slider, using a Bluetooth page turner, tapping the edge of the screen, following a link, making a facial gesture, or playing audio that has automatic page turning enabled. (Facial gestures require a device with a TrueDepth camera.)
• Create links to jump or scroll to another page. Links are great for music with repeats or codas. They also allow music to be automatically scrolled with precise timing.
• Use the pencil and highlighter tools to write on music with your finger or with the Apple Pencil. All Apple Pencil settings are supported.
• Add text with options for size, rotation, color, font, and justification.
• Choose from a wide selection of symbols and shapes to add fingerings, dynamics, accidentals, and more.
• Use the low-latency metronome with options for sound, visuals, accent, and count off.
See More with Second Screen
• Connect two devices and see more of your music.
• When viewing music on the main device, it will extend onto the other device’s screen.
Share and Back Up
• Share your music and collections with other Paperless Music users, with or without your annotations or audio tracks.
• Share music in native format to preserve all information, or share in PDF format for general sharing and printing.
• Create a backup of your library to keep your data extra safe and to easily transfer everything to other devices.
And Much More
• Set the page color of your music.
• Undo changes made to any page while the viewer is open.
• Choose from six library view modes for music and three modes for collections.
• Batch edit genres, tags, and instruments.
• Adjust the text size in the Settings app to boost or shrink the size of text throughout Paperless Music.
• Search using Spotlight. Find and launch right into your music even when the app isn’t running.
Learn more by reading the integrated, searchable user guide, accessible from the app’s home screen and from the website.
Paperless Music has no ads and no subscriptions. There is no sign-in and there are no accounts.
www.paperlessmusic.com

숫자로 보여주는 다른 어플 들과는 다릅니다.

미세미세가 여러분의 건강을 지켜 드리겠습니다!
날씨 정보도 함께 보여드려 편하게 이용하실 수 있습니다.
가장 정확한 현재 날씨, 시간별 예보, 일별 예보 정보를 약속드립니다!
일시적으로 마스크 알리미 기능도 추가하였습니다.
이제 어느 약국에 마스크가 있는지 미리 알아보고 가세요~
전화 연결도 가능합니다!
항상 마스크 꼭 착용하시고 매일매일 건강한 하루 보내세요!
주요 기능:
+ 미세먼지 실시간 농도 (PM10 & 황사)
+ 초미세먼지 실시간 농도 (PM2.5)
+ 미세먼지 예보 (PM10 & 황사)
+ 통합대기 환경지수 실시간 측정 값
+ 황사, 오존, 이산화질소, 일산화탄소, 이황산가스 실시간 측정 값
+ 모든 측정소 초미세먼지 정보 제공 - 초미세먼지 값 미제공 측정소일 시, 가장 가까운 측정소 값으로 대체함
+ 위젯
+ 미세먼지가 나빠질 시 알람/경보 기능
+ 미세먼지가 좋아질 시 알람/경보 기능
+ 전국 미세먼지 지도
+ 날씨 - 실시간
+ 날씨 - 시간별 예보, 일별 예보
+ 날씨 - 일별 예보
자료출처:
- 환경부 한국환경공단 (에어코리아)
- 안양대학교 기후에너지환경융합연구소 (소장: 환경에너지공학과 구윤서 교수)
- 기상청
- 서울특별시 대기 환경 정보
- 인천광역시 보건 환경 연구원
- 경기도 대기오염 정보 센터
- 부산광역시 보건 환경 연구원
미세미세 어플을 이용해 주셔서 감사합니다.
***** 접근 권한 안내 *****
▶ 필수적 접근 권한
- 없음 
▶ 선택적 접근 권한
- 위치: 현위치 미세먼지 & 날씨 정보 전송을 위해 사용
▶ 접근 권한 철회 방법
- 설정 > 개인 정보 보호 > 위치 서비스 > 앱 선택 > 접근 권한 철회 가능

CONTACTLESS ENTRY

bluejetty:00038246:ios.description:
The features in our app are designed for you to get the most from your membership and help you fully maximise your experience at The Gym Group. 
Download now to get the following features: 
CONTACTLESS ENTRY 
Gain quick and easy access to your gym by scanning the QR code with your app. 
PLAN YOUR VISIT 
Check the real-time capacity of your gym using both the number of people and the percentage capacity to help you plan your visit. 
BOOK AND MANAGE CLASSES 
You can book any available classes at your gym through the app as well as managing all your existing bookings and organising face to face inductions or PT taster sessions. 
WORKOUT HUB 
Find a range of workouts tailored to your needs with personalised workout recommendations. Whether you are just starting out or looking to mix up your routine, the Workout Hub has something for everyone. 
The app also connects to HealthKit so you can track your activity from your device or wearable. 
If you prefer to follow your own routine, customise and create the perfect workout with the create your own workout feature using our extensive exercise library. The Hub also includes links to helpful videos that explain how to perform exercises. 
ON-DEMAND FIIT WORKOUT VIDEOS

bluejetty:00169193:ios.description:

What is an eSIM?
An eSIM is a virtual SIM for your iPhone. There’s no tiny plastic card to swap — just install the eSIM profile once, and you’re ready to connect wherever your trip takes you. 
Why Saily?
No roaming fees: Get affordable prepaid mobile data instead of surprise carrier charges.
200+ destinations: Mobile data from the top local networks around the world.
Instant setup: Install your eSIM in minutes, right from your phone.
Keep your number: Your primary line stays active for calls and texts.
Flexible plans: Pick from local or multi-destination data plans.
Top up anytime: Add more mobile data in a few taps, wherever you are.
Track your usage: Keep an eye on your eSIM data usage, all in one app.
Built-in security features: Browse more safely with the Ad blocker and Web protection.
NordVPN pedigree: Built by a team with years of digital security experience.
Perfect for every traveler
Business trips: Join meetings and send emails with reliable cellular data. 
Digital nomads: Run a mobile hotspot and work from 200+ destinations with fast data speeds. 
Vacationers: Post photos and navigate new streets without worrying about connectivity. 
Group travelers: Share your data with up to 4 travel buddies using shared plans.
How it works
Install the app: Download the Saily eSIM app and pick your destination.
Pick a plan: Select a prepaid mobile data plan for your trip.
Set up your eSIM: Follow the on-screen steps to install the eSIM profile.
Get online: Your data plan will start the moment you land.

Stream shows, map your route, or work remotely — all on mobile data, without buying a local SIM card or relying on public Wi-Fi.
Optional US phone number
Get a dedicated US second number (+1) directly in the Saily app from US$0.99/month, and add flexible call and text plans whenever you need them.
Stay connected at sea
Sailing on a cruise? Regular data won’t work in open waters — grab a Saily cruise plan to stay online aboard select cruise lines.

Pay only for the prepaid eSIM data you need, or upgrade to a flexible Saily Ultra subscription. No long-term contracts or unexpected roaming charges on your next bill.
Compatibility and support
Most recent iPhone models support eSIM technology. If you run into questions about setup, coverage, or your data plan, the Saily support team is ready to help 24/7.

Pick a mobile data plan that fits your trip and connect the moment you arrive, with transparent pricing and no roaming surprises!

bluejetty:00034826:ios.description:
shaep is your at home, guided strength x Pilates program designed to help you build a strong, lean, sculpted body with structure that actually delivers results.
Inside the app, you follow a proven method that combines strength training to build shape with Pilates to refine, lengthen, and improve posture. Every workout is intentional, progressive, and designed to support real body recomposition so you can feel stronger, tighter, and more confident without needing a gym.
Beyond workouts, shaep supports your results through simple, high protein nutrition and a grounded approach to wellness. You will have access to meal plans, recipe guides, and new recipes added regularly to help you fuel your body without restriction or overwhelm. Mindfulness is also woven into the experience through breathwork and meditations that support recovery, reduce stress, and keep you consistent long term.
Everything inside shaep is designed to work together so you are not guessing what to do next. You have structure, guidance, and a clear path to results.
shaep membership includes:

- Monthly challenges and structured weekly schedules
- New workout series added regularly
- Breathwork, meditation, and mindfulness sessions

- Community support and exclusive member access

bluejetty:00026487:ios.description:
Join 5 million people and start building bridges by learning ASL with the most popular sign language learning app.

bluejetty:00120496:ios.name: Prepare for Impact
bluejetty:00120496:ios.developer: Dipartimento di Matematica e Informatica - Universita' degli Studi di Udine
bluejetty:00120496:ios.summary: This 3D game has been developed in the context of an international, aviation safety research project (http://hcilab.uniud.it/aviation), aimed at exploring possible new approaches to safety education, and featured on important media such as
bluejetty:00120496:ios.description:
This 3D game has been developed in the context of an international, aviation safety research project (http://hcilab.uniud.it/aviation), aimed at exploring possible new approaches to safety education, and featured on important media such as TIME, Popular Mechanics, Discovery Channel, and Fox News (see http://hcilab.uniud.it/aviation/media.html).
Prepare for Impact is the world-first game that reproduces the experience of real aircraft emergencies from the passenger’s viewpoint, with the highest fidelity allowed by today’s mobile devices. In each virtual emergency experience, the player can try first-hand right and wrong actions that a passenger can take, and see the positive or negative consequences those actions have.
Your goal is to take all the right decisions to come out from the plane unharmed as fast as possible.
The different levels of "Prepare for Impact" depict major types of emergencies, such as in-flight decompression, ground collision, runway overrun, water landing, crash landing, rejected take-off, and fumes in the cabin. Moreover, they are able to simulate the different threats that can make aircraft evacuation more complex, such as fire, smoke in the cabin, water, unusable exits, and others. The latest version of the app also includes a level editor that allows players to create personalized evacuation scenarios.
The game also offers the option of publishing your best evacuation results on world leaderboards.

bluejetty:00014084:ios.name: F.A.Z. - Nachrichten
bluejetty:00014084:ios.summary: Mit der kostenfreien F.A.Z.-App sind Sie überall und jederzeit umfassend informiert: Minutenaktuelle und verlässliche Nachrichten sowie eine fundierte und unabhängige Berichterstattung geben einen umfassenden Überblick zum Geschehen in Deut
bluejetty:00014084:ios.description:
Mit der kostenfreien F.A.Z.-App sind Sie überall und jederzeit umfassend informiert: Minutenaktuelle und verlässliche Nachrichten sowie eine fundierte und unabhängige Berichterstattung geben einen umfassenden Überblick zum Geschehen in Deutschland und der Welt. 
Die App deckt alle F.A.Z.-Ressorts ab und bietet Ihnen Hintergrundberichterstattung, Analysen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven und kontroverse Standpunkte – sowohl von unseren zahlreichen Redakteuren und Korrespondenten als auch von renommierten Gastautoren. Zusätzlich bringen Bilderstrecken, Videos und Storytellings Sie noch näher ans Geschehen
---------------------------------
Das bietet die F.A.Z.-App Ihnen:
• SOFORT INFORMIERT: Top-aktuelle Nachrichten überall und jederzeit verfügbar. Tauchen Sie ein in Hintergründe, Analysen, Kommentare und Interviews – alles in der gewohnten Qualität der Frankfurter Allgemeinen Zeitung!
• MEINE F.A.Z.: Entdecken Sie Ihren persönlichen Bereich mit speziell für Sie zusammengestellten Inhalten auf Basis Ihrer Lesegewohnheiten. Folgen Sie Ihren Lieblingsautoren, speichern Sie Ihre Favoriten in Ihren Merkzettel und greifen Sie jederzeit bequem darauf zu. Ihre Lesehistorie ermöglicht es Ihnen, blitzschnell zurückzublicken und Ihre Lieblingsartikel erneut zu lesen.
• INDIVIDUALISIERBAR: Gestalten Sie die App nach Ihren Vorlieben mit Einstellungen wie Schriftgröße sowie Tag- oder Nachtmodus.
• KI-ZUSAMMENFASSUNG: Das wichtigste auf einen Blick! Mit unserem neuen Feature bekommen Sie unsere Artikel prägnant und relevant zusammengefasst.
• AUDIO: Erweitern Sie Ihr Leseerlebnis auditiv und lassen Sie sich Ihre Artikel bequem vorlesen, sei es beim Autofahren, beim Kochen oder beim Sport.
• PODCAST: Ob täglich kurz informiert oder tiefgehende Hintergründe zu ausgewählten Themen – unsere Podcasts bieten Ihnen hochwertige Inhalte und spannende Diskussionen.
• CARPLAY: Nutzen Sie unsere App nahtlos über CarPlay, um auch während der Fahrt einfach und sicher auf die Inhalte zugreifen zu können. Konzentrieren Sie sich auf das Wesentliche, ohne Ihr Smartphone zur Hand nehmen zu müssen.
• NEWS-WIDGET: Mit den Live-Nachrichten auf Ihrem Homescreen haben Sie immer einen schnellen und direkten Zugriff auf aktuelle Nachrichten und Informationen.
---------------------------------
IN-APP-ABONNEMENT
Nach Ablauf der Testphase verlängert sich Ihr FAZ+ Abonnement automatisch zum Abo-Preis Ihrer gewählten Laufzeit. Sie können Ihr Abo jederzeit in den App Store-Einstellungen (unter „Abonnements") kündigen. Ihr Account wird innerhalb von 24 Stunden vor Beginn einer neuen Laufzeit belastet. Wenn Sie das Abo bis mindestens 24 Stunden vor Ablauf der Gratisphase kündigen, wird keine Abo-Gebühr fällig.
Datenschutz: www.faz.net/datenschutz
Nutzungsbedingungen: www.faz.net/nutzungsbedingungen
Die Zufriedenheit unserer Nutzer liegt uns am Herzen. Wenn Sie Fragen oder Anregungen zur App haben, wenden Sie sich bitte an digital@faz.de. Sollte Ihnen die App gefallen, freuen wir uns natürlich auch über eine Bewertung im App Store!

bluejetty:00070726:ios.name: Helicopter Flight Pilot Sim
bluejetty:00070726:ios.summary: Get ready to fly real helicopters in one of the best helicopter flying simulator experiences! Explore huge open-world scenery from the sky and ground below in a wide range of vehicles to fly and drive. From helicopters to airplanes, to cars
bluejetty:00070726:ios.description:
Get ready to fly real helicopters in one of the best helicopter flying simulator experiences! Explore huge open-world scenery from the sky and ground below in a wide range of vehicles to fly and drive. From helicopters to airplanes, to cars to boats!
More than 50 vehicles are controllable.
Try out the all-new base jumping activities, go to high points in the world, jump-off with the exciting paraglider! Why not get to even higher heights in your helicopter and get the world record by jumping out and opening your parachute!
Play the ultimate flying, car and boat driving simulator right here!
Explore scenery and airports in high resolution with satellite maps, 3D buildings, runways, air traffic, weather conditions, and true volumetric clouds.
More than 150 km² of the area!
!!HFPS - Helicopter Flight Pilot Simulator is the ultimate helicopter flying simulation with 20 free levels!!
One of the best heli simulator games with dynamic weather conditions; fly through clear blue skies, tropical rain, snow, thunderstorms, wind, turbulence, and true 3d volumetric clouds!
Fly helicopters and planes across the huge open-world environment and explore its unique locations. Take off from multiple airports, commute from international airports to small campaign airports, and helipads spread throughout the world!
With tons of exciting points of interest to visit, from the air or the road, and even all new sea vehicles like boats and jetskis, you have the ultimate freedom to explore anywhere in the whole world!
Drive fast cars on the open roads, from 2x2 lanes to very small offroad road of mountains, with hill climb and canyon. Explore the world not just by flying, but with real car driving simulator experiences as well!
Take part in helicopter flight levels by walking into mission markers located throughout the world. Simply walk into the marker to begin the mission like any familiar open-world style gameplay.
Use the helpful minimap to know where are the missions spots. Expand to see the whole map by pressing on it. Fly across the open-world and explore for hours in one of the best airplane flying simulation games!
Action packed missions!:
- Random flight problems (landing gear problems, engine failure, etc.) to test real piloting situations
- Base jump from the top of mountains onto landing pads
- Transport very important passengers
- Clear the way for traffic from the sky with rocket
- Transport broken down vehicles to the scrapyard!
- Put out the fire with firefighter action!
- Stop criminals stealing aircraft in police vs robbers flying
- Emergency landing procedure in airplanes and helicopters
- Control your aircraft during a storm
- Race against helicopters, boats, and more!
- Do basejump from roof. Become a pro basejumper with your paraglider
- Fire rockets to remove all the objects and clear the road with your apache or supercobra
Features:
- Weather systems: clear sky, rain, thunderstorms, snow
- Day and night cycle
- True 3D volumetric cloud system
- Flight turbulence
- Realistic helicopter and plane flight physics
- All-new boat driving and watercraft experiences
- Intuitive flying controls: buttons, joystick, or accelerometers
- Vehicle crashes and smoke effects.
- Highly detailed realistic airplane cockpit environment.
- Huge selection of aircraft and airline
- Thrill-seeker's new base jumping activities!
- Miles of roads to drift and drive on and do stunt jumps
52 controllable vehicles:
- 15 helicopters, like Bell 206, Eurocopter EC135, Apache, Mil Mi-8, SuperCobra, Bell UH-1 Huey
- 18 aircrafts, like Cesna, Piper PA-46, Boeing 747, Airbus A380, F14, Hawk
- 10 boats, like Jetski, Yacht, Vedette, Offshore
- 9 cars, like SUV, 4x4, sport and racing car
The latest and one of the best challenging games. Become the ultimate Helicopter flight pilot in the all-new simulator gaming sensation, Helicopter Flight Pilot Simulator!

bluejetty:00116851:ios.summary:
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a lightning‑fast remote for any Smart TV—no more juggling remotes, no more dead batteries.
Meet Universal TV Remote Control, the easiest way to command every TV in your home (and hotel room!) from one sleek ap
bluejetty:00116851:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a lightning‑fast remote for any Smart TV—no more juggling remotes, no more dead batteries.
Meet Universal TV Remote Control, the easiest way to command every TV in your home (and hotel room!) from one sleek app. Simply connect your iOS device to the same Wi‑Fi network as the TV and you’re ready to tap, swipe, or speak your way to perfect control.
Key Features
Instant Pairing – Auto‑discovers all compatible TVs on your Wi‑Fi network in seconds.
Complete Remote Layout – Power, volume, channels, input switch, and quick‑launch app buttons—beautifully arranged for one‑hand use.
Smart Trackpad & Gestures – Swipe to navigate menus or use two‑finger scrolling on compatible TVs.
Built‑in Keyboard – Type search terms and passwords on your phone instead of pecking at on‑screen keys.
Dynamic Island & Lock‑Screen Widgets – Change volume or pause playback without unlocking your device.
Multiple‑TV Profiles – Save and rename every set in the house (or office) for instant switching.
Dark & Light Modes – Adapts to your system theme for effortless viewing at night.
How It Works:
— Make sure your TV and iPhone/iPad are on the same Wi‑Fi network.
— Open the app; your TV appears instantly.
— Tap to pair—done! No extra hardware, IR blaster, or cables required.
Why You’ll Love It:
— Zero Lag – Commands are sent over Wi‑Fi for near‑instant response.
— Travel Friendly – Works on hotel networks that allow device discovery.
— Energy Saver – Uses a fraction of the power of an infrared remote.
— Privacy First – We never collect your viewing data or personal content.
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EHaJ-Fw5iM2cexKKxs4RVH1dcmdMD20iLYV_IQ27mho/edit?usp=sharing
End‑User License Agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: oriummastin@gmail.com

bluejetty:00041412:android.summary:
Ever felt like some emotions can only be expressed in a specific tongue? Welcome to your immersion.
This is the sanctuary where learners meet, practice, and master Bangla through live voice, video, and cultural exchange—connecting directly
bluejetty:00041412:android.description:
Ever felt like some emotions can only be expressed in a specific tongue? Welcome to your immersion.
This is the sanctuary where learners meet, practice, and master Bangla through live voice, video, and cultural exchange—connecting directly with fluent speakers who bring the "Language of Poets" to life. No robotic translations or stiff textbooks. Just real conversations with people who help you speak Bangla with heart, not just grammar.
Whether you’re mastering the soft vowels of Dhaka, the sophisticated dialects of Kolkata, or simply trying to order puchka like a local—every interaction is a step toward true fluency.
Your Path to the Heart of Bengal
Every linguist started with a single Bondhu (Friend).
 • ✒️ Verse 1 — Start the Alap (Introduction) Select your level and match with a fluent speaker ready to share the beauty of the script and speech.
 • 🎙️ Verse 2 — Hear the Omiya (Nectar) Take the conversation further with instant voice calls. Master the specific intonations and the "sweetness" that defines Bangla.
 • 📹 Verse 3 — Face the Adda Switch to video for a "digital Adda"—the classic Bengali tradition of long, soul-stirring intellectual conversation.
 • ☕ Verse 4 — Share the Culture Discuss Rabindrasangeet, cinema, the best Biryani spots, and the idioms that make the language so rich.
 • ✨ Verse 5 — Your Story Continues Every chat builds more than just a vocabulary; it builds a bridge to a culture that treats guests like family.
Why Learners Choose Us
 • ⭐ Direct Access to Natives Skip the AI. Connect with real people from West Bengal and Bangladesh who speak the language of today.
 • 🎨 Built for Cultural Depth Focused on the nuances, the literature, and the regional slang that apps usually ignore.
 • ⚡ Real-Time Connection Seamlessly switch between chat, voice, and video to practice your pronunciation in the moment.
 • 🌍 Discover the Delta Meet speakers from across the globe and hear the subtle shifts in dialect from Sylhet to Chittagong.
 • 🔒 A Supportive Shongshari (Community) We maintain a respectful, encouraging space for every learner to find their voice.

To set up your Halo/Router network, simply plug one of your Halo/Router units into your modem and follow the instructions in the MERCUSYS app. The app also helps you find the best spots in your home to place additional Halo units.

- Sharing your guest network with visitors
- Viewing which devices are connected to your Wi-Fi
- Restricting access to websites of your choosing
- Setting a time restriction and pause the Wi-Fi on kids' devices
- Controlling when certain devices have Wi-Fi access
- Picking which devices get Wi-Fi priority
- Adding a family member as a network manager to help you monitor your network
MERCUSYS App has met EAA requirements.

bluejetty:00123682:ios.description:
Play the world's best bird flinging, pig popping game!
Use the slingshot to fling birds at the piggies' towers and bring them crashing down – all to save the precious eggs.
New to the world of Angry Birds? Angry Birds 2 is the best way to get to know all of the iconic characters and experience the fun gameplay that has captured the hearts (and spare time) of millions of players.
Decorated Angry Birds veteran? Everything you love about classic Angry Birds games is here with some awesome new additions. Choose which bird to fling when, play with friends, take on multi stage levels, and compete and collaborate with players around the globe.
Features:
● CHOOSE YOUR BIRD. Choose which bird to put in the slingshot and defeat the pigs with strategy! 
● MULTI-STAGE LEVELS. Play fun, challenging levels with multiple stages – just watch out for those Boss Pigs! 
● DAILY CHALLENGES. Have a minute? Complete a daily challenge and earn some quick rewards. 
● LEVEL UP your birds with feathers and up their scoring power. Build the ultimate flock! 
● JOIN A CLAN to take down the pigs with friends and players around the world. 
● IMPRESS THE MIGHTY EAGLE in Mighty Eagle's Bootcamp and earn coins to use in his exclusive shop. 
● COMPETE in the ARENA. Compete with other players for some friendly bird flinging fun and prove who is the best. 
● COLLECT SILLY HATS. Collect hats with different fun themes and level up your birds' fashion game. 
● BAD PIGGIES. The green baddies are back, stronger, badder, and even greener. 
● LOTS OF LEVELS. Play hundreds of levels with more added in regular updates and limited time events. 
● LEADERBOARDS. Prove who is the best in the world on the global leaderboards. 
● FREE to download! 
--- 
When playing this game, Rovio will offset the carbon footprint caused by the device’s energy consumption.
Angry Birds 2 is completely free to play. Although Angry Birds 2 can be downloaded for free, there are optional in-app purchases available. While our game is free to download and play, some game items can also be purchased for real money and the game may include loot boxes or other game mechanics with random rewards. Purchasing these items is optional but you can also disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings. 
This game may include: 
- Direct links to social networking websites that are intended for an audience over the age of 13. 
- Direct links to the internet that can take players away from the game with the potential to browse to any web page 
- Advertising of Rovio products and also products from third parties
This game may require internet connectivity and subsequent data transfer charges may apply. When the game is played for the first time, there is a one-off download of additional content.
Terms of Use: https://www.rovio.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.rovio.com/privacy
We may update the game periodically, for example to add new features or content or to fix bugs or other technical issues. Please note that the game may not function properly if you do not have the newest version installed. bluejetty:00082787:ios.description:
Pic Collage Maker & Photo Frame is a versatile mobile app that is easy to use. Choose photos from your app gallery to make a beautiful collage with this picture editor. It’s great for both new and pro photo editor. Edit photos by adding text, textures, filters, and frames. You can also use emojis, stickers, and drawing tools. 
AI Cutout lets you remove the background from your photo with one tap. It's great for photography, social media, and creative projects. Improve your photo editing skills with this background eraser. Download this photo grid maker and make your favorite designs!
Key Features Pic Collage Maker & Photo Editor:
- Mix up to 16 photos to create an amazing photo collage.
- Remove unwanted objects with the background eraser tool.
- Create collages with over 100 layouts for your photos.
- Change the pic collage ratio and adjust its border.
- A large number of photo frames, filters, and backgrounds.
- Ideal crop ratios for photo collage on social media.
- Add photo effects (such as Neon, Wing, Drip, Splash, Art, Motion, and Pixlab)
- Add text, emojis, stickers, and doodles using the picture editor.
- Create a scrapbook using this photo collage maker.
- Use the photo grid maker tool to split your photo.
- Use advanced editing tools to blend photos seamlessly.
- Make a unique design with Freestyle.
- Make stunning images using the template.
- Save the image in high resolution.
Pic Collage:
Create a collage of your favorite moments using this photo collage maker. Pick a a layout and combine up to 16 photos. You can arrange the photos and adjust the border of your collage. Then, apply filters and set the perfect ratio to create and share your photo collage.
Photo Grid:
Create a stylish photo grid with creative layouts and frames. Select the ratio for your image, such as: 1x2, 1x3, 2x1, 2x2, 2x3, 3×1, 3×2, 3×3, 3x4, 3x5, 3x6, 3x7, 3x8, 3x9, 3x10, etc. You can also create eye-catching Instagram grids or nine-cut designs for your posts using the photo grid maker.
Photo Editor:
Edit your photos with filters, text, stickers, emojis, and textures. You can also draw, crop, flip, rotate, and make adjustments. The picture editor supports many crop ratios, including 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9, 3:4, and 5:4.
Photo Frame:
Photo collage maker app has beautiful photo frames and picture effects. It will make your moments stunning. It has love, anniversary, holiday, and baby frames. Upgrade your picture editing creativity by using this collage maker & photo editor app.
Remove Background:

bluejetty:00040648:ios.description:
This mobile application is designed by a long-time Synology user for fellow Synology enthusiasts, providing an efficient way to manage DS tasks and monitor activity on Synology NAS devices.
This app is an independent third-party client and is not affiliated with Synology Inc.
Key features are:
• Presenting a list of NAS downloads
• Display detailed information on each download process
• Open links from Safari using Share menu
• Open magnet links from any browser
• Easy to add or remove downloads
• Sort and filter downloads
• Change downloads' properties
• Display detailed system information for the NAS itself and VPN connection status (Admin rights for account required)
• Display and change the key settings of Download Station application
• Access to the NAS using the DDNS service (whitelisted IP-address required)
• Access to the NAS using QuickConnect
• Two-factor authentication supported
• Search
• RSS
• Visual representation of the available disk space on your NAS (Admin and File Station access rights for the account required)
• Connection history with the option of iCloud synchronization across all user devices
• Widgets
What user rights are required for use:
• Access to Download Station – required
• Access to File Station – optional, to select the download folder and get the info about storage system. Please note that the user must have the default download folder set, otherwise tasks will not be added. You can set the default folder from the application in the Download Station settings (if you have access to File Station), or through the web version of Download Station in the settings.
• Administrator rights – optional. If the user has administrator rights, access to NAS system information such as VPN connection status, disk information, etc. will be available. In addition, a user without administrator rights can only see their own downloads. Downloads created by other users will not be displayed
All personal data is securely stored in the Keychain (iPhone, iCloud). No data of any kind, including anonymized data, is collected.
Synology NAS with DSM version 6.0+ and Download Station installed are required. Some features may only be available for Download Station version 4.0 or later.
Please direct any comments or suggestions to support@joinersoft.app. We appreciate your support and cooperation in advance!
Disclaimer:
This application does not host, provide, or promote any downloadable content or links.
Support for custom URL schemes and external connections is provided solely to allow users to manage their own systems, such as personal NAS devices.
All use of the application must comply with applicable laws and remains the sole responsibility of the user.
By downloading the application, you accept the Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

AI OPTIONS SIGNALS: SCALPS, SWINGS & LEAPS
• Scalps: fast momentum day trades for active traders
• Swings: multi-day setups for swing traders
• LEAPS: longer-term options for patient investors
• Every signal names the contract (strike and expiration), a buy target, three sell targets and a stop loss
• Push notifications for every BUY, SELL, HOLD, DCA and stop update, so you never miss an entry or exit
• Signal cards show Bid/Ask, Day High/Low, Volume and Open Interest, plus Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega and IV
• Past Performance tracks every closed signal and its max gain
• Signals are based on technical analysis, chart patterns, volume surges, market action and economic news

LIVE OPTION FLOW & UNUSUAL OPTIONS ACTIVITY
• Real-time options order flow: contract, price, premium and whether it traded at the ask or bid
• Spot sweeps, blocks and unusual flow where volume exceeds open interest
• Bullish and bearish flow color-coded at a glance
• Flow Alerts: Weekly, Repeaters, Unusual, Huge Flow ($1M+ sweeps) and ETF alerts
• Tap any alert to see every trade behind it
• Filter by premium size, sweeps or blocks, order side and expiration, or search any ticker

STOCK CHARTS & TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
• Interactive line and candlestick charts, from 1 day to max
• Short, medium and long-term technical outlook with RSI, MACD, SMA and EMA
• Support and resistance levels with a suggested stop loss
• Analyst ratings and 12-month price targets
• Key stats: market cap, P/E ratio, volume and 52-week range
• Earnings dates with EPS and revenue estimates, plus quarterly and annual financials

MARKET CALENDARS & RESEARCH
• Earnings Calendar: upcoming earnings reports
• Economic Calendar: Fed meetings, CPI, jobs reports and more
• IPO Calendar: upcoming and recent IPOs
• Insider Transactions: insider buying and selling from SEC filings
• Latest stock market news and headlines
• Watchlist to track your favorite stocks
• Stock search with today's trending tickers

LEARN OPTIONS TRADING
• Options Trading Guide: calls and puts, option Greeks, implied volatility and IV crush
• Interactive profit-and-loss charts and a leverage simulator: 10 call contracts vs. 100 shares with the same money
• See how much you can lose with options and why smaller positions protect your account
• Step-by-step guides to using AI signals and reading option flow

OPTION SIGNALS PREMIUM
Try it free with a sample of signals, flow and alerts. Upgrade to Premium for every Scalp, Swing and LEAPS signal, real-time alerts, the full day's option flow, all flow alerts and flow filters. Choose a monthly or yearly plan.

bluejetty:00091078:ios.name: Homely Property & Real Estate
bluejetty:00091078:ios.summary: The Homely Property & Real Estate app makes searching for properties for sale, for rent and that have sold across Australia easy and fast. Intuitive, quick to load and visually stunning, listings feature large, prominent pictures, videos, i
bluejetty:00091078:ios.description:
The Homely Property & Real Estate app makes searching for properties for sale, for rent and that have sold across Australia easy and fast. Intuitive, quick to load and visually stunning, listings feature large, prominent pictures, videos, interactive maps and also suburb reviews from real locals.
Add your favourite property to a Collection and invite your friends, family, or flatmates to share, rate and also comment on their favourite properties, homes, apartments or even holiday houses. 
With the Homely Property & Real Estate app be first to know when new properties/ homes go on sale or are available to rent in your desired suburbs with instant notifications and emails. The Homely Property & Real Estate app now also includes Suburb reviews that have been written by real locals to help you find your perfect suburb. 
Never miss an inspection or auction date with the Homely Property & Real Estate app when buying or renting with calendar integrations and reminders, you can also share it with your partner or flatmate.
The Homely Property & Real Estate app is the domain for everything you need to find your perfect home while on the go.
Key features of the Homely Property & Real Estate app:
• Find a home or property: Browse properties for sale, for rent and that have recently sold across Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Gold Coast, Newcastle, Canberra and the rest of Australia.
• Search every type of property: Houses, apartments, townhouses, units and more.
• Filter your search: Customise your search by price, bedrooms, bathrooms, pools, exclude properties under offer and other property features.
• Our famous suburb reviews: Access thousands of suburb reviews written by locals to help you find your perfect suburb for your new home. 
• Push Notifications and Emails: Save your favourite properties and searches, and receive instant or daily notifications when new properties hit the market.
• Sold Hub: Browse our sold hub with all the most recent properties that have sold via auction or private sales. Use the sold hub to research your suburb and find the perfect agent to help sell your home. 
• Build Collections: Whether you’re buying, renting, selling or just like looking at beautiful homes, it’s more fun with friends! Tap on the heart icon on a listing to add it to a Collection.
• Rate and Comment: Within your shared collection you can now rate and also comment on properties you add to your collection with friends and family. 
• Inspection and auction reminders: Easily add inspection and auction details to your personal calendar.
• Different ways to search: Use your current location (by GPS), draw on the map, type in multiple suburbs, include surrounding suburbs or postcodes including seeing the suburb map boundaries. 
• Photo galleries: View stunning photos is the perfect domain for all your photos and videos of beautiful homes with a simple tap and swipe.
• Maps: View properties and nearby amenities on a map view.
• School data: View the details of local schools and see their relative location on a map.
• Contact real estate agents: Find that property and get in touch with local real estate agents to enquire about your favourite properties in the Australian Real Estate landscape. 
We are always looking to improve the Homely Property & Real Estate app for you, so please write a review or send your feedback to feedback@homely.com.au

bluejetty:00152883:ios.name: Reverse Audio Play & Singing
bluejetty:00152883:ios.summary:
Reverse Audio Play & Singing is a powerful and easy-to-use voice recording app with a twist — it lets you reverse your voice and play it backwards.
Inspired by a viral trend on social media where people try to sing or speak phrases in reve
bluejetty:00152883:ios.description:
Reverse Audio Play & Singing is a powerful and easy-to-use voice recording app with a twist — it lets you reverse your voice and play it backwards.
Inspired by a viral trend on social media where people try to sing or speak phrases in reverse, this app brings that experience directly to your phone. Record your voice, play it normally, or flip it to hear how it sounds in reverse. Then challenge yourself or your friends to mimic the reversed version and see how close you can get when you flip it back.
Whether you’re just experimenting with sound, taking part in the reverse singing challenge, or creating unique audio content, this app makes it fun and effortless.
Record. Reverse. Repeat.
With just a few taps, you can:
Record high-quality audio using your phone’s microphone
Play back your recordings instantly
Reverse any recording to hear how it sounds backwards
Switch between normal and reversed playback at any time
Save and reuse your recordings for content, music, or fun
Explore sound in a new way
What does your name sound like in reverse?
Can you say a full sentence backwards and make it sound right when flipped?
How close can you get to singing a song in reverse — and making it sound normal again?
This app is more than just a voice recorder — it’s a creative audio playground. Perfect for musicians, voice artists, content creators, language learners, or anyone who loves to experiment.
Built for creators
Reverse Audio Play & Singing was designed to be fast, intuitive, and minimal. No signups, no clutter — just hit record and start playing. The interface is clean and focused, so you can jump right into what matters: capturing your voice and flipping it in seconds.
Social media meets sound design
What started as a fun challenge on TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels is now a creative tool in your hands. Whether you’re joining a trend, starting a new one, or just playing around, you’ll be surprised how entertaining and addictive reverse audio can be.
Download Reverse Audio Play & Singing today and discover what your voice sounds like in reverse.
Privacy Policy:
https://www.appatio.com/reverse-audio-privacy
Terms of Use:
https://www.appatio.com/reverse-audio-terms

bluejetty:00092431:ios.description:
O Defensoria RJ é o aplicativo que coloca a Defensoria Pública do Rio de Janeiro mais próxima de você. Neste mundo cada vez mais digital, é sempre bom poder acessar informações e serviços de maneira rápida e cômoda. Por isso, o app visa encurtar a distância e facilitar o contato entre o cidadão e a instituição.  
Basta instalar, se cadastrar com seus dados pessoais e fazer a verificação da sua identidade. O aplicativo estará à sua disposição para agendamento de atendimentos remotos e presenciais; encaminhamento de documentações; consulta, remarcação e cancelamento de agendamentos; interação entre os usuários e a Defensoria; além de acompanhamento e informações sobre processos, intimações e ações ajuizadas pelo órgão. 
Com esta nova ferramenta, ficará ainda mais fácil procurar os serviços da Defensoria e receber um retorno sobre o seu processo.  
O aplicativo vem para agregar na prestação de serviços da Defensoria e será mais um canal de acesso ao órgão junto ao 129, telefone do Centro de Relacionamento com o Cidadão (CRC) e as sedes espalhadas por todo o Estado.

bluejetty:00185510:ios.description:
With over 10 million downloads across the Sportsmate LIVE apps you know you’re in good hands.
The Footy Live app by Sportsmate is the only way to stay up to date on everything AFL. After debuting in 2009, Footy Live has continued to innovate while still putting the fans first, bringing you everything that you need to be the most in-the-know footy fan possible.
Built by footy fans, for footy fans, Footy Live combines up-to-the-second live scores and stats from the AFL, AFLW and all of the major state leagues (VFL, SANFL, WAFL, NEAFL) with the most in-depth statistical database, as well as exclusive analysis and the latest breaking footy news and video highlights. Not to mention Dreamteam scores updated instantly so you can follow your fantasy team throughout the weekend.
Whether it’s an intense Western Derby, the colour of a Showdown or the drama of the final quarter of the AFL Grand Final - don’t just follow your favourite club, join them!
FOLLOW LIVE
Access live coverage of every AFL and AFLW match plus selected state leagues including the VFL, WAFL, SANFL and NEAFL.
Live scores for each match
Play-by-play match commentary 
Detailed team stat sheets, match trends, team lists and shot maps
Player specific stat sheets, fantasy dreamteam scores and shot maps
TRACK YOUR FAVOURITE TEAM AND PLAYERS
Follow the progress of your club and your favourite players throughout the AFL season. 
Follow everything to do with your club in the dedicated Team News tab
Prepare for every match by syncing your clubs fixtures to your calendar
Stay up to date with the latest club news and team tweets
Keep an eye on your favourite players and their injury status
GET THE STATS
Need a hand with your fantasy team? Been thrown a thorny footy question? Need the perfect AFL trivia answer? Don’t worry we have you covered here too with a detailed database of team and individual player stats.
Up to date club and player stat rankings
Leaderboards for individual stats and KPIs 
Individual player profiles and career stats
Compare players head to head
Re-live players’ best (and worst) matches with our ‘time-machine’
STAY UP TO DATE
Footy Live by Sportsmate also brings you the breaking footy news, along with exclusive match previews (and tips) as well as analysis from Sportsmate’s team of commentators from around the country.
A thorough overview of the day’s play from around the country via the Match Day tab
Access footy news and updates about club teams
Watch and listen to videos and podcast series on demand
Personalise alerts so you never miss any of the action, footy scores or latest news
DOWNLOAD NOW
Footy Live by Sportsmate is available FREE for all football enthusiasts in Australia and around the world. Don’t miss a minute, download now and start tracking live footy scores today!
NEW FEATURES COMING SOON
We’re constantly releasing updates and improving our apps so we’d love to hear from you how we could make the Footy Live app even better. Please send all feedback to support@sportsmatemobile.com, tweet us at @Sportsmate or use the feedback form inside your app’s Settings. 
ABOUT THE DEVELOPERS
Founded in 2009 and based in Melbourne, Australia, Sportsmate Mobile is an Independent Sports Media company which creates and distributes mobile applications focused on delivering lightning fast sport scores and stats to sports fans all over the world.
With over 10 million global downloads, we are Australia's number one sports app network. Our growing suite of apps is built by a dedicated team of sports mad app developers, designers and content creators who are passionate about delivering content sports fans crave.

Track calories in seconds — just snap a photo. FitCounter uses AI to instantly recognize your meals, estimate nutrition, and log everything automatically. No more manual searching or guessing.
Whether your goal is weight loss, muscle gain, or maintaining a healthy lifestyle, FitCounter gives you the tools to succeed — with precision tracking, smart coaching, and zero ads.
WHY FITCOUNTER?
- AI-Powered Meal Tracking – Snap a photo and let AI identify your food, estimate calories and macros, and log your meal instantly.
- Barcode Scanner – Scan any product for instant, accurate nutrition data from thousands of foods.
- Smart Coach – Get personalized recommendations that adapt to your progress and keep you on track.
- Calorie & Macro Logging – Track proteins, carbs, fats, and calories with ease.
- Apple Health Integration – Sync weight, workouts, and dietary intake seamlessly.
- Hydration & Activity Tracking – Monitor water intake and log workouts effortlessly.
- Custom Goals – Set your own daily calorie and macro targets to match your personal plan.
WHAT MAKES FITCOUNTER DIFFERENT
No calorie compensation. Unlike other apps, FitCounter doesn't let you "earn" extra calories through exercise. Your nutrition plan stays consistent and science-backed.
- Food Quality Ratings – Check NutriScore & NOVA ratings instantly before you buy.
- Quick Meal Reuse – Easily re-log meals, recipes, and favorites with one tap.
- Built for Apple – Apple Sign-in, Apple Pay, and deep Health app integration.
- 100% Ad-Free – A clean, premium experience with no distractions.
Download FitCounter today and take control of your nutrition.

bluejetty:00077625:ios.description:
The News4JAX Weather Authority app offers a sleek and fluid map displaying real-time radar, temperature, and surface winds. Whether you're planning your week or just stepping out for the day, our app provides detailed 48-hour and 10-day forecasts tailored to your specific location, accessible by city, zip code or wherever you are. 
Key Features of the News4JAX Weather Authority App: 
- Live from The Weather Authority Office: Livestreams of the best meteorologist team, for up-to-the-minute coverage of weather impacting the region and your backyard. 
- Interactive Weather Maps: Better, more dynamic weather radar that is more interactive and easier to read. 
- Updates from the News4JAX Weather Authority Team: Get real-time insight, video forecasts and up-to-date analysis from our dedicated meteorologists 
- More Detailed Forecasts: Now including windspeed and direction! Get 3- and 10-day forecasts in both quick view and detailed formats, ensuring you're fully prepared no matter the weather. 
- Live Weather Alerts: Experience integrated weather alerts including tornado likelihood rankings from 1 to 10 for upcoming storm cells. 
- Customizable Notifications: Choose from News4JAX weather alerts and National Weather Service warnings for comprehensive alerting including tornadoes, severe thunderstorms and flash floods, directly on your map. 
- SnapJAX: Share and view photos and videos from your community and where events are taking place. Nothing is more powerful than the sights and sounds shared by our viewers, far beyond the forecasts and maps. 
- Dark Mode: A new visual option for easier nighttime viewing. Dark mode is enabled based on your device's settings. 
Beyond just forecasts, the News4JAX Weather Authority app offers fully automated, specific weather alerts with up to 15 minutes lead time before severe conditions hit. You can set up alerts for up to 16 locations, including your current mobile location, ensuring that you and your loved ones stay safe. 
Northeast Florida and southeastern Georgia, don't just watch the weather. Stay a step ahead with the News4JAX Weather Authority app. Download or update today, and take control of your weather experience. Your peace of mind is now at your fingertips.

- Create Your Personal Oasis: Build a vibrant oasis, celebrating every achievement in your spelling and vocabulary journey.
- Unlock Collections: Earn and collect beautiful illustrations marking milestones in your word adventure — a refreshing reward system beyond simple scores.
- Brain Training Without Burnout: Exercise memory, focus, and language skills through relaxing gameplay that feels more like meditation than work.
- Word Puzzle Meets Word Connect: Enjoy the best of classic word games combined with a modern, creative twist.
- Gentle, Immersive Design: Calming visuals, peaceful soundtracks, and effortless flow make it the perfect casual game for unwinding anytime.

- Smooth Word Connect Play: Swipe to connect letters and discover words in beautifully crafted word puzzles.

- Growing Challenge: Word searches and vocabulary puzzles that evolve in difficulty, keeping you engaged and motivated.

bluejetty:00175590:ios.name: World of Artillery: Tank Fire
bluejetty:00175590:ios.summary: Are you ready to step into the warzone and experience the thrilling action of World War II? With World Of Artillery, an explosive war game, your gaming experience is guaranteed to heat up with artillery fire. This historical warfare simulat
bluejetty:00175590:ios.description:
Are you ready to step into the warzone and experience the thrilling action of World War II? With World Of Artillery, an explosive war game, your gaming experience is guaranteed to heat up with artillery fire. This historical warfare simulator brings you into a lifelike replica of the battles fought during WW2. Join a gun shooting game where victory will be determined only by your shooting skills!
Experience the exciting war thunder – Take part in a historical artillery simulator and experience the power of firing cannons
Are you ready to experience the power and might of an artillery? Step into the shoes of the soldiers who fought in some of the world's most pivotal battles with our state-of-the-art artillery simulator. Feel the adrenaline rush as you fire cannons and witness firsthand the destruction they caused. Experience the power and the noise of the battlefield! Get ready to become a true hero as you engage in this action war game!
Feel like a sniper – Take command of your battle station and fight against enemies with strategic planning and use of tactics
Are you ready to step up and become an artilleryman in the FPS game? It's time to become a command master of a cannon and smash enemy vehicles from cars and tank force to armored trains and whole armies in the warzone of World War II. Break into the world of tanks from an unattainable height! Feeling like a true gunner in fierce tank battles!
Become a hero - Help allied troops by providing fire support
Destroy enemy armies with cannons to defend your position or save a convoy of wounded. The sound of enemy tanks approaching sends shivers down your spine, but you have a crucial role in this battle. Your cannon holds the power to destroy those tanks and protect the allied troops. As you take aim and fire, adrenaline rushes through your veins. One blast after another, you are determined to defend your position and help your fellow soldiers. Every shot counts, and your expertise in providing fire support is invaluable. This is the kind of courage that defines a hero, and you are proud to be a part of this historic moment.
Unlock impressive weaponry – Unlock and upgrade powerful weapons, from classic cannons to advanced artillery pieces
Prepare for battle and unlock the arsenal of impressive weaponry at your disposal. Don't settle for mediocre firepower, upgrade your arsenal and make your enemies tremble in fear! From classic cannons to advanced artillery pieces, there's no shortage of ways to blast your way through any obstacle. Embrace the power of top-tier weapons and make a name for yourself on the battlefield. Whether you're facing off against enemies or just trying to conquer new territory, you won't find a better way to do it than with these ultimate weapons. So what are you waiting for? Equip your troops and get ready for military domination!
Fight for honor - Earn medals for your services, unlock special ranks and honor your nation's flag whilst fighting for glory
If you're looking for an exciting way to experience the feats of war, look no further than World of Artillery: Cannon. With this historical artillery simulator, you can become a hero and take command of your battle station to fight against enemies. Unlock an impressive array of weapons, from classic cannons to advanced pieces of artillery. Plus, train, fight and rise up through competitive leagues while earning rewards and badges for your services. 
Features of World of Artillery:
- Addictive war game with FPS gameplay
- Online and offline game mode
- Battlefields on the territory of Ally nations
- Various shooting game missions
- Extensive arsenal with the ability to upgrade
- Realistic 3d graphics
If you have an itch for war games, World of Artillery: Cannon is the perfect choice! Fight for honor - join forces and prove your worth, become a world war hero today and show off your shooting skills in the ultimate warzone of the world of tanks!

* Clean and minimal interface
* Simple navigation and fast loading
* Regular content expansion
Whether you're a new player discovering your favorite heroes or a long-time fan who enjoys exploring aesthetic variations, ML Hero Skin Center is a great companion for enhancing your style choices.

bluejetty:00185526:ios.description:
Beautiful and Peaceful Fishing
Fishing is to Heal your heart.
Don't worry. It will be ok!
We introduce the beautiful and peaceful game to you who's tired and exhausted from daily life.
Enjoy fishing whales just with a simple control while listening to the sound of waves ASMR at the beautiful sea. 
Fishing and Life Story
 The main character so normal that he could be anyone in anywhere went fishing to the sea of the memories with his dad on a very tiring day.
 He only has a shabby boat and a fishing rod, but he enjoys the peaceful fishing at the beautiful sea where the sun sets, shooting stars fall and the sky fades into the lighthouse.
 What you can do
 You can fish beautiful fish, scary sharks and big whales just with simple control.
 Enjoy the beautiful sunset and the moonlight that fade into the sea. 
 It presents the beautiful scenes of the sunrise and moonset as time goes by.
 The sound of the waves heals your heart. 
 The natural ASMR waves sound brings you to the carefree sea. 
 Try to put your fish in the aquarium. Even just looking at them makes you feel at ease.
 Enjoy your own fishing while getting changed to different clothes.
 It's ok to just get on the boat and go to the sea. 
 Various boats will take you further into the sea.
You can enjoy it online.
 Invite your friends and enjoy fishing together.

bluejetty:00133194:ios.description:
Welcome to the brand new BBVA Empresas App in Spain, Colombia, Uruguay and Peru!
With the BBVA Empresas app you can check all your accounts, pay your bills and make transfers whenever you are, whenever you want. Take the power of your bank right in your pocket!
What else can I do with this app?
- Check your accounts balance and each transactions’ details in real time. Whenever you want being able to filter by date and value.
- Make transfers to both your own accounts and from any other bank (online with BBVA accounts). (1)
- Get precise information about all your sales received by POS the easiest possible way. (1)
- Activate your mobile token to sign your operations safer and faster. (1)
- Pay all your bills from one single app. (1)
- Consult and download the Certificates of your Accounts. (1)
- Sign your operations jointly. (1)
- You can view and sign your documents at any time, from the new pending signatures module. (1)
- Receive payments for your online sales by sending payment links by WhatsApp, email or SMS to your customers. (1)
Did you know this app is safer and easier than ever?
- Access the app with biometrics, the most convenient and secure way to protect your private area. (1)
- Check and manage your Digital Token in a safer and more agile way. (1)
- Now with the multitoken function, you can have the digital token of several users at the same time on the same device. (1)
- The data of your operations are protected with the highest security standards.
- Protect the access to your account thanks to your BBVA password, even if your cell phone is lost.
Are you a BBVA Net Cash user?
No problem, enter the same credentials to access the App. It’s that easy. You are now ready to operate from your phone in a secure, fast and easy way.
Are you not a BBVA Net Cash user?
No worries. Go to any BBVA branch office and we will help you to join us in just 15 minutes.
More doubts?
We are here to help you. Call us at (1)3078071 from 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM or email us at contactoempresarial@bbva.com.co. We are glad to answer your questions and we’re excited that you are part of this app. If have any other suggestions of valuable feedback, email us at contactoempresarial@bbva.com.co 
If you like BBVA Business App, spread the word by rating us with 5 stars, thanks!
(1) Available in Colombia

bluejetty:00174767:ios.description:
Never forget to take your medicine, vitamins, or supplements again with Pill Reminder!
Taking your medication on time is important for your health and well-being. 
With Pill Reminder, you can easily track your medications, vitamins, and supplements, and receive custom notifications and reminders to help you stay on schedule.
Why is it important to take your medication on time?
- Taking your medication on time helps to ensure that you have a consistent level of medication in your body, which is necessary for effective treatment.
- Missing doses of medication can lead to your condition getting worse, hospitalization, or even death.
- Taking medication at the wrong time of day can interfere with its effectiveness or cause side effects.
How can Pill Reminder help you take your medication on time?
- Pill Reminder sends you custom notifications and reminders at the times you need to take your medication.
- You can choose from different sounds for your notifications, so you can find one that works best for you.
- Pill Reminder also allows you to export a PDF report of your medication history, which you can share with your doctor or pharmacist.
Other features of Pill Reminder:
- Add your medications right from the Apple Watch.
- Take care of your whole family with Pill Reminder's family support feature.
- Download Pill Reminder today and never forget your medication again!
Medical disclaimer:
This app does not provide any medical advice or treatment. You are responsible for any drugs and the dosage added to this app. Please always contact your doctor before making any medical decisions.

bluejetty:00035923:ios.description:
QuickTune 7 - the successor of the highly acclaimed QuickTune 6 Tuning Calculator for Forza 6 - is now available with full support for Forza Motorsport 7!
FEATURES:
+ Calculates ready-made balanced and competitive tunes, no tweaking necessary!
+ Supports all cars in FM7 
+ Choose between general purpose and track specific tunes
+ Night and rain tuning
+ Advanced settings for adjustment of tune balance and stiffness
+ Supports imperial and metric units
+ "Favorites" features allows you to save and keep track of your favorite tunes
+ Automatically keeps track of 100 most recent tuned cars
+ Includes aero and transmission tuning
HOW DOES IT WORK:
First provide some car data:
- manufacturer & car model
- power
- weight & weight distribution 
- drivetrain
- chassis reinforcement
- transmission 
- tire compound 
- tire width (front and rear)
- installed aero kits
Then choose whether it should be a general purpose tune suited for multiplayer lobby racing or track specific tune ideally suited for rival races.
Further tuning options allow for custom tuning of track conditions, temperature conditions, overall balance, tire pressure, anti-roll bars, springs and dampers, ride height, brake balance, differential, transmission and aero.
Based on the provided data a tune is calculated. ARBs and spring rates are provided with 3 fraction digit precision, set the in-game values to nearest value.
Advanced tune settings allow you further adjust tune balance and the stiffness.

Sometimes, escaping reality can be simple.

 From forest tree houses and fairy mushroom houses to sky castles, underwater palaces, and dream cottages, every picture feels like a magical world waiting to be colored.
What you experience is more than ordinary coloring.
 It is a relaxing fantasy journey filled with magical houses, cozy living, and peaceful creativity.
Whimsical House Color is a casual game that blends fantasy house art, relaxing paint by number gameplay, and a warm whimsical atmosphere. It is not just about filling blank spaces with color. It is about bringing magical cottages, fairy houses, floating castles, underwater palaces, and dream homes to life through a smooth and relaxing coloring process.
As you play, every completed section makes the house feel brighter, warmer, and more complete.
 That gentle change from empty outlines to a glowing fantasy home gives Whimsical House Color its relaxing charm.
Explore fairy mushroom houses, forest tree houses, magical cottages, floating sky castles, seaside shell houses, underwater palaces, surreal dream homes, and fantasy interiors. Each theme is designed with a warm, dreamy, and healing visual style.
For players searching for Whimsicah fantasy style, cozy home coloring, magical house art, or relaxing games for drawing and creativity, this color experience offers a gentle way to unwind.
 Gameplay & Features
- Relaxing paint by number
Follow the numbers and complete each fantasy house with simple taps. Easy to start, relaxing to play.
- Unique whimsical house theme
Every image is built around magic houses, cozy homes, fairy cottages, dream homes, and fantasy living spaces.
- Forest, fairy, and magic cottages
Discover tree houses, mushroom houses, tiny garden homes, wizard cottages, and glowing forest homes.
- Sky castles and floating homes
Color fantasy buildings above the clouds, floating islands, rainbows, towers, castles, and dreamy sky homes.
- Ocean houses and underwater palaces
Explore shell houses, coral buildings, seaside homes, underwater palaces, bubbles, and blue ocean worlds.
- Cozy fantasy for daily relaxation
Soft visuals, easy controls, and steady progress make it perfect for quiet breaks, bedtime, or stress relief.
- No drawing skills needed
You do not need drawing skills or complicated tools. Just tap, color, relax, and watch each whimsical house come together one section at a time.
If you enjoy coloring games, paint by number, fantasy art, cozy houses, fairy cottages, dream homes, and relaxing casual games, Whimsical House Color brings you into a more imaginative fantasy house world.

Welcome to Whimsical House Color.

bluejetty:00029458:android.description:
DLRMS (formerly eKhatian) app has been introduced to serve the citizens of Bangladesh aspiring for digital land services. The main purpose of this app is to provide the service seekers with instant feedback and answer about any query related to khatian and mouza map. By using this app, any citizen of Bangladesh will be able to search for particular khatian, view information and apply for certified copy of the desired khatian. At the same time, Citizens will get all the information related to Mouza through this app. They will be able to search, view and apply for certified mouza as per their requirement. In this app, anyone can get information about other digital land services like online land development tax, budget management, rest certificate case, online review case and so on.
In addition, citizen will be provided by a tracking ID while applying for any services related to Khatian and Mouza. By this tracking ID, citizen will be able to track the current status of his/her application. The authorized/monitoring authority will be able to view summarized report related to Khatian and Mouza in their dashboard.

bluejetty:00173563:ios.description:
Investigate a mystery of a vanished toy-maker in Brightstone Mysteris — a story-driven hidden-object puzzle adventure game with mini-games and puzzles, an interactive map, guided hint and multiple difficulty modes.
Explore a small town full of secrets. Search beautifully illustrated scenes for hidden objects, solve clever puzzles and mini-games, question strange locals, and piece together a chilling conspiracy. Find out where your investigation will take you!
WHAT AWAITS YOU:
• Puzzle & mystery adventure — dozens of unique riddles and mini-games. 
• Intriguing narrative — a dramatic plot with twists and memorable characters.
• Atmospheric visuals & soundtrack — moody scenes that pull you deep into the mystery.
• Map & Journal – always know where to go next.
• Full voiceovers & HD visuals – immerse yourself in the story.
• Difficulty levels – from relaxed exploration to true challenge.
• Play completely offline — anytime, anywhere
• No data collection — your privacy is safe
• Try free, unlock full game once – no ads, no micro-transactions.
PERFECT FOR PLAYERS WHO WANT:
• A hidden object puzzle adventure with a rich story.
• A detective investigation solving riddles and puzzles. 
• Phone & tablet experience — play anywhere.
• Fully offline experience with no data collection.
• Premium Game • No Ads • No Data Collected
- Gameplay -
Tap to search scenes, collect clues, combine items from your inventory, and complete mini-games to progress the story. Use hints if you get stuck — but the reward is uncovering more of the mystery.
- Play your way - 
Explore, investigate, find hidden objects and items, and solve puzzles and mini-games and reveal the mystery in your own way: adjustable challenge: Casual, Adventure, and Challenging difficulty modes. Win Achievements & Collectibles.
 - Atmospheric adventure - 
A gripping mystery adventure: narrative-driven game-play with a strong detective lead. Immersive locations waiting to be explored; seek, search and solve puzzles.
 - Why players love it - 
The combination of art and atmosphere and blend of story-driven adventure and classic puzzles and minigames. Whether you love relaxing hunts or challenge-driven puzzles, this game offers both.
 - Free to try - 
Try for free, then unlock the full game for the entire mystery — no distractions, just mystery to solve.
FEATURES
• EXCITING out-of-this-world ADVENTURE
• FEELS like playing an interactive thriller novel
• MEET enigmatic characters
• EXPLORE the mystical town and its locations
• FIND clues and solve RIDDLES
• SEARCH for HIDDEN OBJECTS and items
• SOLVE many different mini-games
• USE GUIDED HINT and MAP for traveling
• DIFFICULTY MODES: casual, adventure, challenging
