bluejetty:00023445:ios.description:
**Receipt Maker: Easy eReceipts & PDF Generator**
Turn your smartphone into a powerful receipt generator with Receipt Maker!
Create professional electronic receipts in PDF or HTML effortlessly, and streamline your record-keeping like never before.
Whether you're a business owner, freelancer, shop or cafe owner, landlord, tenant manager, cleaner, tradesperson, gig worker, or simply need to manage expenses efficiently, Receipt Maker is your ultimate digital companion to create receipts fast and get paid.
---
KEY FEATURES
 * eReceipt Maker: Generate stunning electronic receipts on the go. Say goodbye to paper clutter and hello to digital convenience!
 * PDF Receipt Generator: Create polished PDF receipts that impress clients and partners. Present your transactions with professionalism.
 * Effortless Sharing: Send receipts via email or text directly from the app. Instantly update clients, customers, or colleagues with the details they need.
 * Seamless Online Sharing: Share receipts using a variety of popular online tools.
 * Team-Friendly: Empower your accountants and bookkeepers by granting them access to your receipts. Foster smooth collaboration and accurate record-keeping.
 * Multi-Device Access: Enjoy the freedom to use Receipt Maker across multiple devices, including iPhone and iPad. Your data stays synced, no matter where you are.
---
WHY RECEIPT MAKER?
 * Boost Efficiency: Speed up your receipt-making process and focus on what you do best. Generate receipts fast and get paid.
 * Professional Impressions: Present your transactions in a sleek, modern format that reflects your business's image. Generate receipts like a pro!
 * Data Security: Rest easy knowing your financial information and transactions are safe, accessible only to authorized users.
 * Customize & Personalize: Tailor your receipts to match your branding and add a personal touch to each transaction. Generate beautiful PDF and HTML receipts on the go.
 * Accurate Insights: Gain a clear overview of your financial activities and transactions. Make informed decisions based on organized records.
---
Receipt Maker simplifies your accounting and bookkeeping, with your entire team able to view and use the receipts. Choose from 10+ professional templates, and even add your company logo.
Join the thousands revolutionizing their sales management with Receipt Maker. Streamline your financial workflow, reduce paperwork, and enhance collaboration with ease. Download now and take control of your receipts!
Download Receipt Maker today and experience the future of hassle-free receipt management!
---
[Upgrade to the Subscription Version]
The subscription version offers cloud sync, allowing you to store all your data securely in the cloud and access it across multiple iOS devices, like iPhone and iPad.
Upgrading requires an auto-renewal subscription, with payment charged to your Apple ID account at the time of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscriptions through your App Store account settings.
Links to Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
http://www.btoj.com.au/privacy.html
http://www.btoj.com.au/terms.html
Feel free to contact us with any questions!

bluejetty:00185890:ios.description:
This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
 Enjoy one minute of explosive match-3 fun from PopCap Games! Detonate as many gems as you can, 60 action-packed seconds at a time, in the hit puzzle game played by over 125 million people worldwide. Match three or more and create cascades of awesome with Flame gems, Star gems, and Hypercubes. Use powerful Rare Gems and upgradable Boosts to compete against friends, or challenge other players and top the leaderboards in Blitz Champions.
 TOP THE LEADERBOARDS IN BLITZ CHAMPIONS
 Challenge other players across the globe when you compete in Blitz Champions Contests. Get matched with players at your level and battle it out for the top score. Accomplish a variety of tasks and show off your skills – each Contest features a new way to play. Change up your strategy and play like a champion to win powerful rewards and top the leaderboards!
 DISCOVER EXPLOSIVE EXCITEMENT
 Collect special Boosts like Scrambler to scramble the board, or Detonator to blast all special gems, and add extra power and fun to each match. Then upgrade them up to 10 times for scores that reach the stratosphere! Use Boosts any time and without spending Coins. Boosts never expire, so you can focus on upgrading the ones that work for you.
 PERFECT YOUR STRATEGY WITH RARE GEMS
 Amazing and unique Rare Gems like Sunstone and Plume Blast provide big scores and even more excitement. Combine them with Boosts to achieve unbelievably high scores. Play your way when you create mighty combinations of glittering Rare Gems and three Boosts to develop your own personal approach.
 SPARKLING NEW CONTENT
 Feast your eyes on fresh visuals and enjoy remixed audio that has been overhauled to improve your experience. Play live events with players around the world and complete special tasks each week to earn amazing rewards. Plus, get in the game faster than ever with a rebuilt user experience and simplified navigation.

Contains direct links to the Internet and social networking sites intended for an audience over 13.
User Agreement: http://terms.ea.com

bluejetty:00094793:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00094793:ios.description:
Welcome to Donut Sort – The Sweetest Sorting Puzzle Game!
Get ready to dive into a world of delicious donuts and brain-teasing challenges in Donut Sort - Puzzle Game, the classic sorting puzzle game with a sweet twist! Sort colorful donuts into boxes and stack them to create the perfect arrangement. It's time to put your sorting skills to the test in this fun and addictive sorting game!
How to Play
- Sort by Color: Your goal is to organize donuts by color. Each box can hold at least 3 donuts, with the number varying by level. There are approximately 10 different colors of donuts waiting for you to discover!
- Put & Stack: You can only put donuts from the top of one box into another, and only if the top donuts match in color. Be strategic with your moves to avoid getting stuck!
- Complete the Boxes: You can use the boxes with available capacity to sort the donuts. Once a box is full of a single color, it’s packed and cannot be moved.
- Puzzle Challenge: The difficulty increases with each level, and each puzzle will require careful planning to solve. Can you sort all the donuts without hitting a dead end?
Game Features
- Charming Visuals: Enjoy eye-catching graphics and colorful donuts, making each puzzle a visual treat.
- Smooth Controls: Just tap to put the donuts! Simple and intuitive gameplay with smooth, responsive controls.
- Challenging Levels: A wealth of puzzles that increase in difficulty as you progress. Each level presents unique sorting challenges, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting.
- Collect Stars: Earn stars as you complete levels and use them to decorate your very own donut island! Unlock new customization options and personalize your island with unique decorations.
Why Play Donut Sort?
- Free & Fun: Free to play, with many fun puzzles challenging your sorting skills while allowing you to relax through its enjoyable gameplay.
- Multiple Levels: A wide variety of levels to test your sorting skills, each more exciting and challenging than the last.
- Stress Relief: Sort donuts at your own pace to clear your mind and enjoy some relaxing moments.
- Brain Training: A great way to sharpen your logic and problem-solving abilities while having fun!
- No wifi needed: Play anywhere, anytime—whether you have a few minutes to spare or want to spend hours solving puzzles.
Get Sorting and Have Fun!
Donut Sort is perfect for players of all ages, seamlessly combining color sorting with donut elements to create a unique and enjoyable gameplay experience. Ready to sort those sweet donuts? Enjoy hours of addictive, fun, and challenging gameplay! Can you complete all the levels and collect all the stars? Let the sweet puzzle-solving begin!

bluejetty:00022043:ios.description:
The Fifth Edition of The American Heritage® Dictionary of the English Language is one of the most comprehensive and accessible resources available on any mobile device. 
This latest edition has been much anticipated:
10 years
20 Lexicographers
200 Usage Experts
10,000 New Words and Senses
1 Defining Achievement
Keep the hardcopy at home and take the app out with you wherever you need it. 
Main Features:
● the entire text of this landmark new edition
● complete front matter and appendices
● real-time progressive searching
● three-way cross-referencing indexes
● wildcard pattern searches (with * ?)
● online search support for rare words and slang
● spelling suggestions
● internal hyperlinking
● zoomable graphics
● full pronunciation symbols chart
● IPA pronunciation symbol conversion
● detailed etymologies with links to root appendices
● professionally recorded sound files
● automatic search history
● fallback online search for esoteric or archaic words and the latest slang
● AI boosted anagram generator
● two-way external application interaction
● bookmarks with editable notations
● make-your-own flashcards
● "Word-a-day" feature with TOEIC® & TOEFL® lists
● "Share" extension to search inside other apps -with "store for later"
● "Today" and LockScreen widgets
● 3D Touch support
● DarkMode support
● iPad Pro multi-screen and Drag & Drop
● Dyslexic mode and VoiceOver support
● iOS12 to iOS27 support
● iPhone 18 support
● iPhone, iPod, iPad and macOS support
In keeping with the American Heritage® tradition of cutting-edge research, the Fifth Edition represents the work of a dedicated team of experts, scholars, and contributors. Thousands of definitions have been revised in rapidly changing fields such as astronomy and biology, geographical entries and maps have been completely updated, and the dictionary’s signature feature notes on word history, synonymy, and language variation have been enhanced and improved.
Word meanings are made easier to understand with thousands of new quotations from classic and contemporary writers. Etymologies explaining word origins and development have been newly created or revised to reflect the very latest scholarship. Many words are traced back to their roots in prehistory through two unique appendices showing word roots in ancient Indo-European and Semitic.
Reliable, enlightening, and visually stunning, the Fifth Edition of The American Heritage® Dictionary of the English Language gives you the opportunity to make your mark in the best possible way.

First US Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with First US Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the First US Bank app, you must be enrolled as a First US Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00159149:ios.name: Cost Cutters Hair Salon
bluejetty:00159149:ios.summary: Welcome to Cost Cutters, where style meets savings! Unlock the door to convenience with our mobile app—your tool to hassle-free salon bookings! With just a few taps, you can book services for you and the entire family at the Cost Cutters sa
bluejetty:00159149:ios.description:
Welcome to Cost Cutters, where style meets savings! Unlock the door to convenience with our mobile app—your tool to hassle-free salon bookings! With just a few taps, you can book services for you and the entire family at the Cost Cutters salon of your choice. Simply select your preferred date, choose your desired service(s), and book with your favorite stylist. Embrace the ease of getting a haircut at Cost Cutters by downloading the app today.
Key Features of the Cost Cutters Mobile App:
1. Fast and Simple Online Booking*: Wave goodbye to waiting! Book your next fabulous look online, whether it's a spontaneous style change or a carefully planned glam session. You can book same-day or up to 3 days in advance**—your choice, your schedule!
2. Book the Whole Crew: Because great hair runs in the family! With our app, booking for multiple people at once is a breeze. Simply save each guest to your profile before creating a booking.
3. Real Time Wait Times: No more wondering! Check the current wait times at nearby salons and step into style when it suits you. Time is of the essence, and so is your stunning look!
4. Hassle Free Navigation: Our app's salon finder effortlessly guides you to the nearest Cost Cutters salon. One click, and voila—directions to your salon await.
5. Personalized Experience: By logging in you can take advantage of time saving features. Book faster by saving your guest information, and rebooking a past visit with our visit history feature.
6. Booking Reminders: Never miss an appointment. Receive timely reminders to keep your hair game strong!
Frequently Asked Questions:
Do you still accept walk-ins?
Absolutely! Walk-ins are still welcome at all our locations. However, for the crème de la crème of salon experiences, we highly recommend booking in advance. It not only secures your spot but ensures our talented stylists have the perfect amount of time to work their magic.
How far in advance can I book?
Book your appointment same-day or up to 3 days in advance—the choice is yours. Just a heads-up: future booking options may vary depending on the salon's location.
When should I arrive at the salon?
Time is of the essence, especially when it comes to your hair. Arrive punctually for the appointment time you selected so that we can keep you right on schedule. Running fashionably late? Your name will grace our list for a short period of time.
Can I book online without a mobile device?
You bet! You can still book online by visiting www.costcutters.com. Search for the nearest salon, pick your service(s) and stylist, and you’re booked!
* Online check-in is available at participating locations only.
** Future booking options vary by location.

FEATURES

bluejetty:00121407:ios.description:
This Rome guide is completely free and has been created by the Civitatis team, the leading company in the sale of guided tours, excursions, and free tours in English all over the world. So you can guess what you'll find there: all the tourist information you need to make the most of your trip to Rome, with a perfect combination of cultural, sightseeing, and entertainment options. 
You'll also find in this Rome guide practical information that will help you organize your trip to Rome, as well as tips and advice to make the most of your time in Rome. What to see in Rome? Where to eat, where to sleep? What are the places you really have to visit? Any tips to save money? Our Rome guide will answer all these and more.
The most interesting sections of this free guide to Rome are:
• General information: Learn how to plan your trip to Rome and find out what is the necessary documentation to visit it, what is the weather like at the time you're traveling, or what are the opening hours of its stores.
• What to see: Discover the main attractions in Rome, as well as practical information on how to visit these tourist spots, how to get there, opening hours, closing days, prices, etc.
• Where to eat: Learn more about the most traditional dishes in Italy and the best places to sample them in Rome. And why not do it for the best price? We tell you the best places to eat on a budget in Rome.
• Where to stay: Are you looking for a quiet neighborhood to rest or a lively one to party until dawn? Our free travel guide will let you know in which area you should look for your accommodation in Rome.
• Transport: Find out how to get around Rome and which are the best ways to move around depending on your budget or your time.
• Shopping: Get the perfect souvenirs and save time and money by knowing in advance which are the best areas to go shopping in Rome.
• Map: The most comprehensive map of Rome, where you can see all the must-see sights, where to eat, the best area to book your hotel, or the neighborhood with the greatest and liveliest atmosphere in Rome.
• Activities: With our Rome guide, you can also book the best Civitatis activities for your trip. Guided tours, excursions, tickets, free tours... Everything to fill your trip!
We know that when you're traveling, there's no time to waste. And even more, when there are so many things to do in Rome. That's why, with this free travel guide, we want to help you fill your trip to Rome. Have a blast and enjoy your vacation!
P.S. The information and tips in this guide were written by and for travelers and were collected on January 2023. If you find any inaccuracies or find something you think we should change, please contact us (https://www.civitatis.com/en/contact/).

bluejetty:00116206:ios.summary:
Mine, Drill, Battle & Destroy Planets to Build the Ultimate Ship!

bluejetty:00116206:ios.description:
Mine, Drill, Battle & Destroy Planets to Build the Ultimate Ship!
In Planet Crusher, you control a powerful mining ship built to drill, dig, and destroy planets across space. Fly deep into uncharted worlds, mine rare resources, and upgrade your ship with deadly weapons. With roguelike perks and over 3 million possible builds, every mission is a new challenge!
Now featuring new social systems like Guilds, PvP battles, Adventures, Arena fights, and competitive leaderboards! Invite your friends and join Guilds as you compete with others. Join the global mining war and see how you stack up against players worldwide.
Dig Deep & Mine Planets
Each planet is loaded with minerals like iron, titanium, and rare gems. Drill through layers of rock, reach the planet’s core, and gather as much as you can before time runs out—or your ship blows up!
Upgrade & Customize Your Ship
Turn your basic mining rig into a planet-destroying warship. Upgrade your weapons, shields, drills, boosters—and now, PvP loadouts—to rule the stars.
Roguelike Perks & PvP Builds
Choose new perks every run. With millions of combinations, no two ships are alike. Want to dominate in mining? Focus on digging power. Want to crush enemies in the Arena? Build for speed, missiles, and shields. Create builds tailored for Arena duels, PvP defense, or solo adventure mining.
Equip Lasers, Missiles & Blades
Use a mix of lasers, saws, blasters, and missile systems to mine faster and defeat enemy ships. Upgrade your arsenal to suit your playstyle—offense in PvP, or defense in survival mode.
Explore Alien Worlds & PvP Arenas
Some planets are peaceful. Others are battlegrounds. Compete in the PvP Arena, take on special Adventure maps, and climb the leaderboards to prove you’re the best planet crusher.
Level Up & Rise Through the Ranks
Mine more, fight more, win more. Unlock ship upgrades and perks that give you an edge in both mining and combat. Get ranked in weekly leaderboards for mining, damage, PvP victories, and more.
Find Better Gear to Go Deeper & Stronger
Discover rare gear and mods that boost your mining depth, combat strength, and Arena win rate. Earn gear through quests, challenges, and multiplayer events.
Daily Quests, PvP Events & Leaderboards
Take on new challenges every day. Win special rewards in Arena PvP events, finish epic Adventures, and climb the global leaderboards.
Simple Controls, Massive Fun
Just one finger to control everything. Mine, fight, fly, and upgrade. Whether you’re into idle planet mining, roguelike runs, or fast-paced PvP combat, Planet Crusher has it all.
Start Your Adventure—Mine, Fight & Rule the Stars
Customize your ship, mine alien worlds, crush your enemies in PvP, and unlock your place in the galaxy. This is your journey to become the ultimate Planet Crusher.
Download now and join the fight!
IGRS Rating: 13+

bluejetty:00177924:ios.description:
"Translator X" will help you communicate freely and effectively at any time wherever you go.
Our app is a must-have tool for tourists or business travelers, and thus wish to communicate in local languages at the airport, the hotel, or famous places. All you need is to type, say or snap a photo of any phrase in your mother tongue, and the app will automatically recognize, interpret, and pronounce the translation out loud, on the fly! Our app can also turn into a language supporting tool for those who want to learn new phrases and listen to the accurate pronunciation.
We show you how to get the most out of all the features and the top-notch technology used in Translator X.
How the CAMERA OBJECT mode works:
- Take a photo of an object via camera
- See the name of the object automatically recognized in the captured image
- Get the translation into your target language
- Listen to the pronunciation
How the CAMERA IMAGE mode works:
- Take a photo of printed text via camera
- See the printed text automatically recognized in the captured image
- Get the translation into your target language
- Listen to the pronunciation
How the VOICE mode works:
- Speak a phrase in your language via a microphone
- See the text automatically recognized
- Get the translation into your target language
- Listen to the pronunciation
How the TEXT mode works:
- Type a text in your language via keyboard
- Get the translation into your target language
- Listen to the pronunciation
FEATURES:
- Apple Speech Recognition Technology allows converting Speech-to-Text in real-time, ensures maximum translation speed
- 115 languages for Text-to-Text translations
- 39 languages for Speech-to-Speech translations
- 74 languages for Speech-to-Text translations
- Built-in offline voices without Internet connection needs: help reduce traffic usage and faster translation
- Smart & intuitive History log tapes to save conversations & translations. It can also be used as a phrasebook to store your favorite phrases & conversations
- iCloud support to sync all history log tapes across all your Apple devices
- Log tapes can be editable
- Copy to clipboard, Paste & Share log tapes
- Export all History log tapes via Email, SMS, Notes, etc
- Configurable settings: male or female voice, voice speed, auto-detect end of the speech, auto speak out loud after translation
NOTES:
* Translation, Speech Recognition and Text-to-Speech services provided by Google Translate™
* Voice to Voice translations support:
Arabic, Basque, Catalan, Chinese (Cantonese, Mandarin, Taiwan), Czech, Danish, Dutch (The Netherlands), English (Australian, Canada, India, UK, US), Finnish, French, French (Canada), Galician, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Moldavian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Portuguese (Brazil), Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Spanish, Spanish (Mexican), Swedish, Thai, Turkish.
* Voice to Text translations support:
Afrikaans, Bulgarian, Croatian, Filipino, Icelandic, Latin, Lithuanian, Malay, Persian, Serbian, Slovenian, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Zulu.

Our app is a must-have tool for tourists or business travelers, and thus wish to communicate in local languages at the airport, the hotel, or famous places. All you need is to type, say or snap a photo of any phrase in your mother tongue, and the app will automatically recognize, interpret, and pronounce the translation out loud, on the fly! Our app can also turn into a language supporting tool for those who want to learn new phrases and listen to the accurate pronunciation.

We show you how to get the most out of all the features and the top-notch technology used in Translator X.

How the CAMERA OBJECT mode works:
- Take a photo of an object via camera
- See the name of the object automatically recognized in the captured image
- Get the translation into your target language
- Listen to the pronunciation

How the CAMERA IMAGE mode works:
- Take a photo of printed text via camera
- See the printed text automatically recognized in the captured image
- Get the translation into your target language
- Listen to the pronunciation

How the VOICE mode works:
- Speak a phrase in your language via a microphone
- See the text automatically recognized
- Get the translation into your target language
- Listen to the pronunciation

How the TEXT mode works:
- Type a text in your language via keyboard
- Get the translation into your target language
- Listen to the pronunciation

FEATURES:
- Apple Speech Recognition Technology allows converting Speech-to-Text in real-time, ensures maximum translation speed
- 115 languages for Text-to-Text translations
- 39 languages for Speech-to-Speech translations
- 74 languages for Speech-to-Text translations
- Built-in offline voices without Internet connection needs: help reduce traffic usage and faster translation
- Smart & intuitive History log tapes to save conversations & translations. It can also be used as a phrasebook to store your favorite phrases & conversations
- iCloud support to sync all history log tapes across all your Apple devices
- Log tapes can be editable
- Copy to clipboard, Paste & Share log tapes
- Export all History log tapes via Email, SMS, Notes, etc
- Configurable settings: male or female voice, voice speed, auto-detect end of the speech, auto speak out loud after translation

NOTES:
* Translation, Speech Recognition and Text-to-Speech services provided by Google Translate™

* Voice to Voice translations support:
Arabic, Basque, Catalan, Chinese (Cantonese, Mandarin, Taiwan), Czech, Danish, Dutch (The Netherlands), English (Australian, Canada, India, UK, US), Finnish, French, French (Canada), Galician, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Moldavian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Portuguese (Brazil), Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Spanish, Spanish (Mexican), Swedish, Thai, Turkish.

* Voice to Text translations support:
Afrikaans, Bulgarian, Croatian, Filipino, Icelandic, Latin, Lithuanian, Malay, Persian, Serbian, Slovenian, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Zulu.

SUBSCRIPTION:
* Subscription payments will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of your purchase and upon commencement of each renewal term. Subscriptions with a free trial period will automatically renew to a paid subscription. You can cancel your subscription or free trial in the iTunes settings at least 24-hours before the end of the free trial period. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and thus you will be downgraded to the free service.

* Please note: any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
* Privacy Policy: http://www.skypaw.com/translatorx/privacy_policy.html
* EULA: http://www.skypaw.com/translatorx/terms.html

bluejetty:00136909:ios.summary:
You laugh, you actually talk, you flirt again. That's Lovify. 1000+ questions across 50+ topics, with millions of couples already playing.
One of you answers, the other guesses, and every wrong guess is the funniest part of the evening.
T
bluejetty:00136909:ios.description:
You laugh, you actually talk, you flirt again. That's Lovify. 1000+ questions across 50+ topics, with millions of couples already playing.
One of you answers, the other guesses, and every wrong guess is the funniest part of the evening.
Their favourite meal? Easy. The childhood dream they never bring up? Less sure. What they'd actually do with a million dollars? Now it gets interesting.
You learn something new about each other.
HOW TO PLAY
1. Create a room and send your partner the code. They join from their own phone.
2. Spin the wheel to pick a topic.
3. Round one: answer questions about yourself.
4. Round two: guess your partner's answers.
5. Reveal the score, compare answers and laugh at every guess that missed.
Enjoy the Topics like:
Travel, food, films and music, hobbies, romance and many more. Start light with easy icebreakers, then move into the questions that spark real conversations. With this many topics, no two date nights feel the same.
WHY PLAY TONIGHT
It turns an ordinary evening into date night.
No reservations, no planning, no dressing up. Just the two of you, two phones and a question game for couples that's ready whenever you are.
It's the easiest couple activity to say yes to.
Out of date ideas? Tired of scrolling side by side? Lovify has no learning curve. The fun starts the moment your partner joins.
It works across any distance.
Lovify is an online multiplayer couples game, so long distance couples can play from anywhere in the world. Hop on a video call, start a round, and the miles disappear for a while. It's the long distance relationship game that turns into your weekly ritual.
It finally answers "How well do you know me?"
Every right guess is a point. Every wrong guess is a story you'll retell for weeks. This relationship quiz is friendly competition to find out who really knows whom better.
It gets you talking about things you've never asked.
Even after years together, there's so much you haven't asked. Our conversation starters bring out the stories, opinions and little secrets that never come up over dinner. Real communication, minus the serious sit-down.
It fits every stage of love.
Dating, engaged, newlywed or married for years. New couples get an icebreaker that skips the small talk. Newlyweds get a newlywed game to play at home. Husbands and wives get marriage games that show there's still plenty to discover.
It brings the butterflies back.
The teasing, the laughing, the little flutter when your partner guesses you right. That's what fun couple games are supposed to feel like.
It's made by people who actually play it.
We're a couple, and we play Lovify ourselves. That's why the design stays simple and clean, every question is written to get a reaction, and we sweat the small details you'll notice as you play. It's the app for couples we always wished existed.
It's free to play.
No subscription needed, so you can start tonight.
EVERY COUPLE GAME IN ONE APP
A couples quiz, a relationship game, a newlywed game and a long distance game, packed with funny and deep questions for couples. Play a quick round before bed or make a whole night of it.
QUICK ANSWERS
Is Lovify a couples game for long distance relationships?
Yes. Each partner plays on their own phone, so it works wherever you both are.
Do we both need the app?
Yes. Lovify is a two-player couples quiz. One partner creates a room, the other joins with the code.
Is it a compatibility test?
No. It's a game. There are no right answers, only your partner's.
Download Lovify, send your partner the code, and find out tonight who really knows who better.

apple-itunes:673659438.name: Trabee: Travel Budget Tracker
apple-itunes:673659438.description:
Trabee is the travel expense tracker built for trips abroad.
Log what you spend in the local currency and see it in yours, instantly. Snap a receipt and let AI do the typing. Keep your trip budget on track, and when you travel with friends, see exactly who owes whom. No spreadsheets. No exchange rate math in your head.
■ Log it the second you spend it
Type the price in the local currency and you're done. Trabee converts it to your home currency automatically, so you always know what that coffee really cost.
■ Know what's left before you spend
Set a trip budget. What you spent today and what you have left update with every expense.
■ Snap the receipt. We'll type it.
Take a photo and AI pulls the amount, currency, date, store, payment method and category, then saves it as an expense. Receipts in a language you can't read? Not your problem anymore.
■ Group trip? Settle up in a tap
Invite your travel buddies to a shared trip and everyone sees the same expenses. Mark who paid and who's in on each one, and Trabee works out who pays whom at the end. (Settle up is a Premium feature.)
■ Where did it all go?
See your spending day by day and by category. Go deeper with detailed stats in Premium.
■ More than a number
The Travel Log keeps notes, photos, receipts and places in one timeline. Your expense tracker turns into a travel diary.
■ Watch your world fill up
Every country you visit and the route between them shows up on a 3D globe. Save it as a video and show it off.
■ No signal? No problem
Keep logging on the plane. Everything syncs once you're back online.
■ Features
∙ AI receipt scanning (free uses on every trip)
∙ Automatic currency conversion to your home currency
∙ Trip budget with today's spending and what's left
∙ Quick entry with a built-in calculator
∙ Cash and card tracked separately
∙ Categories (food, shopping, sightseeing, transport, lodging)
∙ Expenses by date
∙ Income tracking
∙ Photos and notes on expenses
∙ Shared trips with friends
∙ Travel Log (notes, photos, receipts, places)
∙ 3D travel globe and travel stats (countries, trips, days)
∙ Works offline, syncs automatically
■ Premium
∙ Settle up for shared trips, visible to every member
∙ Unlimited AI receipt scans
∙ Multiple countries and currencies per trip
∙ Budget pockets
∙ Detailed statistics
∙ Spread an expense across days
∙ Multiple photos per expense
∙ Expense locations and footprints
∙ Trip folders
∙ Custom categories
∙ Export to PDF, Excel and CSV
Two ways to get it:
∙ Premium pass (7 or 30 days): a one-time purchase for just the days you travel. Never renews.
∙ Premium annual membership: renews yearly, cancel anytime.
New accounts can try every Premium feature for free.
■ Support
Instagram: http://instagram.com/trabeepocket
Email: support@trabee.co.kr

A Bubble-Popping Adventure Awaits!
Match bubbles to free adorable critters and complete exciting challenges.
Play through thousands of colorful levels with unique puzzles.
Reach new areas and discover magical surprises.
Use special power-ups to solve tricky puzzles and win rewards.
Fun & Addictive Gameplay!
Easy to start, but full of exciting challenges.
Enjoy vibrant animations and lovable characters.
Experience stunning visuals in a colorful world.
Play anytime, anywhere—no WiFi needed!
Join Simon’s Cat, Maisy, Chloe, Kitten, Jazz, and more in this purrfect puzzle adventure! Whether you love match puzzles or bubble shooters, this game will keep you entertained for hours.
Start playing now and enjoy a bubble-popping journey like never before!

apple-itunes:1382434604.name: FlipGive Shop - Funding Sports
apple-itunes:1382434604.description:
Fundraise as you shop, dine, or travel! Every grocery run, gas fill-up, meal out, or online purchase can reduce the cost of sports, school, music programs, and more. Easily earn hundreds of dollars annually by buying gift cards and shopping online through FlipGive—no selling or event planning required. It's the easiest way to support the cause that matters most to you. 
How It Works: 
Buy gift cards from hundreds of top brands—you get the full value, and gift cards never expire. Brands share a meaningful portion of each gift card purchase to help lower your cost. 
Shop online through FlipGive—browse brands, click through to their websites, and earn by completing purchases. 
Fuel your fundraising with everyday purchases. FlipGive meets you wherever you shop, dine, or travel with opportunities to earn cashback. Plus, take advantage of exclusive bonus earnings, incentives, and giveaways to boost your impact! 
App Features: 
Instant access to eGift cards and reloaded funds in your account Wallet 
Scan eGift cards at checkout directly from your phone 
Track your earnings over time with your personal dashboard 
Share referral links so friends and family can help you earn 
Click through to brands' websites to shop online and earn 
And more! 
Perfect for Nonprofits: FlipGive has supported thousands of organizations, including sports teams, schools, and music programs. 
Get Started Today! Discover more at FlipGive.com 
Questions? Email us at Support@FlipGive.com
